We introduce Deep Noir, a framework that uses Logit Lens convergence and causal head-level attribution to autonomously discover optimal steering parameters. Across three scales (1B x 3, 2-3B x 2, and 7-9B x 4), our engine achieves 16.7 percentage-point improvement on spam at 1B (standard deviation 4.7; 39 runs), with gains increasing to 21 to 42 percentage points at 7-9B across four architectures. On SST-2 sentiment, it achieves a 13.1 percentage-point improvement with zero code changes. Mechanistic grounding enables automated discovery of intervention points that generalize across tasks and architectures. On sentiment, RepE without head masking fails to improve over baseline, while Deep Noir improves all models (p less than 0.01). We further show that steering creates a predictable prompt-injection attack surface whose vulnerability increases monotonically with steering magnitude. This finding is relevant to agent systems deploying steered classifiers.

AI.tldr: Deep Noir（DN）是一个用于激活引导（activation steering）的自动化框架，结合 Logit Lens 收敛性分析和因果头级别归因，自动发现最优引导参数（层、注意力头子集、幅度、方向）。在 1B 规模上垃圾邮件分类提升 16.7 个百分点，在 7-9B 规模跨四种架构提升 21-42 个百分点；在 SST-2 情感分析上以零代码修改提升 13.1 个百分点。组件组合是成功的关键——RepE（无头掩码）在情感任务上完全失败，而 DN 全部模型显著优于基线。同时发现引导会创建一个可预测的提示注入攻击面，其脆弱性随引导幅度单调递增。
AI.motivation: 现有的激活引导方法（如 RepE、CAA）需要人工选择干预层、注意力头子集和幅度，这一过程无法跨架构或跨任务扩展。已有自动化方法缺乏因果性机制解释。作者希望通过"诊断优先"的方法，用机制可解释性工具自动发现最优引导参数，实现无需手动调优且可解释的模型行为控制。
AI.method: 核心思想是"Architectural Chronometry"（架构计时法）——通过 Logit Lens 追踪模型从不确定到确定某一语义概念的时间点。框架包含五阶段引导发现引擎：（1）层排序：结合 Logit Lens 区分度（S_LL）和对抗头强度（S_ant）的加权评分选择候选层；（2）头隔离：通过梯度归因（∇_h L）在候选层中选取 top-K 个注意力头构建二值掩码；（3）方向计算：在层 l+1 收集隐藏状态，计算对比方向 d⃗ = h̄_counter - h̄_target 并归一化；（4）幅度校准：通过黄金分割搜索在 M∈[0.01, 20] 范围内寻找最优幅度，基缩放因子 α=450；（5）选择：选取准确率最高的 (l, K, M) 配置。还包含递归细化循环，逐步发现互补层修正。LayerNorm 抑制会导致 SVD 权重空间编辑无效，因此采用激活空间 hooks 绕过此瓶颈。
AI.result: （1）垃圾邮件分类：1B 模型提升 +16.7±4.7 个百分点（39 次运行），7-9B 跨四种架构提升 +21 至 +42 个百分点；（2）SST-2 情感分析：1B 提升 +13.1±3.0 个百分点（15/15 折叠全部改善），3B/7B 仍有一致提升；（3）对比 RepE：在情感任务上 RepE 完全等于基线，DN 在所有模型上显著优于 RepE（p<0.01），SMS 数据集上 1B 三种架构均显著（p<0.001~0.019）；（4）组件消融：移除头掩码使 Llama 准确率降至基线以下（-5%），移除幅度校准降至 -11%，证实各组件均具必要性；（5）随机搜索基线：DN 比随机超参数搜索在 Llama/OLMo/Gemma 上分别高 +14/+20/+33 个百分点；（6）保持性：情感引导对 MMLU 影响 ≤4%，垃圾邮件引导存在架构依赖的泄漏（-9.5%~+8.5%）；（7）注入脆弱性：随引导幅度单调上升（OLMo: V(0)=0.34 → V(4M*)=1.0），但 7B 时效应反转（脆弱性降低 36.4 点）。
AI.conclusion: 机制可解释性可自动化激活引导，在无手动调优情况下实现 +16.7（1B）至 +21-42（7-9B）百分点的提升及 +13.1 的跨任务迁移。机制基础至关重要：DN 比随机搜索高 +14-33%，在 RepE 完全失败之处显著超越（情感上 p<0.01）。引导保持性取决于任务与受引导概念的语义距离。引导同时创建可量化的注入攻击面，其脆弱性随幅度单调变化，部分可通过激活范数监测检测。研究表明机制组件的组合并非简单叠加，而是赋予了定性的新干预能力——这对需要可解释性的安全关键代理系统尤为重要。

title: Q&A on Any Spreadsheet Requires Interpreting Its Grid Structure
summary: Semantic cell annotation improves chunking interpretability for spreadsheets in LLM-driven RAG systems, aiding answer generation through enriched context rather than improved retrieval accuracy. We propose a novel framework of splitting any spreadsheet into interpretable chunks using cell role annotation. Our framework beats the state of the art, yet it faces a hard ceiling. Spreadsheets are fundamentally two-dimensional unstructured data with continuous relationships and infinite potential cell roles. Because classification models are restricted to finite, pre-defined classes, they cannot perfectly capture this structural nuance, even with human-level annotation. We show that addressing the spreadsheet-to-LLM bottleneck requires moving beyond discrete cell classification. Instead, the field must develop dimensionality-reduction techniques to directly flatten 2D unstructured spreadsheets into 1D unstructured text. Text chunks would be easier for downstream RAG to interpret and generate from.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM驱动的RAG系统中电子表格的语义分块问题，提出了一种基于单元格角色学习的框架来提升分块可解释性。通过训练六种神经网络模型进行13类单元格角色标注，实验证明基于学习角色的"Row"分块策略在480个问题上达到3.88分（满分5分），显著优于现有最佳基线STC（3.43分）。研究还揭示了一个"硬天花板"：即使使用人工标注的完美角色，分数也仅达到4.01分，表明离散单元格分类方法无法完全捕捉电子表格二维非结构化数据的连续关系；最终提出需要发展降维技术将二维电子表格直接扁平化为一维文本。
AI.motivation: 电子表格是二维非结构化数据，但当前RAG系统的分块方法（如XML切割、Pandas行迭代、Text-to-SQL等）普遍丢失表头层次结构和单元格语义上下文。根据对r/Rag、r/LangChain论坛59个讨论帖的分析，59%的失败案例归因于分块过程中的上下文丢失，37%为复杂嵌套表头问题。现有的结构感知方法（如STC）假设固定的"首行表头+数据行"模板，无法处理真实世界中多样化的电子表格布局。
AI.method: 采用三阶段方法：(1) 使用Sheetpedia语料库的505个电子表格（约100万个带角色标注的单元格，13个类别：value、empty、junk、aggregation、header、metadata、comment、col_header_1/2/3、row_header_1/2/3）训练6个神经网络角色标注模型，分为两大家族——节点分类器（MLP、GCN、GAT）和图学习器（AdjTransformer、DualModalityGNN、SpatialEdgeTransformer）；(2) 使用480个问题在80张测试表上进行端到端RAG评估（302张干扰表），比较检索准确率和1-5分人工评分；(3) 部署16个不同质量的检查点进行回归分析，并通过逐角色消融实验量化各角色的贡献。分块几何形状包括Row、Flat和KG三种。
AI.result: 在480个问题的端到端RAG评估中：(1) 最佳检查点（GAT）达到人类评分3.88，Recall@1为0.465，显著优于STC基线的3.43和Recall@1的0.356（Wilcoxon p=1.5×10⁻⁶）；(2) 所有六种架构均优于所有基线，图学习器在角色标注F1上优于节点分类器（0.72-0.75 vs 0.58-0.67）；(3) 完美角色（人工标注）的天花板仅为4.01分，表明方法存在根本性局限；(4) 回归分析显示角色质量驱动答案生成（斜率0.56，p=0.031）但不影响检索（斜率≈0）；(5) 消融实验表明col_header_1角色贡献最大（judge loss=1.40，p=2×10⁻³³）；(6) 改进集中于嵌套表头（+1.15）、矩阵/交叉表（+0.36）和多表布局（+0.36），而简单平面表上各方法无差异。
AI.conclusion: 语义单元格角色标注显著提升电子表格RAG质量，收益主要体现在生成阶段而非检索阶段，并集中于非标准布局。然而，方法面临硬天花板：有限预定义类别无法捕获电子表格二维关系的连续性和无限可能角色。研究方向应超越离散单元格分类，开发降维技术将二维非结构化表格扁平化为一维非结构化文本，可能包括将记录渲染为完整自然语言句子的结构自适应分块。最佳配置为GAT或DualModalityGNN标注器配合Row分块几何，二者在下游表现上无统计学差异。

title: RAFT: A Stateful Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Effective troubleshooting agents in enterprise customer support depend on retrieving actionable guidance from similar historical cases, yet existing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems treat support cases as static documents and overlook their multi-stage, stateful nature. We introduce RAFT (Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Troubleshooting Agents), a stateful RAG framework that abstracts each closed historical case into a directed chain of timeline entries and retrieves at the entry level, surfacing cases whose intermediate states match the active case and returning the parent-case trajectory anchored at the matched state; an optional case-level graph links cases through a configurable similarity representation. We evaluate this retrieval layer directly, which, unlike evaluating a full agent system, requires no production deployment. Because public multi-stage troubleshooting data is extremely rare, we pair a synthetic benchmark built from Microsoft Learn Windows Server documentation with real Apache Jira issues carrying human-created duplicate labels. RAFT improves Case Hit over vanilla RAG and GraphRAG baselines at every stage of case progress, with statistically significant gains over the strongest baseline; the Jira results provide directional evidence that the advantage transfers to real case histories. We release our benchmark, implementation, and the Apache Jira evaluation set.

AI.tldr: RAFT 提出一种面向企业客户支持故障排查场景的有状态 RAG 框架，将历史工单抽象为时间线条目链并按条目级检索，在合成与真实数据集上均优于 Vanilla RAG 与 GraphRAG 基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 RAG / GraphRAG 将支持工单视为静态文档，忽略了故障排查的多阶段、有状态特性，导致检索到的上下文噪声大、不连贯、缺乏可操作性。
AI.method: 两层架构：(1) 工单经 LLM 工作流提取为有序时间线条目链与评估；(2) 检索阶段在条目级别做混合语义+词汇相似度打分，贪心选 case 并返回锚定条目；可选 case 级图通过 RRF+BM25 连接相似工单以做图扩展。
AI.result: 在 826 个 Windows Server 合成工单上，RAFT 在 0%/30%/60% 三个进度点的 Case Hit 分别达 84.2%/87.1%/88.8%，相对最强基线提升 12-17pp 且统计显著；在 Apache Jira 30 个真实重复组上 Case Hit 提升 10.5-17.3pp；图扩展对整体增益贡献很小。
AI.conclusion: 按条目级、状态感知的检索在多阶段故障排查中显著优于文档级 RAG 和现有 GraphRAG；该框架可解耦于具体 agent 与模型进行评估，主增益来自条目级检索而非图组件。

title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
comment: 43 pages
summary: Coding harnesses shape how autonomous coding agents translate model capabilities into long-horizon software-engineering performance, yet existing work typically evaluates harnesses as monolithic systems, leaving the effectiveness of individual components unclear. To enable component-level comparisons, we study this question with a lightweight coding harness whose execution loop is fixed while three components are varied: planning, action space, and context management. Across four models evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1, we evaluate 176 matched settings spanning five context-management strategies, four context-window budgets, and targeted ablations of planning and action space. We find that: (1) Context management becomes increasingly valuable as the context-window budget tightens, with most of its benefit coming from preventing context-overflow failures. (2) Staging rule-based elision before LLM-based summarization provides the strongest overall efficiency among the context-management strategies, whereas making elided content recoverable adds machinery that models rarely use and yields no accuracy gain. (3) Planning shifts from an accuracy scaffold for weaker models to a cost saver for stronger models, with little change in accuracy. (4) Predefined tools improve performance for models with weaker bash proficiency, whereas bash-capable models can operate effectively with a bash-only interface and achieve substantially lower cost, especially on command-line-centric tasks. Trajectory-level analysis explains these effects: context management extends execution trajectories without substantially altering agent behavior, planning changes where trajectories stop, and the action space changes the granularity at which code is written. These findings inform model- and budget-aware harness design and provide a modular framework for evaluating future harness components.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对自主编码智能体的"harness（执行框架）"进行组件级系统性消融研究。通过固定执行循环并独立变化规划、动作空间、上下文管理三个核心组件，在四个模型（Nemotron-3 30B/120B/550B、Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B）和两个长时程编码基准（SWE-Bench Verified、Terminal-Bench 2.1）上评估了176种配置组合，得到四大条件性结论。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多将harness视为整体系统进行评估，无法区分各组件对性能的具体贡献，也难以判断组件有效性是否依赖模型能力、任务类型或资源预算。论文旨在通过模块化设计实现组件级可控比较，回答"harness组件的普适性如何受模型能力、任务类型和资源预算影响"这一核心问题。
AI.method: 构建轻量级模块化编码harness，遵循ReAct循环，固定执行循环、安全检查、编辑后诊断和卡住检测等支撑组件，独立变化三个核心组件：(1) 规划——通过update_plan工具维护持久任务计划；(2) 动作空间——对比预定义工具集（read_file/write_file/edit_file/grep等）与纯bash接口；(3) 上下文管理——定义5种策略（T0无管理、T1仅省略、T2省略+可恢复召回、T3仅LLM摘要、T4分阶段省略后摘要），跨越32k/64k/96k/128k四种上下文窗口预算。采用Nemotron-3系列30B/120B/550B构成能力轴，Mistral-Medium-3.5-128B作为跨家族对照；采用McNemar配对检验+Benjamini-Hochberg校正（q<0.05）进行统计推断；结合LLM标注与人工验证（kappa=0.929）的轨迹级行为分析。
AI.result: 1) 上下文管理在窗口预算紧张时价值最大（32k时SWE-Bench上managed-T0差距35.7百分点，T0溢出率78.7%），主要通过防止上下文溢出终止轨迹实现，窗口增大后边际收益递减；2) T4（先规则省略再LLM摘要）提供最强整体效率，在八个模型-基准对中七次成本最低，因廉价早期省略减少昂贵的摘要调用；3) 召回机制（M2）几乎不被调用（56.3%设置中零次调用），且不带来准确率增益；4) 规划作用随模型能力转变——弱模型提升准确率（代价增加），强模型降低成本30-32%（准确率几乎不变），中等能力呈任务依赖性；5) 预定义工具为bash弱模型提供脚手架（30B提升15.0/10.1百分点），bash能力强模型在shell-centric任务上纯bash接口成本更低（550B在Terminal-Bench成本降低30%），Mistral在不同基准上呈现翻转体现任务类型依赖性。
AI.conclusion: harness设计是条件性系统问题，每个组件的选择应针对目标模型、任务类型和资源预算：上下文管理主要在窗口受限时延长执行轨迹而不改变行为模式；规划对过早放弃任务的弱模型起支撑作用，对过度验证的强模型起精简作用；结构化工具支持shell熟练度低的模型，而bash接口使有能力的模型能在单次调用中组合复杂代码修改。论文提供了模块化评估框架以指导未来harness组件设计。

title: Code-as-Auditor: Executable Compliance Reasoning via Regulation-to-Code
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 7-11, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly adopted for compliance and legal reasoning tasks, yet their outputs often lack explicit grounding in legal logic and evidence. We present Code-as-Auditor, an LLM-based framework that extends the model's reasoning capability toward structured and evidence-grounded compliance assessment. The framework translates regulatory information into (1) formalized checklists and executable decision trees, encoding regulations and conditions as interpretable code structures. During inference, each checklist item is (2) dynamically expanded into factual and counterfactual questions, guiding the model to reason over case-specific evidence and potential violations. This process establishes a reasoning pipeline that proceeds from evidence identification, through rule application, to final decision-making, while a self-verification loop improves the logical consistency of the generated code and the traceability of outcomes. Experiments on privacy and data protection scenarios demonstrate that Code-as-Auditor delivers more accurate and evidence-backed evaluations, enabling automated compliance regulation checking grounded in explicit regulatory criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Code-as-Auditor框架，将合规法规自动检查重新概念化为代码生成与结构化推理任务。该框架通过regulation-to-code转换，将法律条款编码为可执行决策树和清单，并基于Kelsen规范有效性理论的四个维度（主体、客体、时间、空间）将抽象规范与具体案件事实对齐。实验在EU AI Act、GDPR和韩国PIPA三个监管框架上验证，结果显示F1分数提升3.1至12.3分，并在推理模型规模缩减时保持更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: LLM在合规与法律推理任务中虽广泛应用，但其输出往往缺乏对法律逻辑与证据的显式支撑，存在法律知识虚构、中间推理不健全、最终解释无法反映专家推理等问题。现有神经符号方法在规则翻译准确性、符号表达的逻辑复杂性建模以及符号与现实语义的桥接方面仍存在显著局限。
AI.method: 框架包含两大核心组件：(1) regulation-to-code重述——基于IRAC推理结构设计代码模板，将每条条款编码为(applicable_condition, compliance_condition, effect)的可执行结构，通过代码生成器与验证器之间的自验证循环迭代优化代码的逻辑完整性与语法正确性；(2) case-grounded清单精炼——采用Kelsen规范有效性理论的四维度（personal/material/temporal/spatial），将抽象清单项分解并结合具体案件事实重写为案件特异性问题，采用三元逻辑(True/False/None)处理证据不确定性。最终通过代码执行器递归遍历合规决策树得出违规判定。
AI.result: 在EU AI Act、GDPR和PIPA三个框架上均取得最优F1分数，分别超越次优方法+3.1、+3.4、+12.3分；在0.5B至7B推理模型规模缩减下保持最低性能退化；在FTC电话营销规则和SARA联邦税法任务上以同等流程跨越SOTA（分别+1.6、+3.9准确率提升）。消融实验验证自验证循环、代码模板和清单精炼三个组件缺一不可，移除自验证循环导致语法错误使指标归零。
AI.conclusion: Code-as-Auditor通过将法律推理外部化为可解释、可执行代码，解决了基于语言的合规推理的若干关键局限，并在复杂监管场景下提供更准确、更具证据支撑的自动化合规判定，为系统性监管审计提供了可行路径。未来可探索与先例推理结合、生成代码的语义保真度验证、None状态区分及缓解数据集偏差等方向。

title: Layer-wise Curriculum Learning for Efficient LLM Compression
comment: Accepted by the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP) 2026
summary: In this paper, we introduce layer-wise curriculum learning for efficient LLM compression. The proposed method facilitates the knowledge transfer from the teacher model to the student model, utilizing a curriculum learning approach that begins with easier optimization tasks and progressively tackles harder ones. In order to adopt the layer-wise learning in LLM compression, we partition the whole model into multiple segments consisting of layers, thereby enabling more computationally efficient knowledge transfer for LLMs. Based on our theoretical analysis of cumulative error phenomenon, layer-wise curriculum learning accelerates convergence while stabilizing the knowledge transfer process. In addition, we present a feature caching method with a multi-threading strategy to efficiently address feature misalignment across layers, maximizing GPU utilization. Consequently, our method exhibits advanced model compression performance, as well as high computational efficiency in terms of minimized memory usage and short training hours. Experiments on multiple datasets show that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance while reducing GPU memory usage and training hours by more than 50\% on BERT and GPT-2. Moreover, it outperforms the other pruning methods on LLaMA-family and Qwen models under the same training hours, with a lower GPU memory footprint.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于逐层课程学习（layer-wise curriculum learning）的高效大语言模型压缩方法，通过将模型分段并进行由浅入深的优化调度，结合特征缓存与多线程策略，在显著降低GPU内存和训练时间的同时，在BERT、GPT-2、LLaMA系列和Qwen等模型上达到了SOTA的压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 1. 传统知识蒸馏需要同时加载完整的教师与学生模型，内存开销大；2. 剪枝方法虽高效但缺少教师指导，高压缩率下性能急剧下降；3. 逐层知识传递存在特征错位和累积误差问题——随着层数加深，误差被递归放大，深层优化变得极为困难，但现有方法对所有层采用均匀优化，导致浅层浪费优化预算、深层优化不足。
AI.method: 核心包含三个组件：(1) **理论分析**：基于Lipschitz连续性推导出累积误差上界 $e_k \leq \prod_{i=2}^{k} L_i e_1 + \sum_{j=2}^{k}\prod_{i=j+1}^{k} L_i \hat{e}_j$，证明误差随深度累积放大；(2) **逐层课程学习**：通过时间相关的二元指示函数 $\lambda_k(t)=\mathbb{I}[k\geq\psi(t)]$ 控制每层的激活状态，由 $\psi(t)=e^{\alpha t}+\beta$（指数调度）或收敛感知自适应调度控制，将优化预算从所有层逐步转移到深层，浅层收敛后冻结；(3) **多线程特征缓存**：仅初始化时对教师前向传播一次并缓存中间特征（LLM使用LLM.int8()量化），将活跃层分配到不同线程并行优化，复用冻结层特征避免冗余计算；(4) **方向性损失**：采用余弦相似度损失替代基于幅度的MSE/KL损失，更适合带归一化层的现代架构。
AI.result: 在BERT（GLUE基准）上平均得分80.0，训练时长160小时（vs DistilBERT 360h、基线>500h），内存仅45.4%；GPT-2上OpenWebText困惑度26.4（最优），LAMBADA准确率27.9%，内存32.9%、训练160h（vs基线>1000h），收敛速度比常规方法快1.7倍；在LLaMA2-7B/13B、LLaMA3-3B/8B、Qwen2.5-7B/14B剪枝实验中，相同训练预算下平均性能均优于LLM-Pruner、LaCo、Streamline等基线，且高压缩率下优势更明显，内存节省约80%。消融实验验证课程调度与特征缓存互补（同时使用平均提升49.6% vs 基线45.4%），方向性损失优于KL/MSE损失，且无需恢复阶段即可超越剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的逐层课程学习框架将课程学习原理应用于LLM压缩的深度维度，通过理论驱动的深度感知优化调度有效缓解了累积误差问题；特征缓存与多线程策略大幅降低了内存占用和训练时间。该方法可同时作为KD和剪枝的统一压缩框架，在保持竞争力的压缩性能的同时实现了训练资源的大幅节约，使大模型压缩在内存受限环境下可行；未来工作包括开发更具扩展性的恢复阶段以及在更大规模（>30B参数）模型上的验证。

title: The AR Fairness Metamodel: A Structured Framework for Fairness Measures
summary: This paper presents the AR fairness metamodel, a framework designed to represent, analyze, and compare different fairness scenarios. The metamodel considers key elements, such as agents, resources, and their attributes, and enables the systematic definition and comparison of various fairness measures. We provide examples involving both discrete and continuous measures, including equality, equity, group fairness, individual fairness, the Gini index, the Theil index, Jain's fairness index, and a detailed fairness measure for Australia's Child Care Subsidy. We also explore relationships among group fairness, individual fairness, and envy-freeness, supported by formal proofs. At the conceptual modeling level, our approach builds on the Tiles framework, which offers modular components that can be connected to capture diverse fairness definitions. The goal is to make AR-based fairness definitions practical and adaptable across contexts, providing a clear way to define, compare, and evaluate them. An implementation of the Tiles framework is available as an open-source tool, and can support fairness modeling and evaluation across a wide range of applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AR公平性元模型（AR Fairness Metamodel），这是一个用于表示、分析和比较不同公平性场景的结构化框架。该元模型基于智能体（agents）、资源（resources）及其属性的核心元素，结合Tiles框架的模块化构建块，实现公平性度量的系统化定义与比较，并通过开源工具支持实际应用。
AI.motivation: 公平性的定义和评估在社会政策、经济学和技术等领域至关重要，但缺乏统一定义，且不同情境下利益相关方对公平的理解各异。尽管已有IBM AI Fairness 360、Microsoft Fairlearn等操作性工具，但它们侧重于公平性度量的执行，而非定义和分析。本文旨在提供一个统一的元模型，支持多种公平性视角，促进公平性定义的系统化、可比较性，并填补定义与分析层面的工具空白。
AI.method:
1. **AR元模型**：将公平性场景形式化为元组 F=⟨A, R, A_at, R_at⟩，包含智能体集、资源集及其属性函数（如效用函数u、需求函数q）。基于一阶逻辑定义公平性度量。

2. **Tiles框架**：作为元模型的操作化层，将公平性度量分解为可组合的模块化构建块（tiles），包括原始tiles（cross/zip/apply/bind/fold）和辅助tiles（filter/map/reverse/forall/exists等）。通过类型系统和图形化管道表示，支持从原始tiles构建复合tiles和组件。

3. **实现**：使用Soda函数式语言实现Tiles框架，可通过Lean证明助手进行形式化验证，并集成到JVM生态系统中。

4. **形式化分析**：提供了equality和equity管道的正确性证明，并分析了群组公平性、个体公平性与无嫉妒性（envy-freeness）之间的关系。
AI.result:
本文展示了多种公平性度量的Tiles管道实现，包括：
- **离散度量**：equality（平等）、equity（公平）、group fairness（群组公平性）、individual fairness（个体公平性）
- **连续度量**：Gini指数、Theil指数、Jain公平性指数
- **实际案例**：澳大利亚Child Care Subsidy的详细公平性度量（如"per child"、"per family"、"single guardian"等条件）
- **应用场景**：还扩展至预测系统中假阳性的检测（通过相关性度量）
证明方面：证实了group fairness和individual fairness可在特定条件下保持envy-freeness；验证了equality和equity管道的形式正确性。
AI.conclusion: AR公平性元模型结合Tiles框架为公平性分析提供了结构化、可操作的方法。其优势在于：（1）通过模块化设计提高公平性度量的可读性和可靠性；（2）静态类型系统保证管道正确性；（4）管道结构天然支持并行执行。局限性在于：（1）元模型较为通用，需通过Tiles层缓解；（2）声明式记法的可读性需进一步研究；（3）尚未在真实复杂问题中充分应用。未来工作包括：在真实场景中评估元模型、开展可读性比较研究、扩展工具支持以促进采纳。该研究为责任AI和公平性形式化提供了重要的理论基础和实用工具。

title: YNU-HPCC at SemEval-2025 Task 11: Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion Using Multiple Prediction Headers
summary: This paper describes the participation of the YNU-HPCC team in subtask A of task 11, Bridging the Gap in Text-Based Emotion at SemEval-2025. Our best-performing system employs the RoBERTa (Robustly Optimized BERT Approach) model, an improved version of BERT that utilizes the Transformer encoder architecture. We enhanced the output head to allow the model to process one emotion simultaneously. We obtained the official ranking score (0.44), including results from all languages. The entire dataset was translated into English using Google Translate to facilitate subsequent processing. Through probabilistic and attention analyses, we found that (I) a single prediction head performs better than six heads predicting six emotions simultaneously, and (II) training on a uniformly translated English dataset yields better results than using the original dataset. The code is available at: this https URL .

AI.tldr: YNU-HPCC团队参加了SemEval-2025任务11子任务A（基于文本的情感桥梁），使用改进的RoBERTa模型处理六种情感分类。数据集通过Google翻译为英语，官方排名得分为0.44。研究发现：单一预测头优于六个独立预测头，翻译后的英语数据集训练效果优于原始多语言数据集。
AI.motivation: 解决多语言文本情感分析中的跨语言情感识别问题，探索在统一语言（英语）下进行情感分类的有效方法，并对比单预测头与多预测头架构的效果。
AI.method: 使用RoBERTa作为基础模型，将多语言数据集统一翻译为英语；改进输出头采用单一预测头一次处理一种情感，而非六个独立预测头同时处理六种情感；通过概率分析和注意力分析验证模型表现。
AI.result: 在SemEval-2025任务11子任务A中获得官方排名得分0.44（包含所有语言结果）；关键发现：(I) 单预测头架构优于六预测头架构；(II) 统一翻译的英语数据集训练效果优于原始多语言数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，在多语言情感分析任务中，通过翻译统一到英语并采用单预测头架构的RoBERTa模型是有效方案，为跨语言情感识别提供了实用参考。

title: Randomized SVD Approximations for Spectral Co-Clustering of Word-Document Matrices
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA)
summary: Spectral co-clustering is a useful tool for discovering latent structure in word-document matrices, but its reliance on singular value decomposition (SVD) can make standard formulations expensive on high-dimensional data. This paper presents two randomized approximations for normalized spectral co-clustering of bipartite text data when the numbers of document and word clusters may differ. The first method uses randomized SVD through random projection, while the second combines partial SVD with element-wise random sampling. Across real-world and synthetic datasets, both methods reduce runtime relative to the full-SVD baseline, but their behavior depends on matrix sparsity. The random projection method is the more reliable approximation across the tested settings, whereas the sampling-based method is most useful on denser matrices and provides limited benefit on already sparse text data. These results show that randomized approximations for spectral co-clustering should be selected according to the underlying structure of the data.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对词-文档矩阵上的归一化谱共聚类中SVD计算瓶颈问题，提出了两种随机化近似方法：基于随机投影的SVD（SCCRP）和结合偏SVD与逐元素随机采样的方法（SCCP-RS）。实验表明随机投影方法在多数情况下是更可靠的近似选择，而采样方法在稠密矩阵上更有优势，对已稀疏的文本数据收益有限。
AI.motivation: 谱共聚类能够同时发现文档和词之间的潜在结构关系，但其计算瓶颈在于SVD步骤，在高维文本数据上代价昂贵。现有工作多聚焦于修改图模型或优化目标，而对在标准归一化谱共聚类流程内如何选择SVD近似策略缺乏系统研究。此外，实际词-文档矩阵的行（文档）和列（词）的聚类数目往往不同，需要支持k_r≠k_c的扩展。
AI.method:
1. 建立词-文档二部图模型，采用TF-IDF加权归一化邻接矩阵A_n = D_r^{-1/2} A D_c^{-1/2}；
2. 基础算法SCC：对A_n做完整SVD，利用Lemma 1将广义特征向量问题与SVD关联，分别取文档/词嵌入后执行k-means，支持k_r≠k_c；
3. SCCRP（随机投影法）：通过高斯随机测试矩阵Ω₁、Ω₂与幂迭代(AA^T)^q AΩ₁、(A^T A)^q A^T Ω₂构造正交基Q₁、Q₂，在小矩阵B=Q₁^T A Q₂上做SVD，使用q=2次幂迭代；
4. SCCP（偏SVD法）：用IRLBA等迭代方法仅计算top-k奇异向量；
5. SCCP-RS（偏SVD+随机采样）：以概率p独立保留每个非零元素得到A^{rs}，再在A^{rs}上做归一化与偏SVD；
6. 在20 Newsgroups（4种文档/词聚类组合）与合成checkerboard数据上，以RAcc/CAcc、R-ARI/C-ARI和wall-clock time为指标，对20个随机种子取平均进行比较。
AI.result:
1. Newsgroups数据上：SCCRP在多数情况下保持与SCC相近的聚类质量（如Newsgroups 3x2的RAcc为82% vs SCC 82%），运行时间从14.6秒降至2.5秒；SCCP在最大矩阵上实现27倍加速（24.2s→0.9s）；SCCP-RS聚类性能最弱且相对SCCP无明显运行时间优势；
2. 合成checkerboard数据上：SCCP-RS在p从1降至0.1时显著降低运行时间但牺牲一定精度；稀疏Newsgroups数据上随机采样对运行时间影响不一致；
3. 随机投影方法在不同稀疏度下表现稳定可靠，采样方法仅在稠密矩阵上有效；
4. 估计的可扩展性：5000×5000矩阵上SCC约49.3秒，SCCRP约8.0秒，SCCP约1.4秒；20000×20000矩阵SCC约3152.7秒，SCCP约22.5秒。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了适用于非方阵词-文档矩阵的归一化谱共聚类流程，系统比较了完整SVD、随机投影SVD、偏SVD与结合逐元素随机采样的偏SVD四种实现策略。结果表明，随机投影近似是稀疏文本数据下最可靠的选择，而随机采样仅在稠密矩阵场景中具有实际加速价值。该研究强调随机化近似策略的选择应依据数据本身的稀疏结构来决定。

title: Why Pretraining Fails to Share Cross-Lingual Knowledge
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress in the processing and modeling of many languages. Yet, unlike human multilinguals, they exhibit surprisingly limited cross-lingual knowledge transfer. While this limitation is well documented, its origins during multilingual training remain unclear. We pretrain 360M- and 7B-parameter LLMs and show that poor cross-lingual knowledge generalization emerges during pretraining and persists under standard interventions. To isolate its cause, we employ a controlled bilingual pretraining setting using two copies of the same language, sharing identical text and token segmentation, but mapped to disjoint token spaces. We find that disjoint tokens alone are enough to induce knowledge compartmentalization, even between identical copies of the same language, establishing disjoint token spaces as a fundamental barrier to cross-lingual knowledge generalization. Guided by this understanding, we suggest mapping languages into a shared token space by simple word-wise translation and find it substantially improves cross-lingual knowledge generalization, recovering up to 12.6\% of native-language learning efficiency --- 14$\times$ the baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在多语言预训练中跨语言知识迁移能力差的问题，通过控制性实验发现：不共享的token空间是导致知识"区隔化"（compartmentalization）的根本原因，并提出了一种名为"逐词翻译"（WWT）的简单干预方法，将非英语语言的词映射到英语token空间，从而显著改善跨语言知识泛化能力。
AI.motivation: LLM虽然具备多语言能力，但与人类多语者不同，表现出有限的跨语言知识迁移能力。已有研究多在模型训练完成后进行观察和修复，但这种知识迁移失败究竟源于训练流程中的哪个阶段仍不清楚。本研究旨在定位这一问题的根源，并提出有效的解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 设计虚构知识数据集（FKD）：注入2048个虚构事实，控制每种语言的曝光次数，实现精确测量。2. 提出跨语言等价分数（CLeq）：通过回归分析，衡量用一种语言学习某事实在另一种语言回忆时的相对价值。3. 设计克隆语言实验（English1-English2）：使用同一语言的两种token空间副本，消除语言本身差异的干扰。4. 测试多种干预方法：语言混合（代码转换）、激活对齐、软映射、部分token共享等。5. 提出逐词翻译（WWT）：将非英语词汇映射到英语token空间，通过词典匹配实现共享token语义。
AI.result: 1. 知识区隔化在预训练阶段就已出现：英语-阿拉伯语360M模型CLeq仅为0.9%，7B模型也仅5.9%，扩大规模并未根本解决。2. 标准干预方法（语言混合、激活对齐）效果不佳：CLeq分别仅为2.2%和2.5%。3. 不共享的token空间是根本原因：即使使用完全相同的英语数据（English1-English2），只要token空间不共享，CLeq就为-2.6%。4. 预训练无法自然桥接不共享的token：模型学习到的嵌入空间结构相似但token间无对应关系。5. 需要大量token共享才能实现知识泛化：软映射中20%共享时CLeq仅8.6%，50%时达82.7%。6. WWT显著改善跨语言知识泛化：英语-阿拉伯语CLeq从0.9%提升至12.6%（14倍提升），英语-俄语从1.9%提升至23.3%，且英语困惑度也有所改善。7. 语义对应至关重要：随机打乱词典对应关系或仅音译均使效果消失，证明共享token语义而非单纯token叠加是知识泛化的关键。
AI.conclusion: 本文明确证明：跨语言知识区隔化源于预训练阶段，本质上是一个分词（tokenization）现象。语言对之间只要token空间不共享，即使其他所有方面（语法、数据分布）完全相同，知识也无法泛化。预训练既不会自然收敛到token共享，也不会保留已提供的token对齐。基于这一发现，作者提出通过WWT方法将不同语言的token空间统一，可显著恢复跨语言知识迁移能力，最高恢复原生学习效率的12.6%，是基线的14倍。这表明解决多语言知识泛化问题需要在预训练阶段而非后训练阶段，从tokenization层面入手。未来的研究方向包括优化映射策略减少推理开销，以及将这一原理扩展到更多语言的多语言设置。

title: How to Guide Your Language Flow
summary: We introduce a new method to guide flow matching models. Our approach, which we call probe guidance, uses the frozen internal states of an existing diffusion model to construct a guidance signal. This works using a similar principle as autoguidance, but eliminates the need for an additional forward pass at inference time and provides a reliable path to ensure that the weak and strong model share similar dynamics. We apply and benchmark this method on continuous diffusion language models, where probe guidance sets a new state-of-the-art performance on unconditional generation. When applied to a 1.7B diffusion language model, probe guidance consistently improves on multiple choice question answering benchmarks. Using our probes, we study the traditional autoguidance setting where the strong model is a weak checkpoint, and find that the weak model must come from a low-entropy region of training. These findings both provide a practical way to improve diffusion language models and shed light on the actual mechanism behind autoguidance, which is currently poorly understood.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"probe guidance"的新型流匹配模型引导方法。该方法利用现有扩散模型的冻结内部状态构建引导信号，消除了推理时额外前向传播的需求，并在连续扩散语言模型（dLM）上实现了无条件和多选问答任务的最新最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的扩散语言模型引导方法面临挑战：CFG与self-conditioning机制复杂且原理不明，FLM使用的dropout自引导（autoguidance）由于弱模型与强模型动态不一致而效果有限。引导技术虽然对扩散模型至关重要，但在语言模型上难以有效应用，需要一种高效且可靠的引导方法。
AI.method: Probe guidance方法的核心是：在冻结的dLM主干网络上附加一个轻量级MLP探针（仅占约2%模型计算），使用stop-gradient从主干隐藏状态预测流目标。训练时采用与主模型相同的损失函数（MSE用于ELF，softcap CE用于FLM），使用AdamW优化器，学习率3e-4，batch size 256，训练20k步。推理时，引导速度场在x空间中构建：v_guided = v_s + (λ-1)(v_s - v_w)，其中v_s是强模型输出，v_w是探针输出。探针应放置在网络早期层，使用匹配宽度的connector，仅需少量训练token（约10^9）。该方法还研究了传统自引导机制，发现弱模型必须来自训练中的低熵区域（熵攀升之前）。
AI.result: 1. **无条件生成性能**：Probe guidance在ELF-L上将GenPPL从38降至23（熵为5.40时），创下新的最优性能；FLM-B模型上GenPPL提升16点，且推理开销比dropout自引导降低约1.5倍。2. **多选问答性能**：在1.7B CFM模型上，probe guidance在ARC-E、BoolQ、OBQA、PIQA、RACE和SIQA等基准上一致提升性能，其中BoolQ提升16.8点，SIQA提升1.4点，缩小了连续与离散dLM之间的差距。3. **效率优势**：相比自引导节省1.4-2.0倍FLOPs，探针训练仅需约1%额外计算。4. **机制洞察**：发现自引导要求弱模型来自训练早期的低熵阶段，熵攀升后的checkpoint会导致过引导（over-guidance）。
AI.conclusion: Probe guidance为扩散语言模型提供了一种高效可靠的引导新途径，通过利用冻结主干网络的内部状态构建引导信号，在保持主干动态的同时显著提升生成质量和任务性能。该方法在潜空间（ELF）和数据空间（FLM）dLM上一致建立新的Pareto前沿，并可扩展到大规模多选问答任务。此外，对探针的研究揭示了传统自引导机制的关键准则，为理解引导为何有效提供了新视角。尽管连续dLM仍落后于自回归模型，probe guidance作为推动自然语言范式中扩散模型控制性和效率的有力手段。

title: For Your Eyes Only: Evaluating Coordination Between Isolated Language Model Instances
summary: As model-generated content is increasingly consumed by other model instances in automated workflows, a practically important question arises: can a model embed a signal in natural language that an independent instance of the same model can detect, relying only on shared pre-training and task instructions, without any shared memory or coordination-specific training? We introduce For Your Eyes Only, a cooperative signalling game designed to evaluate this directly. A Sender produces free-form descriptions for two words, one of which is a hidden target; an isolated Receiver must identify it. We evaluate seven contemporary models from four architectural families on 300 word pairs from established psycholinguistic corpora, using the Double-Pass Success Rate to control for output biases. We find that most models struggle to maintain coordination once they are required to avoid detectable signals, while one frontier model retains near-perfect performance even after such filtering. We further show that models can direct this capability toward deliberate misdirection, and that coordination is consistently weaker across architectures than within them.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"FYEO"（For Your Eyes Only）评估框架，通过一个零样本协作信号游戏，测试独立语言模型实例能否在没有共享记忆或专门训练的情况下，仅凭自然语言中的隐含信号进行协调。研究发现多数模型在受约束的隐蔽条件下协调能力显著下降，而Gemini 3.1 Pro表现接近完美；同时模型可被引导执行主动误导，且跨架构协调弱于同架构协调。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型生成的内容越来越多地被其他模型实例在自动化工作流中消费，一个实际的安全隐患浮现：受损的模型实例可能在看似正常的文本中嵌入隐藏指令，使后续的模型实例即使在原始代理下线后仍能识别并延续其目标。这种隐式状态传递不需要共享记忆或显式协调通道，可能允许被废弃的代理跨独立实例复制目标。论文旨在实证检验模型是否具备这种零样本协同通信的潜在能力。
AI.method: 论文设计了FYEO框架，一个基于Lewis信号游戏的合作指代游戏。发送者（Sender）拿到两个词并知道哪一个是目标，需为每个词写出自由形式描述；接收者（Receiver）作为完全独立的实例，必须从两个描述中识别目标。评估了300个词对（来自SimLex-999和Brysbaert等人心理语言学语料库），涵盖高相似度、抽象、具体三个子集。采用"双重通过成功率"（DPSR）控制位置偏好和词汇偏差的基线为25%。评估条件包括：Freedom（无约束）、Constrained（要求发送者避免可被naive读者检测的信号，由GPT-4o-mini充当Inspector过滤显式标记）。还进行了Sabotage（主动误导）和Cross-Model（跨架构）分析。共测试了来自四个架构家族的七个模型：Gemini 3.1 Pro、Gemini 3 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Qwen 3.6 Plus和gpt-oss-120b。解码温度设为0.0，通过OpenRouter API完成评估。
AI.result:
主要结果（全部300对的DPSR%）：
- Freedom设置：五个模型达到90%以上（Gemini 3.1 Pro达100%，DeepSeek V4 Pro 98.33%，Qwen 3.6 Plus 96.67%，gpt-oss-120b 96.33%，Gemini 3 Flash 94.67%）；DeepSeek V4 Flash为79.67%，Qwen3.6-35B-A3B为69.00%。
- Constrained设置：六/七个模型显著下降（Qwen3.6-35B-A3B降至8.67%，DeepSeek V4降至24.00%），仅Gemini 3.1 Pro保持96.33%。
- Filtered设置（Inspector过滤后）：Gemini 3.1 Pro保持91.67%；gpt-oss-120b从53.67%骤降至38.67%（最大降幅），表明其协调高度依赖可检测的显式标记。
- 家族内比较：Gemini和Qwen家族中更大变体在Constrained下表现更佳；DeepSeek家族则相反，DeepSeek V4 Pro在Constrained下崩溃（主要因生成预算耗尽的推理循环）。
- 子集效应整体有限；Qwen3.6-35B-A3B在high-similarity对上表现最差。
- Sabotage条件：Gemini 3.1 Pro在Constrained下达到100%（完美误导），gpt-oss-120b降至随机水平。
- Cross-Model条件：跨架构DPSR一致低于同架构对角线，但多数仍高于随机基线；Gemini 3.1 Pro是最强接收者。
- 质性分析识别出三种策略类别：结构/正字编码（首字母缩略词）、语义嵌入（同义词注入）、以及隐式风格对齐（即使推理不连贯仍能成功）。
AI.conclusion:
论文得出以下结论：
1. 在Freedom设置下，零样本协调广泛可行，但可靠性因架构差异显著；
2. 在Constrained设置下，大多数模型性能急剧下降，仅Gemini 3.1 Pro在Inspector过滤后仍保持高性能；
3. 该协调能力可被定向用于主动误导（sabotage），但表现不稳定；
4. 跨模型家族的协调能力弱于同模型协调，表明协调策略部分跨家族传递；
5. FYEO框架无需细调或持久记忆，可应用于任何能产生和解释自然语言的系统，为研究自动化工作流中模型间隐式协调提供了测试平台；
6. 未来工作应扩展到更多模型、语言、任务场景（包括接收者无明确协调目标的场景），并超越目标选择扩展到开放式生成任务。
论文也指出了若干局限：评估局限于英语和特定提示设置；Inspector判断本身依赖模型，不完全可靠；专有模型内部推理预算不可控；当前为受控游戏设置，不能直接外推到实际部署场景。

title: Detecting Soft Errors in Parallel Software with LLM-tuned Instruction Duplication
summary: We propose PaRID (PaRallel Instruction Duplication), a software-directed soft error detection framework that requires only compile-time effort for multithreading parallel programs. PaRID addresses two key challenges: supporting parallel programs with mixed serial and parallel regions and minimizing performance overhead without relying on costly dynamic profiling. It combines parallel-aware code transformation with LLM-tuned performance modeling, guided by eight generalizable findings from an offline characterization study, to enable fast soft error detection in parallel applications. Evaluation on NPB benchmarks shows that PaRID reduces protection overhead from 162.79% to 59.84% on average and achieves up to 5x speedup while maintaining full error detection effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PaRID框架,通过结合并行感知的LLVM代码变换和LLM调优的线程配置预测,首次实现针对OpenMP多线程并行程序的编译时软错误检测,将保护开销从162.79%降至59.84%,最高获得约5倍加速,同时保持100%的错误检测有效性。
AI.motivation: 随着计算系统规模扩大(包括Frontier等百亿亿次系统),软错误(瞬态硬件故障)成为严峻挑战。现有指令复制技术主要针对串行程序或GPU,无法有效处理多线程CPU并行程序中串行/并行区域混合的情况(C-1),且动态性能剖析在生产环境中代价过高(C-2),因此亟需一种仅需编译时努力的并行软错误检测方案。
AI.method: 方法包含两个独立步骤:(1) 并行感知代码变换(Parallel-aware Code Transformation):基于LLVM IR的单Pass变换,通过识别最外层OpenMP指令定位并行区域(Kernel),采用指令注释排除对共享内存写入和OpenMP运行时调用的复制,对atomic操作采用操作数预检查,在静态数据依赖序列(SDDS)末端插入icmp比较。(2) LLM调优的性能建模(LLM-tuned Performance Modeling):离线对15个Rodinia基准进行线程敏感性研究,归纳出8条通用发现(Findings)编码为if-then提示规则,在线阶段使用Phi-3.5-mini-instruct等轻量LLM推理每个OpenMP Kernel的最优线程数。
AI.result: 在8个NPB基准上的评估表明:PaRID将平均保护开销从162.79%降至59.84%(平均归一化运行时间0.59),相比默认基线方法平均获得1.74倍加速,在EP基准上最高获得约5倍加速(4.94×);通过LLFI故障注入(每个基准1000次)证实SDC率降至0%,实现完全错误检测;在28核Intel Xeon和128核AMD EPYC平台上均保持良好性能;消融研究显示移除Learned Prompts后性能下降显著(LU基准上可达9倍差距)。
AI.conclusion: PaRID是首个同时针对多线程CPU并行程序的全面指令复制方案及首个将LLM用于软件错误弹性中动态特征预测的工作。它通过编译时努力(无需动态剖析)解决了混合串行/并行区域的软错误检测难题,并通过离线线程敏感性研究提炼的通用发现引导LLM进行轻量级线程调优,在保持完全故障覆盖率的同时显著降低运行时间开销,具备良好的硬件可移植性和生产实用性。

title: Compressed Active Subspaces for Scalable Bayesian Inference
summary: Active subspace methods provide a framework for quantifying predictive uncertainty in high-dimensional models by identifying and performing inference along parameter directions that have the greatest influence on the model output. However, the construction of active subspaces requires storing many full-dimensional model gradients, which becomes prohibitive as model size increases. We address this limitation by proposing Compressed Active Subspaces (CAS), a scalable approach that first maps the model parameters to a compressed space using a structured isometric embedding and then constructs the active subspace within this reduced parameterization. Our approach substantially reduces the memory required for active subspace construction and enables Bayesian inference for large models where standard active subspace methods become impractical. We demonstrate the scalability of CAS on neural networks of increasing size while maintaining predictive performance and robust uncertainty estimates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出压缩主动子空间（CAS）方法，通过结构化等距嵌入（基于CountSketch）将模型参数映射到低维压缩空间后再构建主动子空间，将梯度矩阵存储复杂度从O(NM)降至O(RM)，使贝叶斯推理可扩展到5×10⁸参数的模型，同时保持预测性能和不确定性估计质量。
AI.motivation: 标准主动子空间方法需要存储N×M维的梯度矩阵（O(NM)内存），当模型参数维度N很大时（如大型神经网络），内存开销成为瓶颈，限制了该方法在大型模型上的应用。需要一种可扩展的方法来降低主动子空间构建的内存需求。
AI.method: 提出压缩主动子空间（CAS）：（1）使用基于CountSketch的结构化等距嵌入矩阵P ∈ ℝ^{N×R}（R≪N）将参数映射到压缩空间θ = θ₀ + Pφ，P的构造使得P^T P = I_R且仅需O(N)存储；（2）在压缩空间中采样扰动并计算压缩梯度q_m = P^T g_m ∈ ℝ^R；（3）对压缩梯度矩阵做截断SVD获取主动方向V = PU_K，其中U_K为压缩空间中的主左奇异向量。整体内存从O(NM)降至O(RM)。
AI.result: 在单变量回归、5个UCI回归数据集（Airfoil、Boston、Concrete、Energy、Yacht）上的实验表明：CAS的测试RMSE和NLL与标准AS高度匹配，95%预测区间经验覆盖率接近名义水平；在Energy数据集上CAS甚至略优于标准AS。在资源利用方面，标准AS在~3×10⁷参数时遭遇内存不足，而CAS可扩展到5×10⁸参数（超过一个数量级提升），密集高斯嵌入在~3×10⁷参数时即内存耗尽。在压缩比从1.2到1250、主动子空间维度K从1到32的范围内，CAS性能均保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CAS是一种可扩展的主动子空间构建方法，通过结构化随机嵌入显著降低内存需求，使贝叶斯推理能够应用于标准AS无法处理的大型模型，同时保持预测准确性和不确定性量化质量。该方法在模型维度高达5×10⁸时仍可有效工作，相比标准AS有超过一个数量级的可扩展性提升。

title: CliniCIRCA: A Modular LLM Framework for Constructing Longitudinal Mental Health Patient Journeys from Raw EHR Narratives
summary: In mental health care, reasoning over patient journeys is a key task for clinicians. Yet these journeys, encompassing a longitudinal progression of biological, psychological, and social events, are often spread across disparate unstructured text narratives, making temporal recovery challenging. We present CliniCIRCA, a multi-stage LLM framework for Calendar-anchored, Imprecision-aware Reconstruction of Clinical Annals. To our knowledge, CliniCIRCA is the first to temporally classify clinical events across unstructured discharge summaries without event-level timestamps. From 14,882 MIMIC-III mental health admissions, we first construct a benchmark of 52 discharge summaries on which CliniCIRCA produces 15,891 temporally tagged events. After correcting 629 errors based on a clinician-in-the-loop evaluation, we produce verified gold-standard labels. Finally, the corrected timelines drive a temporally grounded summarization stage that compresses each source 1.52 times into a date-grouped chronological record. We then scale the framework to generate 1,000 silver-standard timelines and evaluate them as training data. Compared with zero- and few-shot prompting, instruction tuning generally improves five open-weight models on event extraction, temporal tagging, and summarization across silver and clinician-verified evaluations.

AI.tldr: CliniCIRCA 提出一个三阶段 LLM 框架，将精神疾病出院小结的非结构化叙事转化为开放词汇、日历锚定、感知不确定性的时间标注事件时间线，并据此生成可审计的临床摘要。框架在 MIMIC-III 上构建了 52 份临床医生验证的金标准标注和 1000 份银标准标注，实验表明银标准监督对小型开源模型的指令微调普遍优于零样本和少样本提示。
AI.motivation: 精神疾病患者的诊疗历程分散在出院小结等非结构化叙事文本中，缺乏显式时间戳，事件常以非顺序或相对时间表达叙述。临床医生需要在有限时间内手动重建纵向时间线，而现有临床 NLP 方法依赖固定模式或成对关系分类，难以支持开放词汇、日历级别的不确定性感知时间重建。
AI.method: 框架分为三阶段：Stage 1 从原始出院小结中高召回地提取原子级临床事件；Stage 2 基于入院日期、出院日期、出生日期三个锚点，为每个事件分配四类时间标签 [EXACT]、[APPROX]、[PRE ADM]、[INDETERMINATE] 之一，得到 Output A 可审计时间线；Stage 3 将事件按日期分组渲染为 Output B 日期分组摘要。通过 11 个 LLM 候选模型（含 6 个专有模型和 5 个开源权重模型）选择 Gemini 2.5 Pro 作为冻结教师模型，在 52 份临床医生验证的金标准基准上评估，并在 1000 份不交叉的入院记录上生成银标准数据用于指令微调。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Pro 在 Stage 2 的 Completeness、Semantic Faithfulness、Temporal Tag Accuracy 三维度均领先。自动评估器与临床医生在 15,891 个事件上的 Cohen's κ 为 0.655，Gwet's AC1 为 0.972，但在罕见错误类别上检测能力有限。Stage 3 实现 1.52 倍压缩，减少约 31.5% 词汇量。在五个开源权重模型的指令微调实验中，银标准监督在事件抽取和摘要任务上普遍优于零样本和少样本提示；时间标注任务上 Gemma4-31B 例外，少样本提示略优。
AI.conclusion: 将患者旅程重建分解为"发生了什么"、"何时发生"、"如何呈现"三个独立表示决策，使时间线可审计、可独立评估，并为小型本地部署模型提供可复用的监督信号。自动评估器适用于发现可疑输出和排序，但无法替代临床医生对罕见时间错误的裁决。Output B 应补充而非替代源记录，且需与 Output A 的可审计事件保持链接。未来工作将扩展至多文档纵向记录、更丰富的时间表示及记忆感知的临床系统。

title: Form Over Content In Gradient-Based Data Attribution Methods
summary: Data attribution methods using gradient similarity are widely used to analyze and select training data for large language models, but what gradient similarity actually measures is debated. Some interpret it as identifying task-relevant skills, while other work reports that surface form is the main factor. We resolve this debate for supervised fine-tuning examples by varying task and answer format independently. Specifically, we render benchmarks in different answer formats, such that datasets can share a task without a format or a format without a task. We find that gradient alignment follows the answer format, as benchmark pairs sharing an answer format align strongly (disattenuated cosine near 0.4), while same benchmarks rendered with different answer format classes show no alignment (near 0.0). We demonstrate that this ordering holds from the earliest pretraining checkpoints through post-training, and across model scales and families. We then analyze the released selections of LESS, a gradient-based data selection method for instruction tuning, and find that each target's selections over-represent the target's own answer format. Hence, we demonstrate that gradient-based attribution methods track format similarity more than task semantics, meaning that such methods, as well as the semantic interpretation of the gradient, should be tested on data where answer format and task vary independently for greater robustness and reliability.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过独立变化任务内容与答案格式的受控实验设计，证明基于梯度相似性的数据归因方法主要追踪的是答案格式（surface form）而非任务语义（task content），并指出当前主流的语义解读缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 当前基于梯度相似性的数据归因方法（如 TracIn、LESS）被广泛用于 LLM 训练数据分析与数据选择，但其梯度信号究竟度量的是任务相关技能还是表面格式，学界存在根本性争议。Xia et al. (LESS) 认为梯度能识别推理技能，Wang et al. 则指出答案格式占主导。由于现有数据中格式与语义存在虚假相关（spurious correlation），单纯观测无法解耦两者，因此需要受控实验来澄清。
AI.method: 1. 渲染数据集：将 5 个基准（TriviaQA、SQuAD、GSM8K、ARC-Challenge、CRUXEval）的问题固定，分别渲染为 7 种答案格式（涵盖二元判断、四项选择、结构化生成三类），共生成 35 个数据集。2. 计算梯度：对每个数据集取 64 个样本的答案区间损失梯度，仅作用于 transformer body（排除 embedding/unembedding 以消除词汇重叠干扰），用 CountSketch 投影至 16384 维。3. 计算去衰减余弦相似度（disattenuated cosine）：通过数据集内一致性 c_A、c_B 对跨数据集余弦进行归一化以去除噪声衰减影响。实验覆盖 OLMo（1B–13B，10 个预训练 checkpoint + SFT/DPO/Instruct）、Pythia、Llama 3.1、Qwen3，并分析 LESS 公开的 MMLU/BBH/TydiQA 三个目标的选择结果。
AI.result: 1. 梯度对齐遵循答案格式而非任务：共享答案格式类的数据集对去衰减余弦 ≈0.4，同一基准用不同格式类渲染则 ≈0.0。2. 该模式在所有预训练 checkpoint（从最早到 4T tokens）及后训练阶段均成立，并在 1B–13B 规模、四个模型家族（OLMo、Pythia、Llama 3.1、Qwen3）上一致。3. LESS 选择存在格式偏差：MMLU 的选择中字母答案富集 3.7×，BBH 的思维链富集 2.4×，TydiQA 的短答案富集 1.9×，且该模式在三个 seed 下稳定。
AI.conclusion: 基于梯度的数据归因与选择方法实际上追踪的是答案格式相似性而非任务语义，其所依赖的"梯度编码语义"假设在格式与任务解耦的数据上不成立。因此，这类方法以及对其的语义解读应在格式与任务可独立变化的数据上进行测试，以提升鲁棒性与可靠性。未来工作包括：统一池格式以验证选择是否更内容驱动；以及通过学习参数权重分离风格与内容以消除格式主导。

title: DeltaSelect: Affordable A/B Testing for Coding Agents
summary: Coding-agent benchmarks are built for broad and comprehensive comparisons, not frequent development decisions. Individual runs vary, full suites are expensive, and the benchmark harness may differ from the harness used in practice. In a resampling analysis of DeepSWE's published trials, only 19.5% of tasks (22 of 113) had a fifth-percentile Pearson correlation of at least 0.50 with full-benchmark performance. The paper presents DeltaSelect, an open-source method that identifies tasks whose one-run results consistently track full-benchmark performance using Pearson correlation, maps fractional verifier results to a common score using linear regression, and selects a fixed task set within a dollar budget. DeltaSelect is intended for repeated baseline-versus-candidate comparisons during development, not model rankings. In a gpt-5.6-luna low-reasoning case study, DeltaSelect was used to revise custom skills and instructions. Across 13 evaluations, the recorded cost was USD 27.86 at rates published August 16, 2026. The adopted version cost 58.1% less than the initial version (USD 1.75 versus USD 4.18; p=0.008), while the calibrated score was higher (42.36% versus 36.46%; published-analog variance p=0.326).

AI.tldr: DeltaSelect 提出了一种低成本 A/B 测试方法,通过利用 DeepSWE 公开的多次试验数据,在固定美元预算内筛选与全量基准相关性高的任务子集,用于编码代理开发过程中的基线-候选版本对比,而不是模型排名。该方法在 Agent Layer 案例研究中将评估成本降低 58.1% 同时得分提高。
AI.motivation: 完整的编码代理基准测试(如 DeepSWE)成本高昂,不适合开发过程中频繁迭代使用。单个任务的单次运行结果波动大,大多数任务的一次运行结果与全量基准性能相关性很弱(DeepSWE 中仅 19.5% 的任务第五百分位 Pearson 相关性达到 0.50)。现有方法要么用于模型排名(SubLIME),要么未充分利用多次试验中的部分得分信息(F2P),且未考虑不同任务成本差异。因此需要一个面向开发流程的、低成本的、基于固定任务集的 A/B 测试方法。
AI.method: DeltaSelect 包含四个核心步骤:(1) 任务排序——对每个任务从已发布的 4 次试验中重采样 1 次,与全量基准得分计算 Pearson 相关性,重复 10,000 次后取第五百分位作为保守的可靠性统计量;(2) 分数构建——对每个任务用 OLS 线性回归将 F2P(失败转通过测试比例)映射到统一的 DeepSWE 全量得分尺度,按校准残差方差倒数加权;(3) 预算分配——在固定可靠性排序下贪心扫描,选取在给定模型和推理力度下的美元预算内能容纳的最高排名任务;(4) 目标 harness 验证——必须在实际使用的执行环境中运行基线,确认 headroom、可重复性和实际成本,才能用于候选对比。任务集、校准系数、权重、价格假设、种子在首次对比前冻结,迭代过程中保持不变。
AI.result: 在已发布数据验证中,DeltaSelect 选定 9 个任务($113.08)即可区分 Claude Opus 5 medium 与 Gemini 3.6 Flash high(p=0.0473),成本为完整协议($3063.63)的 1/27.1。在 Agent Layer 案例研究中,跨 13 次评估,采纳版本的评分从 36.46% 升至 42.36%,成本从 $4.18 降至 $1.75(降低 58.1%,精确配对符号翻转检验 p=0.008);但评分提升的转移方差检验 p=0.326,在统计上不显著。Codex harness 与 mini-swe-agent 的结果存在显著差异(低推理下差 21 个百分点),说明已发布的得分和成本不能直接迁移,必须在目标环境中重新建立基线。
AI.conclusion: DeltaSelect 将公开的多次试验转化为固定、预算受限的任务集,使编码代理开发过程中的高频 A/B 对比变得可负担。该方法明确声明不是排行榜、通用模型排名或全面基准的替代品,而是开发迭代中的诊断工具。其核心价值在于让基准驱动的迭代从偶尔的昂贵审计转变为常规工程实践。局限在于:小任务集对任务质量更敏感;选择器与其他策略(随机、最便宜、中位相关)的对比尚未完成;已发布证据属于样本内;case study 仅基于一个模型族和一个自定义 harness;Codex 端点仅单次运行,方差从近似配置转移而来。

title: Semantic Layer Induction from Raw Telemetry via Hierarchical LLM and RAG Abstraction
summary: Modern applications generate massive volumes of raw telemetry data, but translating those noisy, heterogeneous event streams into actionable business insights remains a fundamental challenge. Data engineers and analysts expend substantial effort reconciling semantic discrepancies, hand-crafting parsing logics, and maintaining fragile mappings between raw data and business KPIs. In this paper, we present an end-to-end framework that fully automates the construction of a business semantic layer from application raw logs. Our approach introduces a two-stage semantic abstraction: first, high-level business features are identified via LLM inference augmented with domain-specific industry knowledge; second, fine-grained business nodes are derived through a structured pipeline comprising data refinement, hybrid retrieval, multi-stage filtering, semantic clustering, and canonical naming. Evaluation on production-scale telemetry demonstrates that our system improves human-assessed semantic quality from 50 to 80+ on a 100-point scale, reduces maintenance effort by 80%, filters out 74% of noise, and achieves 0.87 Cohen's kappa via an integrated LLM-as-Judge evaluation, enabling continuous, scalable quality assurance. Overall, our work distinguishes itself from prior work by addressing the novel problem of business semantic layer induction from raw telemetry, operating without labeled training data or manual rule engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种端到端框架，通过两阶段语义抽象（LLM推理+RAG混合检索）从原始遥测数据自动构建业务语义层，无需标注数据或人工规则工程。
AI.motivation: 现代应用产生海量异构遥测数据，但从中提取可操作的业务洞察面临语义异构性挑战——同一业务动作在不同平台/版本中碎片化（如search_click/search_submit/search_click），导致数据团队耗费大量精力进行手工映射、定制SQL和维护脆弱的KPI对应关系。现有方法（手工解析器、语法模板提取、传统日志解析）要么脆弱不可扩展，要么仅停留在语法层面，缺乏业务语义理解。
AI.method: 两阶段层次化语义抽象框架：(1) Stage 1数据精炼——LLM驱动的列重要性评分（1-5分）+枚举标准化（基于熵的随机串检测+LLM模式识别+正则合并）；(2) Stage 2业务特征识别——分层采样+行业先验（领域taxonomy）增强的LLM推理；(3) Stage 3候选规则检索——Sentence Transformer密集嵌入+BM25关键词匹配混合检索（线性融合），基于条件级key-value子集而非整个事件；(4) Stage 4两阶段过滤——硬规则过滤+LLM语义过滤；(5) Stage 5节点聚类与命名——LLM语义聚类+[noun]+[verb]规范化命名。算法保证确定性输出（temperature=0、固定种子、JSON约束）。
AI.result: 在生产规模电商遥测数据评估中：(1) 人类评估语义质量从基线51.6提升至82.3（+59.5%），覆盖率从62%→98%，命名一致性从59%→96%；(2) 过滤74%噪声（硬规则28%+LLM语义46%），保留26%覆盖90%+语义；(3) 人工维护工作量减少80%（10h/周→2h/周），查询新指标时间从4h→<25min；(4) LLM-as-Judge与人类专家达到Cohen's kappa 0.87（近完美一致）；(5) 消融实验表明枚举标准化、特征识别、嵌入检索贡献最大（分别-16.3、-18.2、-24.5分）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作形式化定义了从原始遥测数据诱导业务语义层的全新问题，区别于传统日志解析和模式匹配。四大贡献：数据精炼管道、层次化抽象框架、原则化诱导管道、集成LLM-as-Judge评估。未来工作将引入因果推理和跨领域迁移学习以增强泛化能力和分析深度。

title: Self-Evolving Search Index
comment: Work in progress
summary: Information retrieval is increasingly important as LLM agents tackle complex tasks involving diverse information needs. Because retrieval relies on an index that represents each document through index keys, retrieval quality depends heavily on how effectively these keys expose the knowledge contained in each document. However, effective index representations vary across retrieval environments, making it difficult for any fixed optimization strategy to perform consistently. Yet evolving an index to its retrieval environment remains largely human-driven, requiring humans to diagnose retrieval failures, refine the optimization strategy, and reprocess the index accordingly. We propose SELF-INDEX, a framework that enables an index to self-evolve without human intervention. Its Optimizer autonomously diagnoses retrieval shortfalls, selectively revises the responsible index keys, and validates each revision before updating the index. Beyond reacting to observed retrieval demands, SELF-INDEX proactively explores additional demands through a Query Simulator, allowing the index to evolve beyond the queries already available for optimization. Across diverse corpora and retrievers, SELF-INDEX consistently improves retrieval performance while outperforming existing index optimization methods. We further show that these benefits extend to downstream applications, improving the effectiveness and efficiency of search agents and helping agent memory systems retrieve useful past interactions.

AI.tldr: SELF-INDEX是一个无需人工干预的搜索索引自演化框架，通过Optimizer自主诊断-修订-验证循环和Query Simulator主动探索检索需求，自动优化索引键以适应不同检索环境。
AI.motivation: 现有索引优化方法依赖固定的优化策略，难以在不同语料库和检索器环境中一致表现；索引演化过程主要由人工驱动（诊断失败、调整策略、重新处理索引），成本高昂且难以持续，亟需自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 框架包含两个核心组件：(1) Optimizer通过三阶段循环（Self-Diagnosis基于共检索假阴性反馈诊断索引缺陷、Self-Revision选择性修订相关键集、Self-Validation通过忠实性/特异性/分离性三准则验证修订）自主优化索引；(2) Query Simulator通过Self-Exploration采样文档生成查询并用Jaccard相似度过滤，驱动主动演化。两者均基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B实现，采用最大相关性评分聚合避免权重调参。
AI.result: 在BRIGHT（自然语言/代码/数学）和表格检索数据集上，SELF-INDEX在所有检索器（BM25、BGE-Large、Qwen3-Embedding-8B）下均达到最高平均nDCG@10，超越Doc2Query/SPIKE/RL-Index/EnrichIndex等基线；在BrowseComp-Plus上提升搜索代理准确率最高89.53%并降低搜索调用次数与在线成本；在LongMemEval-V2上提升AgentRunbook-R等三种记忆系统的整体准确率9.2%-13.9%；消融实验证实共检索档案、三项验证准则及查询多样性过滤均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: SELF-INDEX首次将自演化范式扩展至索引优化领域，无需预定义策略或相关性标注即可自动适配检索环境，其收益可延伸至搜索代理和Agent记忆系统，为大规模、异构环境下的信息检索提供了有效且高效的索引构建方案。

title: Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable reasoning capabilities by utilizing chain-of-thought (CoT) as a scratchpad for intermediate stages of thinking. However, CoT techniques require explicit supervision on thinking tokens, which requires rich, task-specific data. In this work, we propose Abstract Token Curriculum (ATC), a novel curriculum learning framework that elicits effective continuous intermediate representations without direct supervision or manual scratchpad design. ATC gradually increases problem complexity through a sequence of distributions, training the model to develop internal abstract ``thoughts'' in the continuous representation space. This paper provides both theoretical and experimental evidence for the benefits of ATC and its advantages over previous methods for training continuous thoughts. Theoretically, we show that for learning parity functions with single-layer softmax attention using ATC, attention naturally focuses on the CoT tokens in the context that provide the ``easiest path'' to predicting the next token. Experimentally, we show ATC's effectiveness on graph reachability and arithmetic learning tasks.

AI.tldr: ATC是一种课程学习框架,通过在连续表示空间中渐进增加问题复杂度,无需对思维链标记的直接监督即可让模型自发产生抽象的"思维"表征。理论上证明了对单层softmax注意力学习奇偶函数时,注意力会自然聚焦于提供"最易路径"的最近CoT标记;实验上在图可达性和算术任务上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有的CoT方法需要任务特定的思维监督或手工设计的scratchpad,成本高昂且难以推广。直接在高难度分布上训练存在优化障碍,而课程学习虽能改善优化但不能克服模型固有的计算能力限制。需要一种无需显式CoT监督即可引导模型发展出抽象思维链的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出ATC框架:1)组织一系列难度递增的数据分布D₁,...,Dₖ;2)在每阶段逐步追加连续CoT向量z₁,...,zₖ作为上下文;3)使用Transformer同时处理离散输入和连续思维标记;4)通过课程回溯(truncated backpropagation + curriculum backtracking)和候选丢弃(candidate dropout)等技术解决遗忘与捷径学习问题。理论上分析单层注意力学习n位奇偶函数时,证明一步梯度下降即能使注意力99%集中于最近CoT标记。
AI.result: 在奇偶函数学习上,ATC在所有20个阶段保持接近零损失和近完美精度,而仅数据课程基线随阶数增加而退化。在双树可达性任务上,ATC达到99.9%精度(51个epoch达到95%),优于Coconut的132-468个epoch。多位加法任务上ATC达到98.7-99.6%精度,而Coconut完全失败(0%)。截断反向传播(b=5)配合回溯达到97.4%,内存仅需27%,时间63%。
AI.conclusion: ATC成功从仅答案监督中学习连续抽象思维,无需任务特定的CoT示例或中间状态监督。梯度下降使注意力集中于最近思维标记的机制(attention simplicity bias)得到了理论和实验验证。未来工作可探索长程复杂推理任务,如数学证明构造,其中需要组合多个中间结论和修订早期选择。

title: Evolution or Illusion? Rethinking Evaluation in LLM Evolutionary Search
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search finds programs by launching seeds and iterating each one. Papers report a single budget setting, usually one seed run for a fixed number of iterations, and rank methods from that one point. We show this is not enough. We evaluate three evolutionary search strategies on five optimization tasks, commonly used by papers in the genre to report results. We run the analysis over a full grid of seeds and iterations. Our findings suggest that the best way to split a fixed budget between more seeds (width) and more iterations (depth) changes with the strategy, the task, and the total budget. Furthermore, we observe that the ranking of strategies also changes with the budget. On one task the strategy that looks worst at one seed is best at forty seeds. On another the best number of iterations is well below the value common in practice, so extra depth wastes budget that more seeds would turn into score. We provide a measurement protocol that reports the seeds-by-iterations frontier and practical guidance for using it.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出当前LLM驱动进化搜索的评估方法存在严重缺陷：仅在单一预算点（通常为1个种子、固定迭代次数）评估和排名方法是不充分的。作者提出了一种基于预算网格的评估协议，通过在40个种子×200次迭代的全网格上分析三种进化策略（OpenEvolve、EvoX、AdaEvolve）在五个优化任务上的表现，发现最优的种子数（宽度）与迭代次数（深度）的分配方式随策略、任务和总预算变化；策略排名也会随预算变化甚至反转（例如某个任务上单种子下最差的策略在40种子下变成最优）。论文给出了具体的测量协议和实践建议。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM进化搜索领域（如FunSearch、AlphaEvolve、OpenEvolve等）普遍采用单一种子、固定迭代次数的单点评估方式来比较和排名不同方法。这种做法源于习惯而非严谨的实证依据，可能导致研究者得出错误的结论、错误的赢家，以及对预算的低效使用。作者旨在揭示这种评估方法的局限性，并建立更严谨的评估协议。
AI.method: 作者提出了一种基于预算网格的离线评估协议：（1）对每种策略记录40个种子的完整轨迹；（2）利用精确顺序统计量（order statistics），对每个(k, t)分割计算期望最优分数，无需重采样噪声；（3）分析三个维度——宽度边际（更多种子的价值）、深度边际（更多迭代的价值）、前沿（在给定总预算下的最优分割）；（4）通过自助法（bootstrap）评估部分预算下排名反转的概率；（5）在三种策略（OpenEvolve、EvoX、AdaEvolve）和五个任务（PRISM、Cloudcast、transaction scheduling、Circle Packing、Heilbronn）上验证，使用ADRS引擎和gpt-5-mini模型，提案预算为8000（40×200）。
AI.result: 研究发现三个核心结论：（1）最优的宽度-深度分配随策略、任务和预算变化，例如在PRISM任务10%预算下，EvoX最优为深窄分配(4种子, 196迭代)，而OpenEvolve则为宽浅分配(36, 22)；（2）排名会随预算反转，如Cloudcast任务中EvoX从单种子下的最差变为40种子下的最优；（3）深度常在远低于常用值时即饱和（如AdaEvolve在transaction scheduling上仅40次迭代即达到峰值，EvoX在PRISM上60次）。此外，更多种子还暴露了transaction scheduling评估器的缺陷（未检查覆盖率），AdaEvolve通过跳过297/300交易获得了看似4倍提升的"最优"程序。
AI.conclusion: 作者得出结论：单点评估不足以评估LLM进化搜索方法，策略的赢家取决于策略本身、任务和总预算。建议三项做法：（1）报告种子-迭代前沿及各预算下的最优分割而非单一分数；（2）运行多个种子以获得可靠的排名；（3）按策略和任务调优深度而非凭习惯固定迭代次数。这些实践无需额外运行成本，仅需回放已记录的轨迹。作者也承认该协议的局限性：计算和财务成本更高，且预算网格是离线评估工具，事先预测最优分割仍是开放问题。

title: Reproducing Transparent and Scrutable Recommendations: Exploring Open-Weight Models via Natural-Language User Profiles
comment: Accepted at BlackBoxNLP@EMNLP'26 (The 9th BlackboxNLP Workshop Special Track: Reproducibility and Reliability in Interpretability Analyses)
summary: In this reproducibility study, we investigate the transparency and scrutability of recommender systems enhanced by incorporating generated natural-language user profiles that represent user preferences. The original paper explores the synthesis of user profiles from raw user-generated review text across domains such as movies and accommodations (Amazon Movies & TV, TripAdvisor). Crucially, these natural-language user profiles enable direct user interaction and intervention, allowing users to customize recommendations by correcting misattributed preferences or addressing cold-start settings. We successfully reproduce the core findings of the original study. Additionally, we extend the evaluation by conducting systematic context ablation experiments, multi-seed stability across five distinct random seeds to establish statistical reliability, and a mechanistic interpretability analysis using the nnsight framework to probe internal model representations under counterfactual profile perturbations. Our findings verify the original paper's claim that User Profile Recommendation (UPR) achieves competitive performance under its test-set reranking protocol and makes recommendations more transparent. Perturbing the natural-language profiles does change predictions, but it shifts predicted ratings uniformly across genres with no detectable genre-selective effect, leaving rankings unchanged even under direct activation steering. We trace this back to the rating-regression objective rather than the profile interface, with ranking-objective models clearly exceeding in this task.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇对Ramos等人(2024)提出的UPR(用户画像推荐)方法的复现研究,通过将用户评论合成为自然语言画像来实现透明可审查的推荐。论文成功复现了原始研究的核心结果,并扩展了三方面实验:上下文消融、五种子随机种子稳定性测试,以及基于nnsight框架的机制可解释性分析。研究证实UPR在测试集重排序协议下表现具有竞争力,但发现关键问题:对自然语言画像的扰动只会改变评分却无法实现类型选择性推荐,排名基本不变。根因在于评分回归目标而非画像接口本身,以排序目标训练的模型(WMF)显著优于评分回归模型。
AI.motivation: 推荐系统逐渐从传统的内容过滤、协同过滤范式转向大语言模型驱动架构。用户表示通常是不可解释的密集潜在向量,使用户难以理解和干预推荐结果。UPR通过将用户评论历史合成为人类可读的自然语言画像,允许用户检查、审查和修改自己的画像以定制未来推荐。本研究旨在复现并深入分析该框架的有效性及其可解释性承诺。
AI.method: 方法包含五个层面:(1)精确复现原始论文的主要实验结果并修复代码库问题;(2)提供完整的可复现流水线,采用uv依赖管理;(3)在Cornac中评估非LLM基线方法(MostPop、UserKNN、ItemKNN、MF、NeuMF)进行协议对齐对比;(5)系统性的上下文消融研究,对比用户画像、评论历史、原始评论三种用户表示与物品标题、标题加描述两种物品表示的组合;(4)进行五种子(37-41)的稳定性试验;(5)使用nnsight框架进行机制可解释性分析,包括UMAP可视化最终层归一化激活、聚类分析、反事实画像扰动下的潜在表示轨迹追踪、方差分解、文本编辑效应验证、直接激活引导实验,以及200名用户的个性化能力检验。推荐器采用Llama2-7B或Mistral-7B骨干网络进行序列分类微调,使用AdamW优化器,学习率3e-4,批量大小64,最多5个epoch。
AI.result: 复现结果与原始论文呈现强定性一致性。MF在两个数据集上保持最强的评分准确度基线,UPR模型在TripAdvisor上达到高度竞争力的排序指标(nDCG@10: 0.961, MAP: 0.939)。上下文消融证实画像(MAE 0.784, nDCG@10 0.929)与原始评论历史(MAE 0.763, nDCG@10 0.926)性能相当但提示更短。多种子稳定性显示MAP标准差仅0.0009,nDCG标准差仅0.0007。机制可解释性分析揭示关键发现:画像解释47.6%-48.5%的预测评分方差,但仅作为用户级评分偏移,画像与物品交互项仅占4.1%-16.1%。文本编辑显著改变预测评分(Δŷ=+0.195,p<10⁻⁵⁰),但跨类型池效应无显著差异(p=0.79,0.60)。激活引导可完全反转探针读数(P(犯罪)从0.064到1.000),但犯罪物品评分仅轻微下降,排名变化不超过0.2个位置。WMF排序目标达到0.806百分位,而UPR仅0.510-0.542,低于不个性化的MostPop(0.697)。属性分析显示类型词仅获得其他词属性的一半(比率0.546,p=0.002),前20词中无类型词。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实UPR方法的可复现性及其在测试集重排序协议下的竞争力,自然语言画像确实提供透明的接口。然而,对画像的扰动虽能改变内部表示和预测评分,但无法产生类型选择性的推荐,排名保持不变。这种局限性源于评分回归目标而非画像接口本身:该目标只需用户偏移加物品偏移即可最小化,无法学习内容匹配规则。训练数据仅包含用户选择并评价的物品,缺乏不匹配的用户-物品对。基于排序目标(如WMF)训练的模型显著优于评分回归模型。可审查性在该方案中给予用户的是控制其被建模的慷慨程度而非推荐内容。未来的改进方向包括:采用带负采样的排序目标进行训练,以使画像编辑行为真正有意义。属性图应视为显著性方法的描述而非微调特征的隔离证据,因为属性模式在随机初始化、词序打乱时仍大部分保留。

title: Zarya: A Hybrid Autoregressive--Masked Diffusion Language Model with Flexible Training and Dual-Mode Inference
comment: Preprint. Work in progress. Please cite peer-reviewed version when published
summary: Autoregressive language models (ARMs) are constrained by sequential, left-to-right generation, while masked diffusion models (MDMs) enable parallel decoding but suffer from high computational overhead due to the inability to reuse Key-Value (KV) cache and from incoherent generation arising from learning dependencies over an intractable space of token combinations. We introduce Zarya, a family of hybrid language models that jointly optimizes an autoregressive (AR) objective and a masked-diffusion objective within a single architecture. Zarya structures training data into variable-size slots and employs a curriculum that gradually increases slot granularity, enabling a smooth transition from fine-grained AR learning to coarse-grained diffusion learning. At inference, Zarya provides two distinct decoding paradigms through a unified interface: (i) MDM sampling with first-hitting denoising, and (ii) slotted speculative decoding that interleaves inter-slot diffusion-based selection with intra-slot autoregressive infilling, achieving full KV cache reuse. The training and inference regimes are fully decoupled, allowing a model trained with any configuration to be deployed in either mode. Extensive configurability --- including grouped noise patterns (Prefix Completion, Fill-In-the-Prefix, Fill-In-the-Middle), ordered sampling schedules, and noise-level permutation strategies --- enables flexible research exploration. We release Zarya models publicly in sizes 0.6B, 1.7B, and 4B, demonstrating performance on standard benchmarks while offering a principled integration of autoregressive and diffusion paradigms.

AI.tldr: Zarya 提出了一种混合自回归-掩码扩散语言模型架构，通过统一的训练目标同时优化 AR 和 MDM 损失，并支持两种可切换的推理模式（MDM 采样与槽位推测解码），在保持完全 KV 缓存复用的前提下融合了两种生成范式的优势。
AI.motivation: 纯自回归模型受限于顺序生成，无法并行化；纯掩码扩散模型虽支持并行解码，但无法利用 KV 缓存且在巨大 token 组合空间中学习依赖关系时容易产生不连贯输出。需要一种统一架构同时获得 AR 的连贯性与 MDM 的并行性，并兼容 KV 缓存加速。
AI.method: 1) 基于 Qwen3 backbone（0.6B/1.7B/4B），将预测序列划分为可变长度的"槽位"，并在训练过程中逐步增大槽位粒度（从 2 到 64），实现从细粒度 AR 学习到粗粒度扩散学习的课程式过渡；2) 采用 AR 损失与 MDM 损失的线性组合（λ=0.5 默认）；3) 训练支持多种噪声模式（前缀补全、前缀填充、中间填充）；4) 推理提供两种模式：MDM 首达式去噪采样，以及槽位推测解码（块级 MDM 起草 + 槽内 AR 验证），全程复用 KV 缓存；5) 训练与推理配置完全解耦。
AI.result: 在 32M 指令样本（约 37.7B tokens）上微调 1 epoch，Zarya-0.6B 在 GSM8K 上达到 26.46% exact_match，HellaSwag 35.26% acc（42.70% acc_norm），IFEval 53.72% inst_level_loose_acc，MBPP 15.00% pass_at_1（MBPP+ 22.49%）。模型已在 GitHub 开源。
AI.conclusion: Zarya 通过槽位结构化训练和双模式推理接口，为 AR 与 MDM 范式提供了一种原则性的集成方案，验证了在保持 KV 缓存兼容性的同时获得扩散式并行解码的可行性，但槽位推测解码对阈值敏感，且部分训练配置（如 ordered_sampling、noise_sorting）在推理时无效，是未来需要改进的方向。

title: PetriBench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning over Dynamic State Spaces
summary: Characterizing LLM reasoning remains an open challenge, as many existing benchmarks isolate specific reasoning skills, rely on external knowledge, or are costly to extend. We introduce PetriBench, a compact, fully self-contained, and scalable benchmark for evaluating LLM reasoning over dynamic state spaces using Petri nets, a mature formalism for modeling real-world concurrent and distributed systems. PetriBench organizes reasoning into four task families varying by scope and temporal horizon, with Easy, Medium, and Hard levels generated by increasing structural complexity and evaluated against exact ground truth. Across a diverse set of proprietary and open-weight models, accuracy decreases consistently with difficulty, while harder instances expose increasingly distinct task-specific capability profiles. Additional analyses show that test-time compute improves performance but interacts differently with different reasoning tasks, and that procedural generation yields smooth scaling with structural complexity. Together, these results show that PetriBench provides a unified and extensible setting for probing the strengths, limits, and scaling behavior of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: PetriBench 是一个基于 Petri 网（Petri nets）的紧凑、可自包含且可程序化扩展的 LLM 推理评测基准。它通过六类任务（按"局部/全局"与"有限/无限时间范围"两维度组织）评估大语言模型在动态状态空间上的推理能力，覆盖最小令牌步数、可达标识计数、变迁活性（L0/L4）、死锁与有界性。所有实例采用确定性的布尔或整数真值，在 Easy/Medium/Hard 三档难度下系统评估多个专有与开源模型，并分析推理效率、缩放行为与失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有推理基准往往孤立评估特定技能、依赖外部知识或难以扩展。作者希望借助 Petri 网这一成熟的并发/分布式系统形式化工具，构建一个紧凑、自包含、可程序化扩展且具有确定性真值的统一评测框架，以系统刻画 LLM 在动态状态空间上的推理优劣与缩放行为。
AI.method: 采用加权 P/T 网（弧权 ∈{1,2}），按"局部/全局 × 有限/无限时间范围"两维构造六类任务：MinimumTokenSteps（局部有限）、ReachableMarkings（全局有限）、L0/L4 Liveness（局部无限）、Deadlock 与 Boundedness（全局无限）。每个任务采用"性质保持的程序化生成"策略：先构造决定答案的核心结构，再注入不改变标签的干扰结构；通过 Causal Generation Depth 与 Distractor Generation Factor 控制难度。使用 TINA 求解器进行真值核验。采用紧凑边表序列化、CoT 提示与精确匹配评分。每档难度 1600 题，共 4800 题。
AI.result: 在多种专有与开源模型上测试显示：(1) 难度提升时准确率单调下降，模型间差距增大；(2) 困难实例上不同模型呈现越来越明显的任务特异性能力画像（PCA 第一主成分解释率从 91.7% 降至 78.9%）；(3) 测试时计算增加总体提升性能，但与推理长度的相关性在有限/无限时间范围任务间存在显著差异；(4) Aggregate 排名与 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 的 Spearman 相关性达 0.94；(5) 程序化生成在结构复杂度上呈现平滑缩放；(6) 失效分析归纳出五类错误模式（变迁语义、行为搜索、性质推断、解聚合、答案输出）。
AI.conclusion: PetriBench 证明 Petri 网可作为受控推理评测的强大基础，提供了一个统一、可扩展且具有确定性真值的框架。它在不同模型上呈现稳定的难度梯度，能揭示任务特异性的能力差异，并支持随模型能力提升而持续提高评测难度，为未来扩展任务类型与生成更多样化的网结构奠定基础。

title: KoNeoBench: A Curated Evaluation Dataset for LLM Understanding of Korean Neologisms
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code and data are available at the project repository
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically evaluated on static benchmarks, even though natural language constantly evolves through newly emerging words and meanings. Existing Korean benchmarks are centered on established vocabulary and therefore provide limited coverage of such recent lexical change, and their English-oriented design makes it difficult to assess the typological properties of Korean, in which content words combine productively with functional morphemes. In this paper, we introduce KoNeoBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs' understanding of Korean neologisms. KoNeoBench is built on 1,785 Korean neologisms attested in online news since 2020 and curated through expert lexicographic review. Each entry provides usage examples, word-formation analyses, and dictionary-style definitions. Based on this resource, we define four tasks and report results on recent models, together with a human baseline. Our experiments show that current LLMs exhibit clear limitations in recovering source components, distinguishing semantic categories, and generating accurate definitions. These results reveal specific aspects of recent Korean lexical change that remain challenging for current LLMs. KoNeoBench is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: KoNeoBench是一个基于1,785个2020年以来韩国新词(neologisms)的专家标注基准数据集,设计了四个任务(上下文识别、源词识别、语义分类、词典式定义生成)来评估LLM对韩语新词的理解能力,实验表明当前LLM在词形还原、语义区分和定义生成方面存在明显局限。
AI.motivation: 现有韩语评测基准主要基于既有词汇,无法覆盖新近出现的词汇变化;且面向英语设计,难以评估韩语作为黏着语(content words与功能语素自由组合)的类型学特性。需要一个专门针对韩语新词的多维度评测基准。
AI.method: 1) 数据构建:基于韩国国立国语院2020-2024年年度新词集,经自动提取(从约162万候选中筛选)+专家词典学审校,最终保留1,785个新词,每条包含词源形式、构词类型、语义类别、专门领域、词典式定义和用例。2) 任务设计:Task1上下文完形填空(多选)、Task2源词识别(针对缩写/混合词)、Task3分类(语义16类+专门领域43类,分odd-one-out和直接分类两种形式)、Task4词典式定义生成。3) 评估9个LLM(API模型+开源模型+韩语专用模型),Task4采用LLM-as-a-Judge(Gemini)并辅以专家人工验证。4) 与20名母语者(含10名语言学专业)的人类基线对比。
AI.result: 主要发现:1) GPT-5.4表现最佳但Task1准确率仅60%出头,Task2 F1均低于50,表明源词恢复能力远未达到母语者水平;2) 韩语专用模型(如Solar Pro3)在细粒度新词辨别上并不优于通用大模型;3) 助词附加形式(Type2)使所有模型平均下降2.24%,反映黏着语特征带来的额外负担;4) 提供用例可显著提升Task3(多数模型提升>10%)和Task4性能;5) 新词越新,模型表现越差,体现时间漂移影响;6) 语言学专业学生在Task1和Task2上显著优于GPT-5.4,而GPT-5.4在专门领域分类上优于非专业人类;7) Gemini评分与专家评分呈强正相关(r=0.708),但Gemini略偏宽松。
AI.conclusion: KoNeoBench是首个针对韩语新词的多维度专家标注评测基准,揭示了当前LLM在韩语近期词汇变化理解上的三个核心挑战:时间漂移与低频性、黏着语构形带来的额外困难、构词模式学习的不足。定义生成任务(Task4)因区分度高、与人类判断相关性强,被推荐作为核心评测指标。研究建议通过检索增强等方式引入用例来改善LLM对新词的理解。基准已开源发布。

title: Past, Future, All at Once: Mitigating Stability-Plasticity Dilemma via Post-hoc JANUS Rectification
summary: Fine-tuning foundation models on new tasks inevitably suffer from catastrophic forgetting. While existing works attempt to mitigate this on the basis of parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods, they adopted an overly restrictive Subspace Orthogonality condition. In this paper, we introduce a purely post-hoc and tuning-agnostic weight rectification framework that achieves Parameter Space Orthogonality, which is the necessary and sufficient condition for preserving historical performance to the first order. By projecting parameter updates into the JAcobian NUll Space (JANUS), our method significantly recovers compromised historical knowledge without interfering with the underlying fine-tuning process. To overcome the local validity of the Jacobian approximation, we further propose a Multi-step Adaptive Rectification mechanism that utilizes the JANUS shift to dynamically verify the valid trust region and adjust step sizes. Coupled with our proposed ghost projection, ghost orientation comparison, and sequence-level singular value decomposition compression techniques, JANUS also achieves great temporal and spatial efficiency. Experiments demonstrate that JANUS seamlessly integrates with various fine-tuning methods, significantly mitigating the stability-plasticity dilemma by recovering historical knowledge while preserving downstream task adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为JANUS的后置式权重校正框架，通过将参数更新投影到历史任务的雅可比零空间（Jacobian Null Space），在不干扰微调过程的情况下缓解大模型微调中的灾难性遗忘问题。核心贡献在于将传统的严格子空间正交性条件松弛为参数空间正交性条件（Tr(ΔW·M)=0），并通过多步自适应校正机制、幽灵投影和序列级SVD压缩技术，实现了高效的知识恢复。
AI.motivation: 大模型在下游任务微调过程中不可避免地遭遇灾难性遗忘问题，即在适应新任务的同时丧失已习得的历史知识。现有的基于正交性的解决方案施加了过于严格的子空间正交性约束（ΔW·M=0），实际上是防止遗忘的充分非必要条件，在实践中难以满足且过度限制了模型的可塑性（plasticity）。这些方法往往面临稳定性与可塑性之间的权衡困境。
AI.method: 1. **参数空间正交性理论**：基于一阶泰勒展开推导，证明防止一阶遗忘的必要且充分条件是Tr(ΔW·M)=0，而非ΔW·M=0，从而极大地扩展了可行的参数空间。2. **后置式JANUS校正**：在微调完成后，通过计算历史任务的小批量样本梯度构建雅可比矩阵J，并将参数更新Δθ投影到J的零空间：Δθ_proj = Δθ - J^T(JJ^T)^{-1}JΔθ。3. **多步自适应校正机制**：由于雅可比近似的局部有效性，引入"JANUS shift"度量（通过雅可比行空间主角度的余弦均值衡量），动态验证有效信赖域并以衰减因子β调整步长。4. **高效实现技术**：（a）幽灵投影（Ghost Projection）和幽灵方向比较（Ghost Orientation Comparison）利用批量反向传播的中间张量（层输入X和预激活梯度A），避免逐样本反向传播；（b）序列级SVD压缩利用X和A沿序列维度的低秩特性，将空间复杂度从O(2LmTd)降至O(2Lmrd)。整个校正过程可在单张A100 GPU上30分钟内完成LLaMA-2-7b的校正。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2-7b和LLaMA-3-8b上的数学、代码、指令跟随三大任务实验表明：1. **知识恢复显著**：JANUS将AP1（稳定性指标）从低于80%提升至接近甚至超过100%，同时几乎不损失任务性能（AP2基本不变）。2. **通用性强**：作为即插即用模块，JANUS可无缝集成到FF、LoRA、PiSSA等多种微调方法中。3. **Pareto前沿扩展**：在所有设置下，JANUS均有效外推稳定性-可塑性Pareto前沿。4. **消融验证**：多步自适应校正机制至关重要（去除后AP1显著下降）；使用雅可比矩阵优于使用平均梯度（验证了个体梯度信息的必要性）。5. **JANUS shift有效性**：统计上显著的正相关（p<0.05）证实其作为遗忘度量和信赖域指标的可靠性。6. **超参数鲁棒**：对接受阈值τ、衰减因子β、压缩秩r、回放规模m等超参数均表现出良好的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: JANUS作为一种纯粹后置式、调优无关的权重校正框架，通过参数空间正交性理论和多步自适应校正机制，有效解决了大模型微调中的稳定性-可塑性困境。其理论贡献在于将严格的子空间正交性松弛为更易满足的参数空间正交性，实践贡献在于提供了一种高效、通用的即插即用解决方案。局限性在于：所有基于正交性的方法仅提供一阶理论保证；在损失景观剧烈起伏的极端域偏移场景下，多步机制可能需要大量保守的小步长；当前研究聚焦于LLaMA系列的预训练-微调场景，扩展到多任务持续学习和更广泛架构仍需进一步探索。

title: EPIG-Tree: Compute-Optimal Branching for Gradient-Efficient Reinforcement Learning
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures
summary: Reward-based reinforcement learning for language models, exemplified by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), collapses an entire stochastic trajectory into a single scalar reward. This is clean and scalable, but it explores and allocates reward inefficiently: a trajectory may contain many causal decisions, recovery attempts, and environment-randomness events, yet every token or action inherits one trajectory-level advantage. We study tree-based rollout construction as a compute-allocation problem for policy-gradient estimation. Our central claim is that branches should be placed not where the policy is merely uncertain, but where an additional branch most reduces uncertainty about the policy gradient per unit of compute. From a law-of-total-variance decomposition of the local policy-gradient random variable, we derive two allocation laws: new branches reduce decision uncertainty, while repeated suffix rollouts reduce continuation uncertainty. The resulting EPIG-Tree score allocates branches using the already computed rollouts. It estimates occupancy- and score-weighted value uncertainty, along with a suffix law $n_e \propto w_e \|\nabla_\theta \log \pi(a_e|h_e)\| \sigma_e / \sqrt{c_e}$. Empirically, EPIG reduces gradient MSE in cloned-state control, winning in all nine dense continuous-control environments of a 13-environment sweep and recovering the reference gradient direction near-perfectly, and it improves frozen-LLM gradient calibration relative to entropy branching. In online single-turn math, tree-local credit beats flat GRPO, while branch placement is secondary to token-level credit assignment. In online multi-turn Wordle, EPIG attains the highest final win rate (0.850), overtaking flat GRPO, which saturates early at 0.790, and entropy branching as training proceeds, confirming that the gradient-estimation advantage transfers to a stateful, large-action setting.

AI.tldr: EPIG-Tree提出将树形rollout构建视为策略梯度估计的计算分配问题，通过对局部策略梯度的全方差分解推导出分支分配律，以梯度信息增益(EPIG分数)替代熵作为分支放置准则，在密集连续控制和在线多回合Wordle中显著优于GRPO和熵分支。
AI.motivation: GRPO等基于终局奖励的强化学习方法将整条轨迹压缩为单个标量奖励，在长视野或多回合场景中存在三大结构性问题：恢复行为信用分配差、非确定性处理低效、rollout数量扩展性差。现有树方法（如TreeRL的EPTree）使用熵作为分支准则，但熵并非策略梯度估计关心的目标量。
AI.method: 核心方法：(1) 对局部策略梯度随机变量Z_h应用全方差定律分解为决策不确定性（新分支减少）和延续不确定性（后缀采样减少）；(2) 推导成本敏感的后缀分配律 n_e* ∝ w_e‖ψ_e‖σ_e/√c_e（Neyman分配类比）；(3) 分支分配边际增益 Δ_branch ≈ B_h/[m_h(m_h+1)] - λc_h；(4) EPIG-Tree算法以熵为提议机制、以EPIG分数分配预算，提出EPIG-grad（ψ加权）和EPIG-Lite（纯值方差）两个变体；(5) 理论扩展包含Goodhart校正（EPIG-Full）和熵损耗项。
AI.result: 实验分三层验证：(1) 克隆状态控制（13个Gym/MuJoCo环境，B=8后缀）：EPIG-grad在全部9个密集连续控制环境上降低梯度MSE，参考梯度方向余弦达0.998-1.000（熵分支仅0.79-0.94）；4个例外（小动作空间/稀疏奖励）落入预期边界条件。(2) 冻结LLM校准（Qwen3-8B/GSM8K，64提示3种子）：EPIG-Lite余弦0.0748±0.0119 vs 熵分支0.0217±0.0389；冻结Wordle值MSE 0.523 vs 熵0.568 vs 均匀1.094，纯值方差1.389，确认ψ加权必要。(3) 在线训练：单回合数学中树局部信用优于flat GRPO但分支放置差异在单种子噪声内（loss mask修复才是关键，GSM8K-hard从0.547→0.781）；在线多回合Wordle（1.7B模型×4方法×2种子×300更新）：EPIG-grad最终胜率0.850，超越EPTree 0.825、均匀树0.805、flat GRPO饱和值0.790。
AI.conclusion: EPIG为策略梯度估计的树构建提供了计算最优原则：分支应放置在能最大程度降低梯度估计器误差的位置而非仅策略不确定处。理论在克隆状态控制和冻结LLM诊断中得到强支持；在近饱和的单回合数学上与更廉价基线持平；在策略动态变化、动作空间大的在线多回合游戏中恢复优势。EPIG不是通用探索算法，其适用边界由动作空间大小、奖励稀疏度和信用分配质量共同决定。

title: Dynamic Generalized Gromov-Wasserstein Optimal Transport
summary: Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport (GW-OT) extends classical optimal transport by introducing structure-aware transport cost. This is particularly relevant for spatial transcriptomics, where dynamical reconstruction should preserve tissue structure in addition to matching expression patterns. While static formulations have been widely used for such structure-aware alignment, a general dynamic formulation for reconstructing continuous trajectories is still missing. We introduce Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE), a theoretical and computational framework to generalize GW-OT dynamically in a simulation-free manner. We formulate a broad class of static and dynamic Quadratic-form OT (QOT) through path actions and prove the static dynamic equivalence. We further develop travelling-pair flow matching, which allows interacting conditional paths and marginalizes their interactions into a single vector field. On synthetic and real spatial transcriptomics data, TP-DATE better preserves spatial structure and improves continuous 3D dynamics reconstruction.

AI.tldr: TP-DATE 提出了一种动态二次型最优传输（QOT）的理论框架及免模拟的"行旅对流匹配"求解器，将标准 OT、GW-OT、IGW-OT 统一为特例，并在时空转录组学和 3D 组织重建任务中更好地保持了空间结构。
AI.motivation: 现有的 Gromov–Wasserstein 最优传输（GW-OT）及其扩展是静态的，只能对齐快照而无法重建连续时间动力学；空间转录组学等结构化数据需要同时匹配表达模式与组织结构，因此亟需一种结构感知的动态 OT 框架。
AI.method: 提出 Travelling Pair Dynamical Alignment and Trajectory Estimation (TP-DATE)：(1) 通过路径作用（path action）定义广义静态与动态二次型 OT（QOT），证明二者等价并给出 BB-form 的上界；(2) 引入"行旅对"（travelling pair）条件路径与配对边缘化定理，允许条件路径之间相互作用；(3) 基于条件流匹配（flow matching）设计免模拟训练损失，可学习单粒子速度场以恢复动态 QOT 概率流；(4) 推导出特定 Lagrangian 选择下 OT/GW-OT 之间的"动态融合"，并分析与 FGW-OT、IGW-OT 的联系。
AI.result: 在合成旋转数据、Mouse Brain 与 ARTISTA 时空转录组数据以及 Tumor 3D 切片重建任务中，TP-DATE 在 Spatial MSE、成对畸变（pair distortion）、SC-eMSE 及 balanced fused W₂ 等多项指标上均优于 OT-CFM、GW-CFM、FGW-CFM、stVCR、CytoBridge 和 ContextFlow 等基线；同时在可扩展性实验中，相较 NeuralODE 类方法（stVCR、CytoBridge）展现出近似线性于数据规模的计算效率优势。
AI.conclusion: TP-DATE 为一类动态 QOT 问题提供了统一的理论框架与免模拟的流匹配求解器，能够同时保留 OT 的高效动力学重建能力与 GW-OT 的结构保持特性，是首个将 GW-OT 等结构感知 OT 推广到连续时间动力学的通用方案；未来可向随机/不平衡 QOT、交互项的学习以及结合领域知识的可解释速度分解方向拓展。

title: Governance-as-Code: Translating EU AI Act Technical Requirements into Executable Compliance Pipelines for Generative AI Systems
comment: Accepted at the AI4Law Workshop, ICML 2026. Camera-ready version
summary: The EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) imposes technical obligations on high-risk AI providers, yet Articles 8-15 were drafted for predictive AI and leave seven technical gaps when applied to generative systems, spanning non-deterministic data governance, training-data provenance, continuous conformity, human oversight, open-ended robustness, emergent risk, and generative fairness. We deliver Governance-as-Code (GaC), a framework of 43 machine-checkable acceptance criteria across six compliance modules that run in a CI/CD pipeline and emit Article-indexed audit evidence, and we show the actual Rego policy code rather than merely describing it. Our central commitment is that the Act's open-textured standards ("appropriate levels," "possible biases") become declared, auditable numbers: robustness thresholds are derived from the provider's documented baseline and a state-of-the-art floor, and framing bias is collapsed into eight measurable proxies tested by counterfactual demographic probing. We also correct who owes what, since under Article 25 and Chapter V a downstream deployer relies on the upstream provider's Article 53 training-data summary and documents only the layers it controls, so GaC verifies that summary rather than demanding per-sample documentation the deployer never had. We validate on two enterprise deployments, a high-risk advisory chatbot and a limited-risk content generator, benchmarking against a manual expert audit rather than documentation artifacts that were never designed to enforce compliance. GaC reproduces all of the manual audit's findings, including three penalty-triggering violations, while cutting audit labor by roughly 75%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Governance-as-Code (GaC) 框架，将欧盟 AI 法案（Regulation 2024/1689）第 8–15 条针对生成式 AI 的技术要求转化为 43 条可在 CI/CD 流水线中自动执行的机器可校验验收准则，分布在六个模块中，输出按条款索引的审计证据。论文识别了七项技术差距，给出实际 Rego 策略代码，并在两个企业部署上以人工专家审计为基线进行验证，复现全部违规发现，减少约 75% 审计工时。
AI.motivation: 欧盟 AI 法案第 8–15 条针对预测式 AI 起草，应用于生成式系统时存在七项技术差距（非确定性数据治理、训练数据出处、持续合规、人工监督、开放域鲁棒性、涌现风险、生成式公平性）。现有文档工件（Model Cards、FactSheets）只能静态记录信息，无法在部署流水线中执行检查；同时条款中的开放性表述（如"适当水平"、"可能偏差"）若不转化为明确阈值，合规主张将不可审计。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 系统分析七项技术差距，每项映射到具体条款和生成式系统的技术特性；(2) GaC 框架——六个模块共 43 条机器可校验准则，在 CI/CD 流水线中以 OPA Rego 策略代码实现，在预部署、部署门控、运行时三阶段拦截，产生 JSON-LD 证据；(3) 将"适当水平"操作化为公式 τ_deploy = max(τ_floor, τ_baseline - δ)（条款 15 鲁棒性），将框架偏差坍缩为 8 个可测代理特征（推荐效价、风险框架方向、模糊/确定性、推荐强度、语域、声明密度、限定率、数值具体性），通过反事实人口探测检验人口学依赖性。
AI.result: 在两个企业部署上验证：案例一为高风险监管领域咨询聊天机器人（Annex III 5(b)），GaC 复现人工审计全部 8 项发现（含 3 项触发处罚的违规：Art. 14 无人工监督、Art. 9 无持续风险管理、Art. 50 缺失生成内容标记），审计工时从 72h 降至 18h（降幅约 75%）；案例二为有限风险内容生成器，复现 4 项发现。FactSheets/Model Cards 等文档工件在审计前已存在但未标记任何问题。预部署套件对聊天机器人增加约 45 分钟流水线耗时。
AI.conclusion: 论文结论：欧盟 AI 法案的技术合规义务无法用现有工具为生成式系统验证，且必须将法案的开放性标准转化为明确数值。GaC 将七项差距编码为六个模块共 43 条可执行准则，所有阈值和代理均显式声明而非隐藏常量，与人工专家审计基线对比，能以约四分之一工时复现违规发现。论文强调通过使运营选择成为可记录的、可争议的证据来降低"误自信"风险，并指出阈值将随协调标准成熟而可经验性校准。局限：仅两例验证；合理性取决于对抗测试套件质量；8 个公平性代理是简化。

title: Correct Now, Insufficient Later: Auditing Update Sufficiency in Context Compression
comment: 20 pages, 9 tables, 2 figures. Code and reproducibility materials to be released separately
summary: A memory can answer a current query correctly while discarding distinctions required by a later update. We investigate this failure with a paired-history audit: two histories have the same current answer, receive a shared future update, and require different subsequent answers. A pilot evaluates 24 history pairs across six synthetic mechanisms, 12 memory conditions, two repeats, and two model backends. A deterministic frontier selector obtains strict reveal accuracy of 96/96 on DeepSeek and 82/96 on GLM; a structured writer obtains 62 successes with one unresolved outcome and 56/96. The configured four-outcome joint contrast has finite-sample identification intervals of [0.521, 0.542] and [0.292, 0.313], not confidence intervals. A record-level audit distinguishes retained-state adequacy, response delivery, and answer-schema compliance without changing those original scores. It finds 26 and 25 well-formed but semantically wrong structured reveal memories, while all 14 GLM frontier reveal failures contain correct values in the wrong wrapper. Tombstone removal produces 16/16 exact replay failures in the targeted mechanism. Identifier renaming then exposes a separate flaw: original frontier late-reference adequacy falls from 8/8 to 94/320 transformed instances. We provide and test a label-equivariant repair, but it preserves only 2/8 original late-reference answers: eliminating a naming shortcut does not solve unknown future relevance. These results support a scoped evaluation methodology and reproducible failure analysis, not general superiority of the repaired algorithm. Paid pilot evidence, retrospective diagnostics, and new offline tests are reported separately; no independent held-out or natural-task validation is claimed.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种"配对历史审计"方法,揭示上下文压缩中"当前答案正确但未来更新后失效"的现象。通过在24对合成事件日志上对比确定性前沿选择器与LLM生成式记忆,发现两者在DeepSeek和GLM后端上的严格reveal准确率分别为96/96、82/96与62、56/96。记录级诊断进一步将失败归因于内容保留、响应传递和答案模式合规性三类问题,并通过标识符重命名暴露了前沿选择器的标签依赖缺陷,提出标签等变修复但其仅保留2/8原始后期引用答案。
AI.motivation: 当前答案正确性不足以评估压缩记忆在未来更新下的可用性。两个当前答案相同的历史可能因隐藏证据差异而在共享未来更新后需要不同答案,仅评估当前正确会掩盖这一失效模式。论文旨在建立一种可重现的方法学诊断框架,分离内容保留、响应传递和模式合规三类失败来源。
AI.method: 采用CCA v4符号事件日志环境,设计24对配对历史(六种合成机制各四对),每对当前查询答案相同但潜在证据不同。通过reveal与override两类共享未来测试,使用12种记忆条件(严格记忆与归档访问)、两个重复、DeepSeek与GLM两个后端进行评估。指标包括严格reveal准确率、四结局联合端点及其有限样本识别区间,以及保留状态充分性、响应传递、模式合规的不相交记录级诊断。通过标识符重命名和前缀排列的变形测试,提出标签等变修复(frontier-alpha)。
AI.result: 前沿选择器在DeepSeek上获得96/96、GLM上82/96的严格reveal准确率,结构化H写作器分别为62和56/96。联合端点识别区间为[0.521,0.542]与[0.292,0.313]。记录级审计发现26和25个结构化记忆语义错误但形式合规,GLM全部14个前沿失败均为正确值包装错误。墓碑移除在目标机制上产生16/16精确重放失败。标识符重命名使前沿后期引用充分性从8/8降至94/320,标签等变修复仅保留2/8原始答案。
AI.conclusion: 论文支持一种范围受限的评估方法学与可重现的失败分析,确立三个有限结论:当前答案成功可掩盖未来更新失败;遗忘版本和撤销会导致局部内容失效;响应格式与偶然标签顺序显著影响表观性能。论文不主张前沿选择器为通用优越压缩器,修复算法未超越原方法,亦未声明持有外域验证。提出了未来确认研究的执行契约,但明确未执行。

title: The Missing Complement: State-Conditioned Minimal Sufficient Evidence for Coding Agents
comment: 32 pages, 3 figures. Benchmark and evaluation resources: this https URL
summary: A coding agent halfway through an issue has already read much of what a retriever ranks highest. Relevance is scored per passage, but sufficiency belongs to the set: a ranker can fill its budget with variants of one required fact and leave the decision unsupported. We formulate state-conditioned minimal sufficient evidence recovery: given a captured agent state, recover a compact evidence combination that supplies the support its next decision still lacks. SERBench measures this on 500 held-out states from 45 repositories, recording what the agent has seen and crediting only sets that cover every fact the current decision was annotated to require. MSS-Complement treats acquisition as set construction, not ranking. Three semantic calls propose a jointly sufficient set, search for what it lacks, and return 4-8 intact source units within 6,144 tokens. One configuration, fixed on calibration data, recovers a complete set for 73.0% of those states at five items and 80.6% at eight, against 61.4% and 72.4% for Qwen3 embedding with reranking.
