AI.result: 在修订版 Joyo-Kanji-Yomi 基准（13,536 测试句）上，方法取得 99.62% 准确率、0.32% 目标 PER、0.14% 句子 PER，显著优于 MeCab+UniDic（96.66%）、Sudachi（97.32%）、CTC（98.09%）、ByT5（98.45%）和 Qwen3-0.6B（98.78%），并与 Gemini 3.1 Flash 等前沿 LLM 表现相当；Oracle 上限达 100.0% 准确率，验证词格覆盖非制约因素。消融实验显示 DeBERTa-base + margin 损失为最佳配置，移除 margin 损失使目标 PER 升至 0.43%。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的字典约束、上下文感知的神经 G2P 框架，结合大规模 LLM 标注数据，有效解决了日语 G2P 中分词与多音字消耦的耦合难题，性能显著超越传统形态分析方法与神经序列模型，与前沿大语言模型相当；同时指出了专有名词与数字/拉丁字符处理两方面局限性作为未来方向。

title: F$^{2}$DR: A Fine-Grained Full-Pipeline Reward Framework for DeepSearch Workflows
summary: With the widespread industrial deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs), DeepSearch has emerged as the dominant paradigm for resolving complex user queries. It typically operates through an iterative closed-loop workflow consisting of planning and reflection, information retrieval, and answer generation. However, existing reward models (RMs) and evaluation benchmarks are primarily designed for static single-turn tasks, failing to capture the full-pipeline complexity of DeepSearch workflows. To address this limitation, we propose F2DR, a fine-grained full-pipeline DeepSearch reward framework. F2DR evaluates DeepSearch workflows across three dimensions: Content, Trajectory, and Answer, enabling comprehensive process-level assessment. We further construct DeepSearch RM-Bench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating RMs in DeepSearch scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that F2DR achieves significantly higher evaluation consistency than self-evaluation-based baselines, while DeepSearch RM-Bench exhibits strong discriminative capability across existing open-source RMs. We will publicly release the complete DeepSearch RM-Bench dataset soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出F²DR，一种面向DeepSearch工作流的细粒度全流程奖励框架，并基于此构建DeepSearch RM-Bench基准，用于评估奖励模型在多步骤搜索推理场景下的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有奖励模型（RMs）与评估基准主要针对静态单轮任务设计，无法捕捉DeepSearch工作流（规划-反思、信息检索、答案生成）的多阶段复杂性，导致过程级评估能力不足。
AI.method: 1）数据采集：从工业搜索平台筛选多跳复杂查询，采用基于DAG的规划-反思范式生成DeepSearch轨迹，构建偏好对；2）F²DR框架：从内容（Content，基于知识点的清单核查）、轨迹（Trajectory，6个子维度的任务级与轨迹级审计）、答案（Answer，主客观结合）三个维度评估；3）基准构建：通过多模型共识与人工核验过滤偏好对，形成1,070对高质量偏好数据。
AI.result: F²DR相比自评估基线平均提升约10个百分点的偏好准确率，DeepSeek-R1取得最高85.79%；推理型模型在轨迹评估上显著优于非推理模型；现有开源RMs（Bradley-Terry判别式模型接近随机水平，生成式推理增强模型约63）在DeepSearch RM-Bench上表现受限，表明该基准具有强区分能力。
AI.conclusion: F²DR为DeepSearch场景提供了首个过程级、全流程的奖励框架，DeepSearch RM-Bench作为首个专用基准揭示了主流奖励模型在复杂多步决策链中的性能瓶颈，验证了结构化过程级评估机制的必要性。

title: JustMem: Just-Enough Memory Access for Long-Term Conversations
comment: 12 pages, 8 tables, 3 figures. Includes appendix
summary: Efficient long-term conversational memory requires retrieving sufficient evidence without indiscriminately expanding the context presented to the language model. This is challenging because relevant evidence may be distributed across multiple sessions, while compression may discard details needed for answering. Different queries therefore require different forms of memory access. To capture these demands, we formulate memory access along two dimensions: discovery breadth, which controls how broadly evidence is searched, and reading fidelity, which controls whether evidence is read in compact form or recovered from the original conversation. Based on this formulation, we introduce JustMem, which stores conversation history as compact atomic memories and adapts memory access along these two dimensions to each query. Specifically, LOOKUP handles local evidence, COMPOSE broadens discovery for distributed evidence, and REPLAY increases reading fidelity for fidelity-sensitive evidence. On LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, JustMem achieves the highest mean accuracy and retrieval recall among the compared memory systems while using substantially fewer generative-model tokens for memory construction and inference.

AI.tldr: JustMem提出了一种针对长对话记忆的自适应访问框架，通过"发现广度"和"阅读保真度"两个维度，根据查询需求在Lookup、Compose、Replay三种访问配置间动态分配记忆资源，以紧凑的原子记忆存储配合按需的源恢复机制，在显著降低生成token消耗的同时，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S基准上达到了最高的准确率和检索召回率。
AI.motivation: 现有长对话记忆系统采用相对固定的访问策略，难以同时应对局部证据、跨会话分布式证据以及保真度敏感证据三类不同需求：窄检索会遗漏信息，过度拓展又增加上下文成本和干扰项暴露。
AI.method: 将记忆访问分解为两个维度：(1)发现广度——控制候选证据搜索范围；(2)阅读保真度——控制是使用紧凑记忆还是回溯原始对话。基于此设计JustMem：会话被编码为带源链接的紧凑原子记忆卡；查询时由规划器预测证据需求，按规则映射到三种配置——Lookup用于局部证据，Compose通过多视图候选联合扩展发现广度，Replay通过源链接回溯原始对话以提升阅读保真度。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo上达到79.61%准确率和88.05% Recall@10，在LongMemEval-S上达到83.40%准确率和96.00% Recall@10，均优于FullText、Naive RAG、A-Mem、MemoryOS、SimpleMem、LightMem等基线，且构造和推理的生成token消耗最低（相比最强基线LightMem分别降低50.7%/64.9%和67.2%/55.7%）。消融实验验证：(H1)全局原子粒度比会话级打包检索准确率高10.72点；(H2)引导式扩展发现使聚合类查询准确率在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上分别提升9.04和12.76点；(H3)查询门控的自适应源恢复策略在保持保真度收益的同时将每问题token消耗从3967降至1155。跨基准迁移到LoCoMo-Plus的认知分割上仍保持62.59%准确率，显著优于最强基线31.67%，且性能下降幅度最小（17.02 vs 33.45–49.71点）。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，记忆访问应按查询需求自适应分配发现广度与阅读保真度：广义发现允许更多证据竞争同一紧凑读入预算，而选择性源恢复仅在压缩损失细节时引入。JustMem证明，更强的记忆性能无需更大的生成预算，核心原则是"发现足够广，阅读足够精"。

title: VākQA: A Benchmark and Evaluation Study for Telugu Spoken Factoid Question Answering
comment: Paper is accepted in IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Question answering has advanced rapidly with large language models, but predominantly for high-resource languages, in both text and spoken settings. Spoken question answering (SQA) benchmark for Telugu remains unexplored, and the reliability of automatic evaluation in this setting remains unquantified. We introduce VākQA, a Telugu SQA benchmark of 2,001 factoid question-answer pairs across six domains, with 2.53 hours of speech audio, bilingual transcriptions, and human-verified reference answers. We first validate evaluation methods against human judgements: Gemini-as-a-judge best approximates human ratings but is non-uniformly strict, while open-weight judges systematically penalize correct Telugu answers that differ in surface form from the reference. Using this validated setup, we benchmark proprietary and open-weight models across input modality, language, and domain. We observe that Telugu phrasing retains cultural specificity that is lost in translation, speech input introduces phonetic confusions that alter question meaning, and cascaded ASR-MT errors compound progressively. VākQA is publicly released.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了首个泰卢固语口语事实型问答基准VākQA（2,001条QA对，6个领域，2.53小时语音），并系统评估了LLM评判的可靠性及多种QA模型在不同输入模态、语言和级联ASR-MT管线下的表现。
AI.motivation: 泰卢固语作为低资源语言，其口语问答（SQA）基准尚未被探索，且现有自动评估指标在该场景下的可靠性也未被量化研究。本文旨在填补这一双重空白。
AI.method: 构建半自动VākQA数据流水线（YouTube采集→VAD分块→微调Seamless-large-v2 ASR→Gemini提取QA→Whisper-timestamped对齐→人工验证翻译）；基于100题400三元组人工评分校准评估方法；系统测试Gemini-2.5-Flash及多种开源模型（Gemma-3系列、Llama-3.1、Hex-1、Sarvam-m、Qwen-3-4B）在语音/文本、泰卢固语/英语、级联ASR→MT等多种配置下的表现，使用Spearman ρ、Kendall τ等指标对比LLM-as-a-judge与人类评分的相关性。
AI.result: 评估可靠性方面：Gemini-as-a-judge与人类评分相关性最高（ρ=0.86），但存在非均匀严格性（高分更严，低分更松）；开源Gemma-3评判器系统性惩罚表层形式不同的正确答案；EM、F1、BLASER-2.0与人类评分相关性均<0.5。QA基准方面：Gemini显著优于开源模型（oracle泰卢固语文本：3.63 vs Gemma-27B 2.55 vs Gemma-4B 1.43）；翻译为英文导致18.8%题目性能下降；语音输入因语音混淆使21.2%题目性能下降；级联ASR-MT错误累积，分数从3.63降至2.44-2.80；文化领域翻译后下降最显著（3.76→2.42），科学与地理领域跨语言迁移更稳定。
AI.conclusion: VākQA是首个泰卢固语SQA基准，对专有和开源模型均具挑战性；泰卢固语输入比英语翻译更好地保留语义范围和具体性；语音输入引入的语音混淆和级联ASR-MT错误会逐步损害QA性能；可靠评估仍是瓶颈——小型开源LLM评判器无法识别泰卢固语语义等价性，Gemini评判器也具有非均匀严格性，限制了在低资源语言SQA场景下的精细比较。

title: D-Quant: Driftable Entropy Coding for KV Cache Quantization
summary: The KV cache has become a major bottleneck in deploying LLMs, as its memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and batch size, imposing substantial pressure on both memory capacity and bandwidth. Among various KV cache compression techniques, quantization is particularly attractive due to its effectiveness and ease of deployment. However, most existing methods rely on fixed-width quantization, where a $b$ bit representation is inherently limited to $2^b$ quantization levels. As the bit width decreases, the number of available levels shrinks exponentially, leading to severe information loss and rapid performance degradation. We further observe that fixed-width quantization fails to exploit the highly non-uniform distribution of KV cache. After rotation and normalization, KV values approximately follow a normal distribution, with most values concentrated near the center and only a small fraction appearing in the tails. Nevertheless, fixed-width coding allocates the same number of bits to frequent and rare symbols. Entropy coding naturally exploits such non-uniformity by assigning shorter codewords to frequent symbols and longer ones to rare symbols, substantially reducing the average number of bits required for representation. However, its variable-length output is not suited to highly parallel attention kernels, where efficient dequantization and computation rely on regular memory layouts and fixed-stride accesses. To bridge this gap, we propose \textbf{D-Quant}, a flexible KV cache quantization framework that introduces a \textbf{drift} mechanism to convert entropy-coded representations of each token into fixed-size bitstreams, enabling regular memory access and parallel dequantization within attention kernels.

AI.tldr: D-Quant提出了一种基于熵编码和"drift"机制的KV Cache量化框架，通过将变长熵编码转换为定长比特流，在保持并行注意力计算效率的同时，显著降低KV Cache的内存占用并提升推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: LLM部署中KV Cache的内存和带宽开销随序列长度和批量大小线性增长，成为主要瓶颈。现有固定位宽量化方法在低比特下量化级别数指数级减少，导致信息严重丢失；且无法利用KV Cache近似正态分布的非均匀特性。熵编码虽能利用非均匀性分配码字，但其变长输出与注意力kernel的规则内存访问和并行解码需求不兼容。
AI.method: 1) 预处理阶段：对每个token的KV值应用Hadamard旋转，对Key额外做窗口化通道均值去除，再做token级仿射量化；2) 熵编码：采用rANS将量化符号编码到固定字节大小的容器中，概率模型直接由标准正态分布解析推导，无需校准数据；3) Drift机制：构建拉格朗日优化问题，在长度约束下最小化重建误差，通过二分搜索求解λ，仅对少量从高频符号向低频邻近符号"漂移"的符号做局部调整；4) 工程优化：基于token中心解码，将仿射变换折叠到注意力内积中，避免显式反量化；5) 概率锐化(α=1.4)以匹配drift后实际编码分布。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Llama-3.1-8B上，D-Quant以2.26 bits/value保持接近BF16精度（RULER平均86.50/88.94 vs BF16 87.31/89.69），128K上下文下大幅领先基线（如Qwen3-8B上70.92 vs 最佳基线57.14）；在1.96 bits更低预算下仍优于所有基线。KV Cache内存最高减少7倍，吞吐量最高提升3.5倍。匹配存储下KL散度约为固定位宽编码的1/2。
AI.conclusion: D-Quant通过将熵编码与定长容器约束相结合，解决了变长编码与并行注意力kernel不兼容的问题，同时解耦了量化级别数与位宽的固定关系，提供了灵活的存储-精度权衡，且完全无需校准。该工作为KV Cache压缩的编码格式层面开辟了新方向。

title: Evaluating Communicative Success in Machine-Translated Conversation
comment: 32 Pages, 11 Figures, 11 Tables
summary: Interpreter agents built on machine translation (MT) increasingly mediate live conversation between people who do not share a language, yet we still evaluate them with metrics built for isolated sentences, which measure fidelity rather than whether communication succeeds. We introduce a reusable three-layer checklist-and-judge framework that evaluates interpreter-mediated conversation across semantic, pragmatic, and cultural-social dimensions, covering the naturalness, intent, and social appropriateness that fidelity metrics leave unmeasured. It runs in both single-turn and interactive multi-turn settings, where simulated users reply to translated messages as the conversation unfolds and each turn is scored alongside the conversation as a whole. We extensively validate it through controlled perturbations, cross-judge comparisons, and human annotations. Our main single-turn benchmark evaluates 10 interpreter setups across Arabic, Bengali, Indonesian, and Korean from 5,624 OpenSubtitles-derived scenarios spanning 12 translation directions, and our multi-turn study covers all 6 language pairs in scripted and live modes. Results show a consistent decline from semantic to pragmatic and cultural-social success, while conventional MT metrics overlook failures among stronger interpreters, and prompt ablations show that scenario context, structured instructions, and cultural context improve communicative success, although gains vary across setups. Our work thus provides an evaluation framework and benchmark for interpreter agents in conversation, and highlights the importance of communicative success alongside existing translation metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于评估机器翻译驱动的口译代理在跨语言对话中交际成功的三层清单-评判框架(语义、语用、文化-社会),通过单轮和多轮设置、5,624个场景和10个翻译系统进行验证。结果显示所有系统均呈现从L1到L3的一致性能下降,且传统MT指标在强系统上几乎无法捕捉细粒度失败。
AI.motivation: 现有MT评估指标(BLEU、chrF、CometKiwi等)主要衡量单句翻译保真度,而口译代理需要传达交际意图、自然度和文化适当性——这些"保真度之外"的维度恰恰是翻译在对话场景中最容易失败的地方,尤其对于低资源、非英语中心语言对。
AI.method: 构建一个可复用的"清单-评判"评估流水线:从OpenSubtitles中筛选出5624个双向对话场景(阿语、孟加拉语、印尼语、韩语,12个方向),使用Gemini 3.1 Pro为每个场景生成三层(L1语义/L2语用/L3文化-社会)的二元检查清单;由LLM Judge对照译文、受众回应和对话上下文逐项打分。单轮基准测试10个翻译系统,多轮测试覆盖脚本和动态模式;通过输入Dropout、措辞改写、极性反转、人为植入违规四类对抗性测试以及跨评判器比较和人类标注进行广泛验证;并提出"配对特定文化语境"翻译简报作为改进翻译质量的干预手段。
AI.result: 1)所有10个系统在所有4种语言上都呈现稳定的L1→L2→L3逐层下降模式,这是本文的核心实证发现;2)CometKiwi、GEMBA-MQM、MQM-APE、RATE等MT指标在系统内部与交际得分相关性随系统能力上升而崩溃——在最强系统Gemini 3.1 Pro上这些指标的顶部四分位仍有10.3%–12.2%翻译通过率≤0.6,底部四分位有62.0%–69.6%通过率≥0.9;3)多轮对话的整体得分低于轮次级得分,说明轮次级准确不能保证对话成功;4)对话历史、场景上下文、结构化指令和文化语境均能改善翻译表现(直接无上下文36.4%→含文化语境51.3%);5)人类-评判器一致性从L1到L3递减,印证层次难度排序;6)Bangla作为源语言最难、Arabic作为源语言较易,两者在目标语角色上反转。
AI.conclusion: 本文贡献:1)一个经过对抗扰动、跨评判器协议和人类校准验证的三层清单-评判框架,涵盖单轮与多轮场景,且经验证明它捕获与现有MT度量正交的维度;2)一个可复用的数据到评估流水线,包括5620个增强对话场景和来自6个语对的56240个真实系统输出;3)一个配对特定的文化语境,既改善清单质量与评判可靠性,又改善翻译简报中的口译输出。论文的总体意义在于提出并通过实证确立了"交际成功"作为独立于翻译保真度的评估维度的重要性,强调MT评估应从单句忠实度扩展到对话中的意图、自然度和社会适当性。

title: Generalization through Lexical Abstraction in Transformer Models: The Case of Functional Words
comment: 16 pages, 11 figures
summary: Pronouns, adverbs and other functional words (such as they, her, somewhere, there) are often used in language to replace concrete nouns or phrases, when their properties - such as gender, grammatical number - provide sufficient information for the given context. Do pretrained transformer models encode such functional words in a manner that allows them to be used like humans do? Can language models recognize the syntactic and semantic parallelism of sentences such as "The researchers wrote the paper" and "They wrote it", which relies on such lexical abstraction? We map these linguistic questions into the embedding space of a pretrained transformer model, and compare representations of nouns, with the representations of the pronouns and adverbs that can replace these nouns, in isolation and in parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We then probe for shared syntactic and semantic structure in the embeddings of parallel lexicalized and functional sentences. We find that functional words are located centrally compared to nouns, but are also distinct, which is congruent with their behaviour as place-holders in a wide variety of contexts. The analysis of the embeddings of parallel (lexicalized and functional) sentences show them inhabiting different subspaces of the embedding space. Experiments that distil the structural information of the sentence show that training on either type of data does not reveal the shared structure - because of the over-consistency of the vocabulary (in case of the functional data), and the too much variety (in case of the lexicalized versions). However, training with a mix of functional and lexicalized sentences, the shared structure emerges.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨预训练Transformer模型是否编码了功能词（代词、副词等）作为名词占位符的语法抽象能力。研究通过分析词嵌入和句嵌入，发现功能词在嵌入空间中位置居中但又与名词区分明显；虽然功能化与词汇化句子的嵌入看似占据不同子空间，但通过变分编码器-解码器对比学习探测发现，混合训练可揭示两者共享的句法-语义结构。
AI.motivation: 功能词（代词、副词如they,her,somewhere,there）在语言中常作为名词或介词短语的占位符使用，体现了词汇抽象能力。研究者希望探究预训练Transformer模型是否以类似人类的方式捕获了这种词汇抽象特性，即能否识别"The researchers wrote the paper"与"They wrote it"之间的句法-语义平行结构。现有对模型泛化能力的评估往往偏技术视角而缺乏语言学视角，本文从语言学的抽象与泛化角度切入。
AI.method: 1）基于Levin动词交替分类（变化状态COS和宾语省略OD），使用Blackbird Language Matrices（BLM）框架构建合成数据集，包含词汇化（Lex）与功能化（Fun）两种版本，以及三种词汇变化等级（type I/II/III）。2）使用Electra预训练模型获取词与句嵌入，通过t-SNE和UMAP进行二维可视化分析。3）使用变分编码器-解码器配合对比学习，将句子压缩到5维潜在层，探测共享的句法-语义结构。4）构建两步VAE BLM求解器，在合并任务上检验跨训练设置的泛化能力。对比单独训练Fun、单独训练Lex与混合训练三种条件。
AI.result: 1）功能词在嵌入空间中位于中心位置但与名词有区分，符合其作为广泛占位符的预期。2）词汇化与功能化句子的嵌入占据不同子空间，表层相似度低。3）单独在Fun或Lex数据上训练的变分模型无法跨类型泛化（Fun→Lex F1约0.40，Lex→Fun F1约0.22-0.49），但混合训练在两种测试集上均达到高F1（Fun: 0.98, Lex: 0.92）。4）潜在层表征可视化显示混合训练产生了重叠聚类，表明发现了共享结构。5）BLM任务求解实验（type III最大词汇变化）证实：单独训练模型跨类型测试性能骤降，混合训练则保持稳定高性能，验证了句法-语义结构在功能化与词汇化变体间以复杂但可检测的方式被类似地编码。
AI.conclusion: 预训练Transformer语言模型确实以某种方式编码了功能词的抽象占位符特性：功能词嵌入在空间中心但保持区别性，反映其作为多语境占位符的行为。词汇化与功能化句子的嵌入虽位于不同子空间，但深层的句法-语义结构可通过变分探测与对比学习揭示。混合训练能促使模型发现跨变体的共享结构，表明抽象与泛化能力可在模型中被激发，但这种编码比表层余弦相似度所显示的更为复杂。研究为语言模型的词汇抽象能力提供了基于语言学的证据。

title: Before the Arrest: Benchmarking LLMs on Criminal Profiling from Incomplete Evidence
comment: Accepted by EMNLP 2026 Findings. Codes are available at: this https URL
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly applied to legal and criminal justice tasks, yet existing work focuses almost exclusively on post-arrest scenarios where the suspect's identity is already known, leaving the critical pre-arrest challenge of inferring suspect characteristics from incomplete evidence largely unexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce the Profiling, Investigation, and Judgment (PIJ), comprising 2,500 real homicide cases from five countries. PIJ evaluates LLMs across three tasks that span the entire criminal investigation pipeline: criminal profiling, which requires abductive reasoning to infer suspect attributes from fragmentary scene evidence, crime process reconstruction, which tests structured information extraction, and sentence prediction, which demands legal deductive reasoning. We evaluate 9 powerful LLMs and find that performance degrades systematically as tasks shift from explicit fact extraction to implicit reasoning over unknown suspect profiles. Categories requiring inferential reasoning, such as motivation and victim-offender relationships, remain the primary bottlenecks. Further analysis reveals substantial gaps between LLMs and human experts, along with pervasive biases in gender, age, and motive attribution. Our findings indicate that pre-arrest inference from incomplete evidence remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PIJ基准,包含2500个真实凶杀案,用于评估LLM在犯罪调查全流程中的表现,涵盖嫌疑人画像、案件过程重建和量刑预测三个任务,发现LLM在溯因推理和细粒度法律判断上存在系统性差距,并存在性别、年龄、动机偏见。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在法律和刑事司法任务的研究几乎完全集中在逮捕后阶段(已知嫌疑人身份),忽略了逮捕前从碎片化证据推断嫌疑人特征的关键挑战,需要系统性地评估LLM在此类高风险场景中的能力。
AI.method: 构建PIJ基准(2500个真实凶杀案,来自5国),基于犯罪学理论(表达型/工具型凶杀、日常活动理论、生命历程犯罪学)设计三阶段任务(画像/重建/量刑);评估9个LLM在零样本、少样本和CoT提示下的表现,结合人类专家标注进行对比,并分析性别、年龄、动机偏见。
AI.result: 1) LLM在事实提取类任务表现较好,但在需要溯因推理的画像任务上F1普遍低于50%,动机和受害人与嫌疑人关系类别是主要瓶颈;2) DeepSeek-V4-Pro和Gemini-3-Flash整体最优;3) DeepSeek启用深度思考反而降低性能(幻觉放大);4) LLM与人类专家存在显著差距(人类画像65.32 vs LLM最佳51.38,量刑90.73 vs 65.87);5) 几乎所有LLM存在90%以上将未知性别误判为男性的偏见,并普遍低估嫌疑人年龄。
AI.conclusion: 逮捕前从不完整证据进行推理仍是LLM的开放性挑战;LLM在溯因推理、细粒度法律判断方面存在系统性能力差距,并存在性别、年龄、动机的偏见;不应将LLM作为真实案件调查中的自主决策工具,该基准仅用于诊断弱点和指导未来改进。

authors: et al. (492 additional authors not shown)
title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: Pushing the Limits of KV Cache Compression
summary: The widespread adoption of long-horizon agents has made model workloads increasingly input-heavy. Although prior work has substantially reduced the cost of long-context computation, prefill remains computationally expensive, and large KV caches continue to strain HBM and SSD capacity and data-transfer bandwidth. Together, these compute, storage, and bandwidth demands constitute the primary bottleneck to further lowering deployment costs. To address this challenge, we introduce DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 552B backbone parameters and support for contexts of up to one million tokens. With its Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) architecture, the model activates 16B parameters per token during decode but only 8B parameters during prefill, substantially improving cost efficiency for agentic workloads. To push the limits of KV cache compression, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash combines cross-layer KV cache reuse in Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) with FP4 KV caching. These designs reduce its global KV cache footprint (always in HBM) to 890 bytes per token, roughly 1/4 of the corresponding footprint of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Further, through a dedicated deployment optimization known as SWA Bounded Replay, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash reduces its persistent KV cache footprint (always on SSD or in host memory) to roughly 1/8 of that of DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Despite its much smaller KV cache footprint, the model delivers substantially better performance than the baseline. In addition, we streamline the DeepSeek-V4 architecture and introduce several efficient architectural extensions. We pretrain DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on a multimodal corpus comprising 45T tokens and conduct comprehensive post-training, yielding strong performance across diverse text-based and multimodal agentic scenarios. Model checkpoints are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 是一个552B参数的多模态MoE模型，通过Causal Encoder-Decoder (CED) 架构、Compressed Sparse Attention 2 (CSA2) 跨层KV复用、FP4 KV缓存和SWA Bounded Replay部署优化，将全局KV缓存压缩至每token 890字节（约为V4-Flash的1/4），持久化KV缓存压缩至1/8，同时在agentic、推理和多模态任务上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 长horizon智能体工作负载日益以输入密集型为主，prefill计算昂贵且KV缓存在HBM/SSD容量与带宽方面成为主要瓶颈，进一步降低KV缓存占用对降低长上下文部署成本至关重要。
AI.method: 核心方法包括：(1) CED架构将40层网络分为20层因果编码器和20层解码器，解码器全局KV由编码器隐藏状态投影得到，prefill仅激活8B参数，decode激活16B参数；(2) CSA2引入Full/Reindex/Reuse三种模式跨层共享全局KV和indexer K；(3) FP4 (MXFP4/NVFP4风格) 主KV缓存量化；(4) SWA Bounded Replay仅回放最近n_win个token以重构SWA KV，避免存储；(5) 训练侧采用head-wise Muon、Sinkhorn-balanced embedding更新、阴影indexer、跨阶段共享状态管理；(6) RL阶段引入标量reasoning effort b∈[1,100]通过指数衰减的token惩罚控制推理强度。
AI.result: 相比V4-Flash-Base，V4.1-Flash-Base以更少的激活参数（8B/16B vs 13B）和更小的KV占用取得相当或更优的世界知识、推理和编码性能；在agentic任务上DeepSWE v1.1达到74.2%（超过Opus-5和GPT-5.6），Terminal-Bench 2.1达90.6%，Codeforces评分3471；多智能体配置在ProgramBench和FrontierSWE v2上均优于单智能体基线；reasoning effort从25提升到100平均Pass@1提升约9个点，代价约2.5倍输出token。
AI.conclusion: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash通过架构、缓存精度和部署策略的联合优化，将KV缓存压缩推向新极限，在显著降低部署成本的同时在推理和agentic任务上匹配或超越前沿闭源模型，为长horizon智能体的大规模部署提供了高性价比方案，并作为未来模型扩展的新起点。

title: Design of the IBM Granite 5.0 TurboCTC ASR Model
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, submitted to ICASSP 2027
summary: We describe the architecture, training methodology and inference speedups of Granite 5.0 Turbo CTC, a 470 million parameter encoder-only model with an excellent speed-accuracy tradeoff. The architecture uses pyramidal temporal subsampling within Conformer blocks using strided depthwise convolutions, block-diagonal (chunk-wise) self-attention, and conditioning on intermediate predictions from the middle layer. Training highlights are the use of only publicly available data, the novel use of a Muon optimizer, and balanced data sampling. Inference speedups include replacing 1 x 1 convolutions with linear layers and optimizing the attention computation in the Conformer blocks. Collectively, these result in a model that is on the speed-accuracy Pareto frontier of the Open ASR leaderboard for English short-form ASR while being twice as fast as the fastest competitor. The model can be used under a permissive license and downloaded from this https URL .

AI.tldr: IBM 发布 Granite 5.0 TurboCTC 语音识别模型，4.7 亿参数编码器结构，结合 Conformer 金字塔时序下采样、分块自注意力与自条件机制，配合 MuonP 优化器、LLM 蒸馏与鲁棒微调，在 OpenASR Leaderboard 上以两倍推理速度位居速度-精度 Pareto 前沿。
AI.motivation: 尽管将 LLM 集成到 ASR 中可获得更强的能力，但 LLM 带来的高内存占用与自回归生成限制了推理速度。论文回归 encoder-only Conformer + CTC 路线，致力于在保持高精度的同时实现极快的推理速度，构建速度-精度权衡最佳的 ASR 模型。
AI.method:
架构：16 层 Conformer，hidden=1024；采用 1) 第一、二个 Conformer 块内的 stride-2 深度可分离卷积实现金字塔时序下采样（总 8×）；2) 块对角（chunk-wise）自注意力（块大小 128）；3) 中间层（8 层）CTC 输出的自条件机制，与最终层 CTC 损失按 0.2/0.8 加权。
训练：约 60k 小时公开英语数据 + 合成数据，三阶段训练——CTC 基模型（MuonP 优化器 + Polar Express 正交化、OneCycleLR、平衡采样 α=0.8、SpecAugment + 噪声增强）→ Granite-4.1-8B-base LLM 蒸馏（4 层 AED 解码器，KL 散度）→ 多条件鲁棒微调（速度扰动 + 噪声/混响/带宽/编解码扰动，干净与失真视图加权损失 + 参数插值 γ=0.4）。
推理加速：用 Linear 层替换 1×1 深度可分离卷积；优化 Conformer 注意力计算，使用 PyTorch EFFICIENT_ATTENTION 后端。
AI.result: 在 OpenASR Leaderboard 英语短音频任务上，5.83% 平均 WER；推理速度（RTFx）从基线 9229 提升至 13715，加速约 49%，是当时速度最快的模型，且精度不损失。LLM 蒸馏将平均 WER 由 5.83% 降至 5.75%；鲁棒微调进一步降至 5.72%。在嘈杂与远场 ASR 榜单上进入前 10 且保持最高推理速度。
AI.conclusion: 通过架构（时序下采样、分块注意力、自条件）、训练（MuonP、LLM 蒸馏、鲁棒微调）和推理优化（Linear 替代 1×1 卷积、高效注意力内核）三方面协同设计，可在 encoder-only CTC 框架下获得 SOTA 速度-精度权衡。该模型以宽松许可证开源，可直接下载使用。

title: Fine-Tuning Models for Biomedical Relation Extraction
summary: Next-Generation Sequencing has revolutionized the study of genetic mutations, enabling large-scale investigations into their roles in disease development. However, extracting meaningful insights from the vast amount of biomedical literature remains a complex challenge that cannot be addressed manually. In this paper, we present pre-trained models (PTMs) for the automatic extraction of relations from biomedical text, specifically targeting the variant-phenotype domain. Our evaluation on the SNPPhenA corpus demonstrates that fine-tuning small BERT-based models, particularly DeBERTa, yields strong performance, approaching the current state-of-the-art (SOTA). Additionally, our results indicate that carefully fine-tuning Google's Gemini Pro 1.0 outperforms the existing SOTA for both sentence-level tasks (where the model processes only the target sentence) and abstract-level tasks (where the model processes the entire abstract).

AI.tldr: 本文针对生物医学文本中的variant-phenotype关系抽取问题，研究了基于预训练模型（包括DeBERTa和Gemini Pro 1.0）的自动抽取方法，并在SNPPhenA语料库上进行评估。结果表明微调小型BERT模型（尤其是DeBERTa）可接近现有最优性能，而精心微调的Gemini Pro 1.0在句子级和摘要级任务上均超越现有SOTA。
AI.motivation: 下一代测序技术（NGS）产生了海量生物医学文献，使得手动提取变异-表型关系变得不可行；因此需要自动化的关系抽取方法以从生物医学文本中获取有意义的基因变异相关洞见。
AI.method: 1. 采用预训练模型（PTMs）进行生物医学文本中的关系抽取；2. 在SNPPhenA语料库上进行评估；4. 任务涵盖句子级（仅处理目标句子）和摘要级（处理整个摘要）两种设置；3. 方法包括：(a) 对小型BERT类模型（如DeBERTa）进行微调；(b) 对Google Gemini Pro 1.0大语言模型进行精细微调。
AI.result: 1. 微调DeBERTa等小型BERT模型在variant-phenotype关系抽取任务上性能强劲，接近当前最优水平（SOTA）；2. 经过精心微调的Google Gemini Pro 1.0在句子级和摘要级任务上均优于现有SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 预训练语言模型（无论是小型BERT类模型还是大型LLM如Gemini Pro 1.0）经过恰当微调，均可有效用于生物医学变异-表型关系抽取，其中Gemini Pro 1.0在SNPPhenA基准上取得了新的最优性能，验证了LLM在此类生物医学关系抽取任务中的潜力。

title: To Copy or Not to Copy: Controlling Speculative Decoding via Intrinsic Model Signals
summary: Speculative Decoding (SD) has significantly accelerated Large Language Model (LLM) inference, yet existing approaches face a fundamental tradeoff between two drafting strategies: neural drafting and context-based copying. Neural drafts (e.g., EAGLE3) provide robust performance across diverse text settings, while copy-based methods achieve higher speedups in copy-intensive regimes by generating candidates faster and exploiting long repetition spans for near-perfect speculation. We analyze existing copy-based methods and find that they are prone to accidental repetitions where surface-level n-gram overlap does not reflect a structural intent to copy, leading to false-positive triggers that ultimately degrade throughput. We introduce SwitchSD, an adaptive framework that treats copying as a latent control signal of the LLM. By training lightweight probes on the target model's internal representations, SwitchSD identifies genuine copy-intent with high precision (AUC > 0.99). This allows the system to dynamically switch between neural drafting (e.g., EAGLE) and context-based copying. Our results across Llama and Qwen families demonstrate throughput gains of up to 15% over state-of-the-art baselines like EAGLE3, effectively turning copying from a noisy heuristic into a principled, model-aware decoding regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwitchSD，一种基于LLM内部隐藏表示的自适应推测解码框架，通过训练轻量级线性探针识别"复制意图"，动态切换神经起草与上下文复制策略，解决了现有复制启发式方法因偶然重复导致吞吐量下降的问题，在Llama和Qwen系列上实现比EAGLE3最高15%的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 推测解码（SD）面临神经起草与上下文复制两种策略的权衡：神经起草（如EAGLE3）在多样文本上稳健，而复制方法在复制密集场景下加速更显著。但现有基于n-gram重叠的复制方法（如CopySpec）无法区分真正的复制意图与偶然重复（如数学推理中变量名的巧合复用），导致大量误触发，产生"推测税"，反而降低吞吐量。作者认为复制不是表面现象，而是由模型内部表征中的潜在控制信号驱动。
AI.method: SwitchSD包含三个核心组件：（1）复制意图探针——在目标模型中间层（如Llama-3.1-8B的第14层）注意力子层后的隐藏表示上训练严格的线性投影（二分类），使用Claude Sonnet生成的1000个具有多样化重复结构的提示构成CopyDiversity数据集，通过模型自生成补全提取隐藏表征与标签（连续≥5个token的逐字重复标记为copy-mode）；（2）动态切换机制——解码时，若探针分数超过F1最优阈值τ且当前上下文存在κ-gram（κ=5）匹配，则启用基于复制的推测（从上下文检索W=10个长度为D=20的候选，按最近性排序，通过块三角注意力并行验证），否则回退到神经起草（EAGLE3或SPS）；（3）KV缓存惰性传播——在下一步前向传播中同步接受的token，以摊销同步开销。探针训练后具有AUC>0.99的近完美线性可分性。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.1-8B、Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen3-8B三个模型上，针对HumanEval（代码）、Math500（数学推理）、CNN/DM（摘要）三个基准测试：SwitchSD在全部9个配置上均取得最高吞吐量，平均加速比HumanEval 2.31×、Math500 2.03×、CNN/DM 1.83×；比EAGLE3最高提升15%；比BanditSpec等统计自适应方法显著更优（如Llama-70B Math500上1.48× vs BanditSpec的0.99×）；关键特征是"少而精"——触发复制频率更低但平均接受长度显著更高（如HumanEval Llama-3.1-8B上17.9%触发率对应5.39平均接受长度 vs CopySpec的30.3%/2.09）；探针激活时30.0%轨迹达到最大推测长度20 token，未激活时仅4.7%；高温度（T=1.0）下仍保持1.54×加速比。
AI.conclusion: SwitchSD确立了推测解码中"潜在感知编排"的新方向，证明模型内部表征可提供高精度"白盒"控制信号以切换解码模式，在保持生成质量的同时实现最高15%的EAGLE3改进。复制意图被证明是残差流中的一阶可线性分离特征，与注意力驱动的归纳电路相关。探针架构可扩展为多模态编排器，用于预测最优推测长度或选择专业起草模型，机制可解释性研究有望进一步精细化此类探针，缩小Transformer内部理论理解与低延迟推理实际需求之间的差距。

title: Foundations of Stochastic Lexical Calculus: Semantic Descent and Random Dynamics on Probability Simplices
summary: Large language models produce prompt-dependent probabilities over words, whereas scientific systems require uncertainty over meaningful states that can be updated as evidence arrives. We develop an observable framework for determining when language-derived probabilities support such a sequential state representation. Theoretically, we define typed measurable transformations of contextual language, construct a minimal closed representation, and give necessary and sufficient conditions for semantic updates to exist uniquely. We bound irreducible nonclosure and accumulated error, and under average contraction prove existence, uniqueness and stability of an external random recursion on a probability simplex. These results define a stochastic lexical calculus without attributing an internal calculus to the language model. Empirically, frozen experiments test the observable implications. Raw prompt-conditioned probabilities fail the prespecified invariance gate; after prompt-specific calibration, a common three-state representation passes the stability gates and covers 28 of 30 untouched eight-step paths, or 0.933 at nominal level 0.90. Accordingly, language probabilities support a stochastic state only conditionally on verified closure, stability and coverage within a declared operating domain.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个"随机词汇演算"框架，定义了语言模型输出的提示相关词概率何时能支持一个可作为科学状态递归更新的语义状态表示。理论上构造了规范最小闭表示，给出了语义下降（semantic descent）的充要条件，并在平均收缩条件下证明了概率单纯形上外部随机递归的存在性、唯一性和同步性。实验上原始提示核未能通过不变性门限，但经提示特定校准后的三态表示通过了稳定性门限，在标称0.90水平下对30条未触及八步路径覆盖了28条（0.933）。
AI.motivation: 语言模型产生的词级概率随提示变化而波动，而科学系统需要对有意义的"状态"进行不确定性估计并随证据更新。现有研究虽建立了语言衍生不确定性的实用性，但遗留一个先验数学问题未解决：语言的概率值摘要何时能保留后续信息变换所需的全部区分度？若不满足闭合性，逐次摘要便无法构成状态过程，即使单次摘要已校准良好。
AI.method:
方法分为理论与实证两部分：
1. 理论：定义类型化可测上下文变换系统、可观察词汇核 K 及语义映射 Π→Δ^{K-1}；构造规范行为签名 S*（未来行为商）作为最小闭表示；通过纤维保持（fibre preservation）刻画精确下降的充要条件（定理3.1），并以变换纤维直径 ω_T* 给出近似下降的不可约误差下界（定理3.3，定理3.4给出多步离散Gronwall传播界）；在平均收缩假设 E log L(Ξ_0) < 0 下，利用遍历迭代随机函数理论证明因果存在性、唯一性及同步性（定理4.7），并给出扰动界（定理4.8）；用等距对数比（ILR）坐标实现单纯形状态的基不变性。
2. 实证：冻结的三态隐马尔可夫实验（risk-on / mixed / risk-off），两种信息等价提示构造，6个词汇证据符号，每路径8步更新；测试原始核与提示特定仿射校准后的Jensen-Shannon不变性门限、路径保形覆盖；预冻结所有门限与划分。
AI.result:
1. 完整词汇过程测试：观测候选质量、最小奇异值（2.96e-16，失败）、平均对数收缩率（χ=-0.1686，通过）、收敛斜率（含零，失败）、均匀路径恢复（0.91，通过）、逐项扰动界（通过）。
2. 原始顺序滤波器：路径覆盖率36/40=0.90（通过），但跨提示最大JS=0.13397超过冻结门限0.10，原始提示核不满足信息不变性。
3. 提示特定校准后：跨提示平均/最大JS=0.001122/0.010720，通过门限；30条未触及八步路径中28条被冻结保形半径0.190669覆盖，经验覆盖率0.933（标称0.90，通过）。
AI.conclusion: 本文为语言衍生概率提供可观察的框架，回答"概率解释何时可作为状态而非仅作为评分"。结论是状态必须在校准之外还满足（近似）闭合性，即在所声明的变换下纤维保持。校准、行为分离、闭合性、最小性四个要求不可互相替代。实证表明原始词汇核未通过门限，但提示特定校准后的三态表示在冻结域内通过全部声明门限，支持一个有限范围的正向陈述。该工作不主张语言模型内部存在贝叶斯机制，而是陈述了外部可观察语言衍生表示能够合法支持随机状态递归的数学与经验条件。

title: Before the Warning Comes Too Late: Incremental Phone-Scam Detection from Speech
summary: We study weakly supervised incremental telecom fraud detection from raw telephone audio, where training provides only conversation-level labels and predictions must be updated before a call ends. We introduce StreamFraudNet, which processes incoming audio through overlapping bounded-context windows using a frozen self-supervised speech encoder, recurrent temporal modeling, and learned aggregation of latent window scores. On a controlled English benchmark, StreamFraudNet achieves a ROC--AUC of \(0.9953\), significantly outperforming acoustic and mean-pooling baselines while remaining competitive with strong global temporal models. The model produces its first prediction after 10 seconds of audio, updates every 2 seconds, and operates faster than real time on the evaluated server hardware. Ablations identify recurrent temporal context as the principal contributor to performance. These results demonstrate that fraud risk can be scored incrementally from raw speech without transcripts or temporal annotations, while highlighting the need for latency-aware training to improve early prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出StreamFraudNet,一种基于原始电话音频的弱监督增量式欺诈检测模型,采用冻结的自监督语音编码器、循环时序建模和潜在窗口分数聚合,可在通话结束前实时输出欺诈风险评分。
AI.motivation: 电信诈骗造成巨大经济损失,且具有时效性。现有方法多依赖ASR转录、大模型或细粒度标注,难以在通话进行中实时预警。本文旨在探索仅利用对话级二分类标签,从原始音频进行增量式欺诈风险评分。
AI.method: StreamFraudNet架构:将音频切分为重叠的有界上下文窗口,通过冻结的Wav2Vec2编码器提取特征,采用注意力池化形成chunk级表示,用BiLSTM建模窗口内时序依赖,再由可学习的注意力聚合器将所有已观测窗口分数融合为对话级评分。训练仅使用对话级BCE损失,无需时间戳标注。默认配置:5个chunk窗口、步长1、chunk时长2秒,首次预测在10秒后,每2秒更新一次。
AI.result: 在合成英语基准上ROC-AUC达0.9953,显著优于声学和均值池化基线,与强BiLSTM-attention全局模型相当;在10秒音频时已达0.9532 AUC。Mandarin TeleAntiFraud-28K上准确率0.7131,接近Qwen2-Audio ASR-text。组件分析表明循环时序上下文是关键贡献因素。端到端RTF<0.05,支持服务器和CPU实时推理。
AI.conclusion: StreamFraudNet证明了仅凭原始语音和对话级标签即可实现增量式欺诈风险评分,但有界窗口主要支持高频更新而非提升离线精度。窗口级分数表现为潜在风险指标而非精确的欺诈定位。未来需引入延迟感知训练以改善早期检测。

title: The Public Discourse Corpus (PDC): A Speaker-Attributed Dataset for Valence and Epistemic Modality with Target Speaker Participation
comment: 16 pages, 1 figure
summary: We introduce the \textbf{Public Discourse Corpus (PDC)}, the first dataset of public-figure interview speech jointly annotated for affective valence and epistemic modality. The corpus contains 998 videos from 100 speakers across seven professional domains, yielding 186,642 sentences (3.1 million words) after sentence segmentation and filtering. To ensure that all retained videos contain analyzable speech from the intended speaker, we introduce \textbf{Target Speaker Participation (TSP)}---a five-category annotation taxonomy with documented inter-annotator reliability ($\kappa = 0.616$)---as a key methodological contribution that any corpus construction project can adopt. Target-speaker turns are separated from interviewer and third-party speech through an \textbf{audio-first diarization pipeline} combining local Whisper ASR with pyannote speaker separation, released as an open-source implementation. We release the annotated corpus, the annotation tools, the cross-provider validation sample, and the complete processing pipeline. The dataset is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了公共话语语料库（PDC），这是首个对公众人物访谈语音同时标注情感效价（valence）和认知情态（epistemic modality）的说话人归属数据集。语料库包含来自7个专业领域的100位发言人的998个视频，共186,642个句子（约310万词）。论文的核心方法论贡献包括：（1）目标发言人参与度（TSP）五类标注体系，用于验证自动检索的视频中确实包含目标发言人的可分析语音（Cohen's κ=0.616）；（2）基于音频的说话人分离流水线，结合本地Whisper ASR与pyannote说话人分离技术，以开源形式发布。语料库标注使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash进行零样本双维度分类，并通过GPT-5.5在1%分层样本（N=1863）上进行跨提供商验证（效价κ=0.63，情态κ=0.53）。释放内容包括标注语料库、标注工具、跨提供商验证样本及完整处理流水线。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学日益依赖NLP技术在大规模上测量心理和修辞构念（如情感、确定性、情绪、立场），现有公共话语语料库要么只提供情感标签，要么只提供情态标签，缺乏在相同说话人归属语句上同时标注两个维度的资源。此外，从YouTube自动构建语料库时存在严重的内容归属污染问题——约47%的检索结果是关于目标人物的第三方内容（新闻报道、纪录片旁白等），而非包含其本人语音的访谈。
AI.method: 四阶段语料库构建流水线：（1）数据收集——通过yt-dlp检索100位发言人的候选人视频，按7个专业领域分层抽样；（2）TSP标注——五类分类法（TSP-0目标缺席、TSP-1被引用对象、TSP-2多方讨论、TSP-3唯一受访者访谈、TSP-4独白演讲），仅保留TSP-2/3/4；（3）基于音频的说话人分离——使用faster-whisper large-v3进行ASR，结合pyannote/speaker-diarization-3.1进行声学说话人分离，通过基于规则的决策树识别目标发言人；（4）基于LLM的标注——使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash进行情感效价（正面/中性/负面）和认知情态（强调/中性/犹豫）的零样本双维度分类。
AI.result: 最终语料库包含998个视频、100位发言人、186,642个句子（约310万词），平均每句16.7词。效价分布略偏负面（34.7%负面 vs 24.9%正面），情态以中性为主（58.0%）。TSP标注在188个视频上的Cohen's κ为0.616（五分类）和0.690（二分类包含/排除）。本地流水线与AssemblyAI在212个文件上的转录一致性较强（Jaccard 0.706，84.1%词重叠）。跨提供商标注协议（DeepSeek vs GPT-5.5，N=1863）显示效价一致性75.9%（κ=0.63），情态一致性72.5%（κ=0.53）。示例分析显示正向陈述比负向陈述更可能具有强调性质（φ=0.191 vs 0.140）。
AI.conclusion: PDC填补了公共话语语料库中同时标注效价与情态的空白，使先前不可能的大规模研究（关于评价性语言与认知承诺的交互）成为可能。TSP分类法作为一种可复用的方法论贡献，解决了从媒体来源构建语料库时普遍存在的"关于某人 vs. 某人发声"的内容归属问题。基于音频的说话人分离流水线为说话人归属提供了比纯文本启发式更强的证据。本文的局限性包括：本地流水线的说话人归属准确性尚未直接通过人工评估验证；LLM标注可靠性仅在两个提供商的小样本上验证；语料库仅限于YouTube英文内容，可能无法推广至具有不同情态标记系统的语言。

title: Viveka-Insight: a cross-lingual concept graph and citation-grounded retrieval resource over the complete works of Swami Vivekananda in English and Bengali
summary: Classical philosophical corpora pose three compounding challenges for language resources: they exist in several languages without parallel alignment, their vocabulary is remote from that of contemporary readers, and generated text over culturally sensitive material must be verifiably grounded. We present Viveka-Insight, a bilingual resource and open-source pipeline for the works of Swami Vivekananda (1863-1902): the nine-volume English Complete Works and the ten-volume Bengali Vani o Rachana, two related but non-parallel corpora of about 15 million characters. Four layers are released: (i) a structure-preserving parse (32,694 paragraphs, 168,842 sentences) with per-paragraph anchors deep-linking into the published editions; (ii) a cross-lingual concept graph of 8,362 language-agnostic concepts with 87,518 relation-typed paragraph-concept and 55,872 concept-concept edges, in which canonical English labels act as a string-equality key linking Bengali and English passages with no parallel data; (iii) a bilingual alias inventory of 60,850 surface forms (30,053 English, 30,797 Bengali); and (iv) a human-annotated set of 200 paragraph-concept edges judged by three annotators, released with all per-annotator judgments. We report known-item cross-lingual retrieval over 194 verified rendered lecture pairs (Recall@10 0.86 in both directions), a 30-question audit of citation integrity and modern-question bridging, and a human study placing concept-extraction precision at 0.60 under strict two-annotator consensus (Cohen's kappa = 0.61). The extractor's confidence weight is calibrated: restricting to weight >= 0.8 raises precision to 0.71 while retaining 98% of concept-bearing paragraphs. Precision is markedly lower in Bengali than English (0.54 vs 0.68), locating the weakness in exactly the half that cross-lingual access depends on. The design transfers to other multilingual classical corpora.

AI.tldr: Viveka-Insight 是一个针对 Swami Vivekananda 全集（英文 9 卷《Complete Works》与孟加拉文 10 卷《Vani o Rachana》，约 1500 万字符）的双语语言学资源与开源流水线，包含四层结构：结构化解析、跨语言概念图（8,362 个概念）、双语别名表（60,850 个表面形式）以及 200 条人工标注的评估样本。其核心创新在于：以规范英文小写连写标签作为字符串相等键，在无平行语料的前提下实现非平行双语语料的跨语言链接；并通过概念介导的检索路径与"时代桥接"机制，使现代问题能够映射到 19 世纪的合适词汇。所有生成的回答均携带可深链到原始段落锚点的引文标记，并由后处理删除任何伪造引文。
AI.motivation: 古典哲學語料面臨三重複合挑戰：(1) 多語種但無平行對齊；(2) 詞彙遠離當代讀者（如"smartphone addiction"在1902年的語料中根本不存在）；(3) 涉及文化敏感材料，生成文本必須可驗證地溯源（grounding）。傳統密集檢索器在詞彙鴻溝下表現欠佳，且對宗教人物虛構陳述的容錯性極低。該工作旨在為 Vivekananda 雙語非平行語料構建一個可維護、可審計、可跨語言檢索的概念層資源。
AI.method: 構建流水線分四階段：(1) 結構感知解析器從已發佈 HTML 版本恢復 volume→chapter→paragraph→sentence 層次，保留每段 HTML 錨點以支持深鏈接；(2) 用 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct（vLLM 服務）對每段做單次概念抽取，強制概念標籤為英文小寫連寫規範形式（canonical English, lowercase, hyphenated），使標籤本身成為跨語言鍵——孟語段與英語段通過字符串相等掛載到同一節點；(3) 標籤嵌入聚類（cosine≥0.92）合併近義變體，並構建 similar（cosine≥0.78, top-12）和 co-occurs（同段共現≥2次）兩種概念-概念邊；(4) NFC 標準化文本作為唯一鍵，支持增量重建（10–15 分鐘）。檢索端：所有單元用 BGE-M3 嵌入 1024 維共享空間，存為精確內積 FAISS 索引；兩條路徑——直接路徑（句/段/章三粒度）與概念介導路徑（概念標籤索引 + 1-hop 圖遊走）——經加權 RRF 融合後由多語言 cross-encoder 重排。QA 端三階段：(1) 分析與橋接——從概念索引取最近 15 個標籤，LLM 從中選 2–6 個（強約束防幻覺）並產出"永恆化"改寫與橋接說明；(2) 用原問題與改寫並行檢索並對原問題重排；(3) 用 Qwen2.5-7B 生成學術性第三人稱回答，後處理將每個 [n] 引文標記重寫為深鏈接並除未指向檢索源的標記。
AI.result: 三項評估：(1) 已知項目跨語言檢索——基於 194 對 LLM 驗證的英語講座-孟語轉述配對，Path A 直接密集檢索 Recall@10 達 0.88 (EN→BN) / 0.82 (BN→EN)；融合 + cross-encoder 重排後雙向均為 0.86，MRR 為 0.67/0.70；Path B（概念介導）獨立 Recall@10 僅 0.14/0.12，證實其為擴展層而非已知項目檢索器。(2) 30 題引文完整性與橋接審計——30/30 全部返回非空結果，Stage-1 JSON 回退率 0%；現代問題 93% 產生橋接說明，永恒問題僅 13%；136 個引文標記中 0 個為偽造（驗證器作為空閒護欄）；跨語言證據佔比在橋接前後基本不變（32% vs 40%），揭示跨語言性主要由共享嵌入空間和概念圖提供而非改寫步驟。(3) 概念抽取精度人類研究——N=200 均勻隨機抽樣，三位標註者獨立判斷；A（非作者）精度 0.665，B（作者）0.705，嚴格雙人共識精度 0.600（Cohen's κ=0.61，"substantial"），並集精度 0.77；提取器置信度權重已校準（Spearman ρ=0.19），threshold≥0.8 將共識精度從 0.54 提升至 0.71（Fisher p=0.023），同時保留 98.1% 的含概念段落；孟語精度顯著低於英語（0.54 vs 0.68, p=0.043），定位弱點恰在跨語言訪問所依賴的那一半。
AI.conclusion: Viveka-Insight 證明：一個中等規模 LLM 單次抽取 + 共享多語言嵌入空間 + 規範標籤概念圖的輕量本地流水線，足以讓雙語非平行古典語料實現按語義檢索、雙語可回答、證據透明可審計。時間橋接機制將系統最明顯的弱點（19 世紀詞彙）轉化為顯式可檢查的映射而非沉默的檢索失敗。架構無 Vivekananda 特定假設，可遷移至任何具穩定規範結構的單語或多語古典語料（如 Ramakrishna Kathamrita、甘地文集、希臘教父文獻）。明確的下一步包括：(1) 採用孟語能力更強的抽取器以閉合英孟精度差距；(2) 通過系統已暴露的審計軌跡開展社區驅動糾錯；(3) 對生成回答做學者標注的忠實性研究（當前僅結構性驗證引文指向而非語義支持）。

title: Schema-Anchored Latent Reasoning for Semantic Parsing-Based Knowledge Base Question Answering
summary: Semantic parsing (SP)-based knowledge base question answering aims to answer natural language questions by generating executable logical forms (LFs) over knowledge bases (KBs). When applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to this task, a key challenge over large, heterogeneous KBs is selecting question-related schema elements (i.e., relations and classes) and composing them into complex LFs. Recent LLM-based methods often make early discrete commitments to schema elements during intermediate reasoning, allowing incorrect intermediate schema decisions to propagate and finally result in incorrect LFs. To overcome this limitation, we propose SALR, a schema-anchored latent reasoning method for LF construction. It performs multi-step reasoning by generating continuous thoughts in the model's hidden states, thereby delaying the explicit commitment to LF decisions. To ground this latent reasoning process in the corresponding KB schema, SALR aligns continuous thoughts with a codebook of KB schema elements through an alignment objective supervised by schema traces deterministically derived from gold LFs. It then incorporates the aligned schema codes into inputs for subsequent reasoning steps. This schema-mediated feedback guides LF generation without requiring the model to emit an explicit textual reasoning trajectory. Experiments on GrailQA and WebQSP show that SALR achieves consistent overall gains over strong baselines. Notably, on compositional questions from GrailQA, SALR outperforms TIARA, a strong SP-based baseline, by 2.86 F1 points. Further analyses show that schema-mediated feedback affects LF generation and that schema information is recoverable from the latent states.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SALR，一种用于 SP-based KBQA 的模式锚定（schema-anchored）潜在推理方法。该方法通过在 LLM 隐状态中执行连续思维推理，将连续思维与 KB 模式元素的固定码本对齐，并构造思维反馈到后续推理步骤，从而在生成逻辑形式（LF）前延迟离散 schema 决策。实验表明 SALR 在 GrailQA 和 WebQSP 上均取得持续改进，尤其在 GrailQA 的组合问题（compositional）上以 +2.86 F1 显著超越强基线 TIARA。
AI.motivation: 基于 SP 的 KBQA 中，现有基于 LLM 的方法（如 TIARA）在多步推理中通过生成显式文本来做出 schema 元素选择，导致早期错误的 schema 决策难以恢复并传播到最终 LF。作者在 TIARA 的 GrailQA 验证集分析中发现，在有多步 schema 错误预测的样本中，74.1% 在初始步就出错，其中 99.2% 最终生成错误的 LF。因此，需要一种既能利用 KB schema 结构化监督，又能延迟离散决策、避免错误传播的方法。
AI.method: SALR（Schema-Anchored Latent Reasoning）的核心包括三部分：(1) Schema Codebook：从预训练 LLM 对每个 schema 元素（关系或类）的文本序列化进行 mean-pool，得到固定的连续模式码 b_s，形成码本 B_S；(2) Schema Trace & Schema Anchoring Module：从 gold LF 确定性派生按组合深度排序的 schema trace τ(l)=(τ_1,...,τ_T)，通过 InfoNCE 对齐目标将连续思维 h_t 投影 z_t=g_φ(h_t) 与正/负 schema 码对比学习，并对 τ_t 中 schema 码取均值后经 MLP f_ψ 构造"constructed thought" ĥ_t 反馈到下一步隐状态计算；(4) Adaptive Termination：通过线性终止头 r_η 和交叉熵损失自适应决定 latent 推理步数。最终总体目标为 L_LF + λ_align·L_align + λ_term·L_term。推理时通过 top-k（k=3）相似度从码本选择 schema 码，无需 gold trace。附录 A 还提供了基于互信息的理论解释。
AI.result: 在 GrailQA 和 WebQSP 上以 Llama-3.1-8B 为骨干网络（LoRA 微调），SALR 增强 TIARA 在 GrailQA 总体达到 80.01 EM / 85.42 F1，组合问题 F1 达到 80.85（比 TIARA 提升 +2.86 F1）；SALR 增强 SG-KBQA 在 WebQSP 达到 79.96 F1（表中最强）。消融实验显示：去除 schema anchoring 退化为 COCONUT 式通用 latent 推理时总体 F1 下降 1.20，组合问题 1.05；去除 latent 推理直接解码时组合问题 F1 下降 2.86；用当前思维检索取代 gold-code 反馈仅下降 0.25 F1。模式可恢复性分析显示 SALR 在 R@27 上达 33.58%（vs. 通用 latent+probe 的 24.15%），MRR 0.1010。PCA 与余弦相似度图显示 SALR 的连续思维跨步更具区分度。干预实验显示用 gold schema 码替换预测码将 F1 从 85.42 提升至 85.85，而随机化 schema 反馈使 F1 暴跌至 71.81。Qwen3-4B 迁移实验也证实 +0.37 F1 的提升。效率方面，推理 token 数（38.51）显著少于显式文本推理（62.36）。
AI.conclusion: SALR 通过将 latent reasoning 与 KB schema 结构化监督相结合，在 SP-based KBQA 中实现了一种新的推理范式——在保留连续隐状态计算的同时延迟离散 LF 决策，并以 schema 锚点提供任务特定的引导。实验与分析证实 schema 信息可从连续思维中恢复（schema recoverability），且 schema 介导的反馈（schema-mediated feedback）确实影响 LF 生成。该方法在 GrailQA 和 WebQSP 上对两个强基线均带来一致性增益，尤其在组合问题上表现突出。局限性包括：依赖可枚举的 KB schema 集、需要从 gold LF 派生的预处理、需要检索阶段提供足够覆盖；额外 latent 计算也增加了推理成本。未来工作可结合更强的检索与修复机制，并探索面向更广泛推理任务的结构化锚点。

title: An Analysis of Training-Free Self-Reported Confidence in Language Models
comment: workshop
summary: Large language models can report a numerical confidence together with generated content, but it is unclear whether this report is more than calibrated rhetoric. We analyze three training-free signals: confidence verbalized with the answer, post-hoc $P(\mathrm{True})$, and agreement with three additional generations on the same 100 TriviaQA questions for two model families. Direct verbalization is a surprisingly strong baseline: after auditing benchmark errors, it reaches AUROC 0.956 and 0.937 for correctness prediction. Three-sample agreement is substantially weaker (0.765 and 0.790), and a fixed interpolation with verbalized confidence has no statistically reliable benefit. Four of nine errors from one model and two of eight from the other receive unanimous sample support, showing that self-consistency can amplify shared misconceptions. Re-eliciting confidence for the same fixed answers with equivalent prompts changes scores by 0.043 to 0.084 on average and flips 4\% to 9\% of decisions at a 0.8 threshold. An exploratory audit of 100 confidence-tagged biography claims further finds only a modest confidence gap between supported and contradicted claims. These results argue that useful self-reports remain sensitive to elicitation, correlated errors, and benchmark noise.

AI.tldr: 本文在黑盒、无训练条件下系统比较了三种语言模型自我报告置信度信号（直接口头置信、后验P(True)、三次采样一致性）在两个模型家族、TriviaQA 99题及100条传记声明上的表现，发现直接口头置信度是强基线（AUROC 0.956/0.937），而采样一致性最弱且会放大共同错误，固定插值并无普适收益，且置信度对语义等价的提示措辞敏感（4–9%决策翻转）。研究强调基准标签质量会显著影响校准结论。
AI.motivation: 语言模型生成内容越来越长，用户难以逐一核实事实，需要置信度辅助分配验证资源；但闭源模型的logit/隐藏状态不可访问，使得口头置信度成为唯一可用的不确定性信号——然而其是否真正反映正确性概率仍不清楚，且不同elicitation方式间的可比性也存疑。
AI.method: 在黑盒、仅允许prompt和≤3次采样的训练免费设定下：(1) 三个信号——直接口头置信、后验P(True)、三次额外采样支持分数；(3) 固定平均组合作为基准；(4) 协议包括TriviaQA 100题种子采样（审计后保留99题）、DeepSeek Flash与Claude Sonnet 5同接口评估、传记协议（FActScore话题抽取5条原子声明×20实体，Sonnet盲法标注+人工审查）、提示稳健性子实验（固定答案，等价paraphrase与反向量表re-elicit）、配对样本量 (2,000次百分位置bootstrap)，指标涵盖Brier、ECE、AUROC、AURC。
AI.result: 直接口头置信度AUROC 0.956（DeepSeek）/0.937（Sonnet），是最强单一信号；后验P(True)在模型间不一致（DeepSeek严重欠自信）；三次采样支持最弱（AUROC 0.765/0.790），且4/9与2/8的错误获得了采样一致支持（如拳手归属、历史救护车起源等共同错误）；固定插值的95% bootstrap区间均跨零，无普适收益；提示改写使平均绝对变化0.043–0.084，4.0%–9.1%在0.8阈值处翻转；审计标签修正使准确率提高3–4个百分点；100条传记声明中5条被证据反驳，置信度均值仅比支持声明低0.089，仍有一条错误获≥0.9置信度。
AI.conclusion: 训练免费置信度有用但模型间不可互换；应将置信度作为触发外部验证的信号而非真理保证；不同elicitation方法不应等同对待；采样一致性可能强化共同错误而非独立证据；基准标签质量对校准研究影响巨大（未审计标签可模拟过度自信）；需要更大、独立裁定、面向长篇的声明级研究才能将置信度作为控制信号部署。

title: Steering the Compass: Aligning Dynamic Psychological Counseling Conversations with Cognitive Behavioral Therapy Strategies
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026
summary: Recent advancements in large language models have revolutionized the field of psychological counseling, especially in the context of Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT). While the success of CBT relies heavily on dynamic decision-making informed by the client's real-time mental state, this aspect has often been overlooked in current research, limiting both flexibility and therapeutic outcomes. In this paper, we introduce StratCBT, a dataset specifically designed for psychological counseling conversations with CBT Strategies, consisting of 9,688 sessions and around 256K utterances, with each counselor's response aligned with one of eight distinct strategies. The creation of StratCBT involves modeling clients based on their negative thoughts and generating high-quality counseling conversations through self-chat, incorporating realistic sessions as guidance, thereby significantly surpassing existing datasets in both general counseling and CBT-specific skills. We conduct extensive experiments to demonstrate the effectiveness of strategy-aligned generation and evaluate its efficacy in delivering professional and effective counseling with LLM-simulated clients to reflect real-world scenarios. The dataset can be obtained from this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出StratCBT数据集,将认知行为疗法(CBT)的8种策略与对话轮次对齐,通过动态策略选择提升LLM心理咨询效果,包含9688个会话和约256K话语,在通用咨询和CBT特定技能上优于现有数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的CBT对话系统多依赖固定脚本或预定义策略序列,无法根据客户实时心理状态进行动态调整,缺乏灵活性,限制了治疗效果。本文旨在解决动态决策这一被忽略的方面。
AI.method: 1)收集23个真实CBT会话(来自CheeseBurger Therapy);2)定义8种CBT策略(倾听、引导、示范、叙事、认知重构、新思维、总结、其他);3)利用PatternReframe数据集建模客户(事件、想法、感受、行为);4)采用Gemini-2.0-Flash自聊天框架,结合真实会话作为ICL指导,生成高质量咨询对话,并对咨询师话语标注策略;5)在生成时先预测下一轮策略再生成回复。
AI.result: 1)Strat数据集在CTRS六个维度(理解、人际效能、协作、引导发现、聚焦、策略)上显著优于ESConv、SoulChat、ExTES、CPsyCounD、SMILE、Cactus等数据集;2)策略对齐生成在零样本和微调设置下均提升BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR、BERTScore等指标;3)优于Direct-Refine、Self-Refine、知识增强等基线;4)细调后的Ministral-8B在Patient-Ψ-DM模拟场景中,GPT-4o在PANAS上表现,正负情绪改善均更显著。
AI.conclusion: StratCBT是首个将心理健康咨询与CBT策略对齐的数据集,验证了策略对齐生成的有效性,展现了其在真实治疗场景中的应用潜力。未来工作将扩展至SFBT等其他疗法理论,并通过高级规划技术进一步提升性能。

title: SAFARI: An Industrial Benchmark for LLM-Assisted Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly considered for safety-critical engineering, yet their reliability in regulated functional-safety workflows remains underexplored. We introduce SAFARI (Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference), the first industrial benchmark for LLM-assisted automotive Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment (HARA) under ISO 26262. It contains 3,000 de-identified industrial HARA cases and evaluates two coupled tasks: open-ended hazard analysis and standards-grounded risk assessment. To evaluate open-ended HARA artifacts, we propose the first reference-anchored LLM-as-a-judge protocol with high expert correlation. Experiments with nine frontier LLMs show that models often produce plausible hazard narratives but remain weak at ISO 26262 risk classification, with the best ASIL macro-F1 reaching only 0.261. Chain-of-Thought prompting provides limited benefit and often degrades categorical risk assessment. Error analysis further localizes major failures to scenario-critical context omissions during hazard generation and to controllability misjudgments during risk assessment, indicating where expert oversight should be concentrated. The dataset can be obtained from this https URL .

AI.tldr: 本文提出了SAFARI（Safety-Aware Functional Automotive Risk Inference），首个面向汽车功能安全（ISO 26262）HARA（Hazard Analysis and Risk Assessment）的工业级LLM评测基准。基准包含3000个脱敏工业HARA案例，评估两个任务：开放式危险事件分析（Task 1）和标准约束的风险评估（Task 2）。论文提出首个面向HARA的参考锚定LLM-as-a-judge协议，并对9个前沿LLM进行了对比实验。
AI.motivation: LLM在安全关键工程领域的潜力日益受到关注，但其在受监管的功能安全工作流中的可靠性尚未被系统评估。现有评测多关注通用安全（真实性、拒答行为）或特定领域（金融、医疗、法律），而HARA这种结合开放式因果推理与标准约束分类的级联敏感工作流缺乏工业级评测基准。此外，工业实践中需要明确LLM能在哪些子任务上提供辅助、哪些输出仍不可靠，从而有针对性地配置专家审查资源。
AI.method: 1) 构建SAFARI数据集：3000个来自工业项目的脱敏HARA案例，聚焦"非预期驱动力/扭矩输出"这一关键故障类别，沿机动、道路、天气、能见度、交通参与者等ISO 26262相关因素变化场景上下文。数据集划分为1600训练/400验证/1000测试，由认证功能安全工程师标注并通过ISO 26262一致性校验。2) 设计双任务评测协议：Task 1评估危险事件、危险、受影响人群；Task 2评估E/S/C、派生ASIL、安全目标、FTTI。3) 提出参考锚定LLM-as-a-judge协议（使用Qwen3.6-Max作为评判器），沿HLM、PCC、RCC、SGA四个安全特定维度对开放式HARA产物进行1-5分评分，并与认证工程师评分验证高一致性。4) 对9个前沿LLM在少样本（k=3）和CoT两种提示策略下进行实验对比，并实现确定性规则基线作为非LLM对照。
AI.result: 1) 9个模型在Task 1整体表现尚可（GLM-5.1 FS达到0.726平均分），尤其在物理后果一致性和风险人群覆盖方面较好；但在HLM（危险因果链与场景锚定）维度普遍偏弱（均低于0.20）。2) Task 2性能显著下降：最佳ASIL Macro-F1仅0.261（GPT-5.5 FS），暴露、严重度、可控性分类可靠性低，表明开放式危险叙事无法可靠转化为标准约束的风险分类。3) CoT提示在HLM、PCC、S、C、ASIL上普遍带来性能退化，ASIL假-QM率从14.9%升至41.0%；但CoT稳定提升FTTI数值估计。4) 错误分析定位两大瓶颈：Task 1的场景关键上下文遗漏（弯道、低附路面、能见度等），Task 2的可控性误判（单点错误经ASIL确定性传播放大）。5) 规则基线在S和C上分别优于12/13个LLM配置，表明场景属性对分类具有强信号，LLM相对透明基线的改进在E/S/C维度并不一致。6) 评判器一致性验证：Qwen3.6-Max与GPT-5.5两种评判器与专家评分的相关系数差异最大仅0.027，排除同族偏好干扰。
AI.conclusion: SAFARI揭示了LLM在汽车HARA工作流中的清晰能力边界：模型能生成表面上合理的危险叙事，但在ISO 26262标准约束的风险分类上仍不可靠。CoT提示对此任务收益有限且常降低分类性能，仅对数值型FTTI估计有益。场景上下文遗漏和可控性误判是两大关键瓶颈，这恰好指明了专家审查应集中的环节。结论强调，当前LLM更适合作为危险探索与文档支持工具，而非自主承担安全关键风险评估。局限性在于仅覆盖单一故障类别，以及数据集的工业经验分布具有长尾性。

title: WiC is Not WSD: A Study on LLMs and Lexical Ambiguity Resolution
comment: Accepted to AACL 2026 (main)
summary: Word-in-Context (WiC) remains challenging for language models, despite recent progress on lexical-semantic tasks. We hypothesise that this difficulty arises not only from comparing two contextual uses of a word, but also from the absence of an explicit sense inventory that specifies the relevant level of semantic granularity. We evaluate open LLMs on WiC and traditional Word Sense Disambiguation (WSD) under similar settings. We find that providing candidate senses, similar to what is done in traditional WSD, improves WiC performance in all settings. In general, explicit sense information helps models make more consistent and targeted judgements. Human evaluation further shows that many apparent WiC errors reflect label ambiguity or mismatches between model and annotator sense boundaries rather than simple failures of lexical understanding. In particular, results show that LLMs overthink the sense distinction often leading to errors based on overly fine-grained distinctions.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了大型语言模型在词义消歧任务WiC上表现不佳的根本原因，指出WiC缺乏显式的义项粒度规范是核心难点，而非单纯的上下文比较能力不足。通过在WiC中引入候选义项、对比WSD以及人类评估，验证了显式义项信息能显著提升性能，尤其对小模型帮助更大，并揭示了模型倾向于过度细粒度区分是错误的主要来源。
AI.motivation: WiC任务（判断同一词在两个语境中是否同义）尽管形式简单，但LLM表现接近随机水平。已有研究多归因于上下文比较的难度，本文则认为关键瓶颈在于WiC缺乏类似传统WSD的显式义项清单（sense inventory），使模型无法确定应使用的语义粒度，从而产生错误的细粒度区分。
AI.method: 1) 在三种设置下评估开源LLM（LLaMA3、DeepSeek、Mistral的大/小变体）：粗粒度WiC、细粒度WiC、粗粒度WSD（CWSD-20）；2) 引入Options+（提供候选义项）与Options-（标准WiC）、CoT+与CoT-两种提示策略，组合为四组实验；3) 构建"WiC through WSD"流水线，让模型先对每个上下文单独做WSD，再比较两个预测义项；4) 人工评估120条粗粒度和140条细粒度错误样本，分类错误类型（义项误识别、粒度过细/过粗、推理失误等）。其中细粒度WiC数据集为基于WordNet 3.1新构建（924个目标词、1185对实例）以避免数据污染。
AI.result: 1) 提供候选义项（Options+）在所有设置下一致提升WiC性能：粗粒度WiC平均从74.9%提升至84.9%（CoT+条件下）；2) 同一义项清单下，WSD（92.7%）仍显著优于WiC（84.9%），说明比较步骤本身也贡献难度；3) "WiC through WSD"对小模型帮助巨大，如Mistral-S从61.5%提升至82.3%，而大模型几乎无变化；4) 模型存在系统性的False偏向（60.8%–69.1%），主要源于对True实例的召回率低；5) 人类评估显示：在粗粒度WiC的120个错误样本中，39个被判定为模型实际正确、54个为义项误识别、32个为粒度过细；在细粒度WiC的140个错误样本中，76个被判为模型实际正确，仅19个为义项误识别，31个为粒度过细、14个为粒度过粗。
AI.conclusion: WiC对LLM的核心挑战并非词汇语义知识不足，而是缺乏显式的义项粒度规范。显式提供候选义项、将WiC分解为先WSD再比较的步骤，能显著改善性能（尤其是小模型）。许多"模型错误"实质是标注者的义项边界与模型偏好之间的不匹配，模型倾向于做出比人类标注更细粒度的区分。模型规模与架构均影响表现：大模型总体更强，但DeepSeek-S表现优于Mistral-L，说明设计因素同样重要。未来需研究如何将这种粒度校准能力赋予小模型。

title: What Does Privileged Information Add to On-Policy Self-Distillation?
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) lets a language model learn from a frozen copy of itself that sees an answer or a worked solution. Giving the teacher this extra information seems to offer the student more to learn, but how much does it add beyond distillation itself? To isolate that contribution, we construct AMPLE-Math, a reusable suite of 5,319 mathematical problems with six reasoning views that share the same answer, and compare each view with matched reference-free distillation. With a thinking-enabled teacher supervising direct-response rollouts, reference-free distillation accounts for much of Qwen3-1.7B's improvement under thinking-enabled evaluation, both in domain and on external benchmarks. Evidence for an additional reference benefit is modest in Qwen, strongest for a polished solution, whereas complete traces add two percentage points in SmolLM3-3B at step 50. These benefits depend on the student being trained. At the same checkpoint, replacing short direct-response rollouts with long thinking-enabled rollouts turns gains into losses in both families while the problems, references, and evaluation stay fixed. Teacher profiles and matched loss interventions in Qwen further show that changing token-level supervision can leave student behavior largely unchanged. Together, these findings suggest that OPSD can improve access to existing reasoning capabilities through parameters shared by direct-response and thinking-enabled inference. The value of a privileged reference is what it adds to this cross-mode transfer, not how much of the solution it reveals.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线自蒸馏（OPSD）中"特权信息"（privileged reference）究竟比无参考蒸馏多贡献了什么。作者构建了 AMPLE-Math 数据集（5,319 题 × 6 种推理视图），在 Qwen3-1.7B 和 SmolLM3-3B 上通过严格的控制实验发现：无参考蒸馏已能解释 Qwen 大部分提升，特权参考的额外贡献较小且因模型而异；学生训练轨迹本身（而非参考内容）才是转移效果的决定因素——切换为长思维链训练甚至将收益转为损失。
AI.motivation: OPSD 中给教师提供解题过程或答案看似能为学生提供更多信息，但这些额外信息（特权信息）究竟比纯蒸馏多贡献了多少尚不明确。先前研究发现无目标解答的参考也能产生增益，结构化引导甚至能胜过完整解答，因此需要将"参考本身的贡献"与"蒸馏本身的贡献"严格分离。
AI.method: 1) 构建 AMPLE-Math：从 OpenThoughts-114k 中抽取 5,319 道数学题，每题构造 6 种答案一致但推理表示不同的视图（Answer Only / Gist / Key Points / Clean Solution / Summary / Full Trace）。2) 在每种视图训练时与无参考对照（仅去掉 PI）匹配比较，主配置为"思维开启教师监督直接回复学生"，在 Qwen3-1.7B（LoRA r=64）和 SmolLM3-3B 上训练 100 步。3) 教师画像分析：测量正确性对齐 Cv、修正标记压力 Fv、时序 KL 分配。4) 匹配干预实验：替换为他题参考、截断 trace 开头、放松修正标记损失、改变损失窗口等。5) 评估含域内测试与 AIME 2024/2025、HMMT Feb 2025 外部基准，使用 95% 问题聚类自助法置信区间与 Holm 多重比较校正。
AI.result: Qwen3-1.7B：无参考蒸馏已解释大部分提升；Clean Solution 相对无参考仅多约 +1.30 点（未通过 Holm 校正）；完整参考并未带来更大增益；其他题参考替换会降低约 2 点；将直接回复训练切换为长思维训练使所有视图由收益转为损失（约 -3 至 -10 点）。SmolLM3-3B：Full Trace 在第 50 步相对无参考多 +2.00 点（直接回复训练），但所有配置在第 100 步均低于基线。修正标记的损失放松几乎不改变标记使用；扩展损失窗口的表面增益主要由更早停止解释。原始 OPSD 数据上的复现验证：外部基准 +5.56 点（Avg@12），提升集中在间歇可解题。
AI.conclusion: OPSD 的主要价值在于通过直接回复与思维推理共享的参数，让已有推理能力在思维推理模式下更易被调用，而非通过特权参考揭示更多解题过程。特权参考的价值应以其对跨模式迁移的边际贡献来衡量，而非其揭示的解答完整程度。参考设计与学生训练轨迹应作为联合问题考虑。

title: UniPolicy: Unified Objective-Specific Policies for Generative Search Advertising
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables
summary: Search advertising connects user intent with commercial content and plays a critical role in platform monetization. Recent systems typically align pretrained generative models with a single business reward, such as eCPM, or use naive reward fusion for preliminary multi-objective alignment. However, an ideal search advertising system must jointly account for heterogeneous objectives, including relevance, click propensity, and commercial value, to balance user experience and business value while mitigating globally suboptimal performance caused by gradient competition. We propose UniPolicy, an objective-aware multi-policy alignment framework. UniPolicy combines objective-specific prefix tokens, sparse MoE-LoRA routing, and objective-specific residual FFNs to hierarchically decouple parameters within a shared backbone, providing differentiated parameter and policy-expression spaces for different business objectives. It further constructs pairwise preferences from multi-stage behavioral feedback, supplementing the relative preference information in exposed-but-unclicked samples and strengthening the relative advantage of clicked candidates in the generation distribution. At inference, UniPolicy supports parallel, business-customizable multi-policy beam search, flexibly allocating candidate quotas across objectives under a fixed retrieval budget. Large-scale offline experiments show that UniPolicy delivers balanced improvements across multiple metrics while preserving retrieval quality, outperforming single-objective reinforcement learning and naive reward-fusion baselines. In a 7-day online A/B test on a real search advertising system, UniPolicy improves CTR by 0.71%, RPS by 1.58%, and advertising revenue by 1.32%, while maintaining stable serving latency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UniPolicy，一种面向生成式搜索广告的多目标对齐框架，通过目标条件前缀、MoE-LoRA稀疏路由和目标特定残差FFN在共享骨干网络中分层解耦异构业务目标参数，并利用多阶段行为信号构建偏好监督，在推理时支持并行多策略束搜索灵活分配候选配额。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式检索广告系统通常使用单一业务奖励（如eCPM）对齐，或通过朴素奖励融合进行多目标对齐。前者损害生态平衡，后者将异构目标压缩到同一参数空间，导致梯度竞争使最强目标支配统一策略、其他目标的学习信号被淹没。此外，点击监督无法利用曝光未点击等候选间的相对偏好信息。
AI.method: UniPolicy包含三个核心模块：(1)目标条件多策略对齐：通过目标特定前缀token注入隐式提示，结合稀疏MoE-LoRA（12分支选Top-3）和目标特定残差FFN在共享骨干上分层解耦参数，并为每个目标独立执行GRPO优化；(2)基于多阶段行为信号的偏好优化：利用Click>Exposure>Miss的漏斗关系构建候选pairwise排序监督（带差异化间隔），强化点击候选在分布中的相对优势；(3)高效多策略推理：通过共享KV缓存和并行多目标束搜索生成候选，结合"修剪与回填"机制在固定预算下灵活分配各策略配额。
AI.result: 离线实验显示，UniPolicy在NDCG@10上达到0.4218（最佳），CTR和Relevance归一化得分均超过单目标GRPO基线，eCPM接近最优单目标结果；消融实验验证各组件均有效，前缀token去除影响最大；案例分析显示三策略确实产生差异化的生成偏好。线上7天A/B测试中CTR提升0.71%、RPS提升1.58%、广告收入提升1.32%，P99延迟仅增加2.5%。
AI.conclusion: UniPolicy将传统统一多奖励优化重新定义为目标条件的多策略学习，通过层次化解耦缓解了单目标偏向和统一策略压缩引起的目标竞争问题。理论分析表明该框架将目标间策略耦合成本转化为条件适配空间中的目标特定近似误差，为生成式搜索广告的多目标业务对齐提供了一条可扩展、可控且可工业部署的路径。

title: HerHealthEval: Evaluating Multilingual and Register-Sensitive Understanding of Women's Health Communication
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to the 2026 International Conference on Large Language Models (LLM 2026)
summary: Large language models are increasingly used in healthcare communication, yet most evaluations emphasize response quality while assuming that the user's concern has been interpreted correctly. We introduce HerHealthEval, a controlled evaluation framework for multilingual understanding of women's-health communication. For each clinical case, HerHealthEval provides matched versions in English, French, and Modern Standard Arabic using six communicative forms: canonical, clinical, layperson, indirect or hedged, emotionally concerned, and deliberately under-specified. The first five express the same underlying concern and retain the same clinical information, whereas the under-specified form intentionally omits relevant details to test whether the model recognizes that clarification is needed. We evaluate a multilingual instruction model and QLoRA-adapted variants on concern classification, risk calibration, clarification behavior, parse compliance, and cross-form consistency. Results reveal that aggregate accuracy and consistency can conceal safety-relevant failures. A multilingual adaptation model reaches 0.994 under-triage in French and Arabic under language-asymmetric risk supervision. A controlled re-adaptation using source-derived, language-invariant risk labels reduces under-triage to 0.572 and 0.558, respectively. These findings show that robust multilingual healthcare evaluation requires explicit testing of register variation, uncertainty handling, and the provenance and invariance of adaptation labels.

AI.tldr: HerHealthEval是一个用于评估大语言模型在女性健康沟通中多语言和语域敏感理解能力的受控评估框架。它通过英语、法语和现代标准阿拉伯语匹配版本,以及六种交际形式(规范、临床、外行、间接或犹豫、情感关切、故意欠详)来测试模型是否正确理解患者意图。结果显示聚合准确率可能掩盖安全隐患,多语言适配在错误的语言不对称风险标签下导致法语和阿拉伯语漏诊率高达0.994,而采用语言不变风险标签重新适配后漏诊率分别降至0.572和0.558。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM医疗评估主要关注响应质量而假设用户关切已被正确理解,且忽视了多语言和不同语域表达同一关切时模型表现的差异。论文旨在填补这一空白,专门评估模型对患者底层关切的"理解"能力,特别关注女性健康这一因污名化、文化间接性而对理解错误尤为敏感的领域。
AI.method: 构建HerHealthEval框架:固定每个临床案例的底层关切,在英语、法语、MSA中匹配六种交际形式(规范、临床、外行、间接/犹豫、欠详、情感关切)。前五种保留相同临床信息,欠详形式故意省略相关信息以测试澄清行为。评估Qwen3.5-9B-Instruct及其QLoRA适配变体在关切分类、风险校准、澄清行为、解析合规性和跨形式一致性上的表现。设置五类对比模型:零样本基线、英语QLoRA适配、英语+澄清过采样、联合英法阿QLoRA适配(M3-ML)、以及风险修正的多语言再适配(M3-ML-RC)。通过精确匹配、来源溯源、释义家族排除三种规则控制数据泄露。
AI.result: 零样本基线英语漏诊率0.718,澄清召回率0.856。多语言适配模型(M3-ML)英语漏诊率0.711,但法语和阿拉伯语漏诊率高达0.994(几乎将全部"应就医"案例错误归为"常规"),同时产生虚高的跨语言一致性(法语0.978、阿拉伯语0.967)。澄清召回率在所有语言中降至接近0。后置审计发现原始多语言适配语料通过将英语启发式方法直接应用于翻译文本来重新计算法语和阿拉伯语风险标签,导致语言不对称标签偏向"常规"。风险修正再适配模型(M3-ML-RC)从英语源案例推导一次风险标签并跨语言传播,将法语漏诊率降至0.572、阿拉伯语0.558(具高度统计显著性),但澄清召回率仍为0。
AI.conclusion: 聚合准确率和一致性指标可能严重掩盖安全隐患。模型对语言实现方式(语域)高度敏感,同一关切用不同表达可获得不同预测。多语言适配的成败不仅取决于是否包含多种语言,更取决于监督信号是否语言不变且经过质量控制。澄清行为需要显式训练目标而非仅靠过采样。稳健的多语言医疗评估必须明确区分理解、不确定性处理和风险校准三个层面。

title: Summarization Bias: The Directional Collapse of Objective Projection into Told-Mode Labels in Large Language Models --- A Conceptual Framework and Registered Test Protocol
comment: v1.1. 8 pages. Also archived at Zenodo: this https URL
summary: This paper introduces and operationalizes summarization bias: a proposed systematic tendency of large language models (LLMs) to represent narrative meaning as an abstract summary label rather than as the reconstructable inferential structure that produces it. Within the Bulut Doctrine, narrative effect is theorized along a told-shown axis: in told mode, emotional and informational content is declared explicitly and requires little reader reconstruction; in shown mode, that content is suppressed at the surface and must be reconstructed from physical cues and indirection (Objective Projection). Shown mode is the higher-load condition the doctrine is designed to measure. The claim is that LLMs fail along this axis in a specific direction. Summarization bias is hypothesized to operate in two regimes: (i) a generative regime, in which a model asked to render an emotion through Objective Projection defaults to declaring it instead; and (ii) an evaluative regime, in which a model judging narrative quality rewards told-mode explicitness and under-detects shown-mode suppression. The evaluative regime is the more consequential, since LLMs increasingly serve as judges and reward models, and a directional bias toward told mode would impose a selection pressure degrading prose toward flat declaration. This report does not claim the bias is validated. It defines the construct, situates it against LLM-as-judge biases, rereads a completed independent reliability study as directional evidence consistent with it, and pre-registers a two-regime test with decision rules under which the construct would be abandoned.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"摘要偏差"(summarization bias)这一概念构念,指大语言模型存在将叙事内容从"展示模式"(shown mode,通过客观线索让读者推断)折叠为"讲述模式"(told mode,直接陈述情绪/信息)的系统性方向性倾向。该偏差有两种作用机制:生成式(模型在要求进行客观投射时默认直接命名情绪)和评估式(模型作为评判者时偏好显性陈述、削弱对隐含表达的识别)。文章提供了操作性定义与预设检验方案,尚未采集数据。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地充当评判者、奖励模型与自动编辑工具,如果存在对"讲述模式"的系统性偏好,将形成选择压力,在优化迭代中逐步将叙事散文推向表面化、直接化的方向,损害依赖读者重构的高负载文学表达(Bulut Doctrine 中的 Objective Projection 与 Narrative Entropy)。文章强调"方向性"是关键主张——非对称失败比一般性的文学敏感性弱更有意义且更可证伪。
AI.method: 方法为概念框架 + 预设检验方案(尚未执行):(1)操作化定义——告知/展示编码、抑制信息指数(SI)、摘要偏差的双形式操作化定义;(2)对一个已完成的三研究可靠性报告[3]进行再解读,作为方向性证据:5 个机器标注器在"具象化关键特征"上趋近随机,而人类仅有 9/100 的标注;(3)四阶段预设协议——阶段 1 构造长度匹配、Flesch-Kincaid 匹配的人类告知/展示对(目标 k=20,κ≥0.60 才推进);阶段 2 检验生成式 H1g;阶段 3 检验评估式 H1e(目标 Cohen's h≥0.3 或 OR≥2);阶段 4 通过长度失配与提示框架变换进行针对冗长偏差与谄媚偏差的判别性检查;(4)预设决策规则:若阶段 3 证伪 H1e 则撤回构念,并与确认结果同等公开。
AI.result: 无新数据结果。本文报告的内容为:(a)构念定义与文献定位(冗长偏差、自我偏好、谄媚等已知 LLM-as-judge 偏差均不可化约为摘要偏差);(b)对已完成可靠性报告[3]的再解读——5 个机器标注器(含规则检测器与 4 个 LLM)在"具象化关键特征"上阳性计数分别为 0、1、40、72、78,4/5 趋近偶然,被解读为与摘要偏差一致(机器在"展示层"已被作者"扁平化",故无法指认);(c)但作者承认该解读亦与规则定义本身不够可操作一致,该报告本身拒绝做出裁定;(d)承诺阶段 1 配对刺激集与全部原始计数将以开放实验室笔记与 Zenodo 形式公开。
AI.conclusion: 本文为概念性与预设注册阶段的工作,不对"摘要偏差"做验证性断言。其学术贡献在于:将日常的"只会讲不会展示"观察提炼为可测量的、有方向的、可证伪的构念;预先规定放弃构念的条件以防止事后构造拟合;把检验核心定位于评估式偏差(因其作为奖励信号会产生退化压力)。阶段 3 是否支持 H1e 在本文中保持开放,后续将以等量级公开的方式报告确认或撤回。

title: On-Demand Attention: Language Models Know When to Recall
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures
summary: Reasoning and agentic workloads increasingly demand efficient long-context inference. Yet full-attention decoding reads the growing history at every step, regardless of its benefit to the next prediction. We show that a pretrained model's decoding states already contain information predictive of this benefit, before the global read. Building on this finding, we introduce On-Demand Attention (ODA), a local-first decoding method that uses a lightweight recall head to selectively invoke global attention as its predicted benefit changes during generation. ODA trains only the recall head, leaving pretrained weights unchanged and the complete historical KV cache available for future recall. We further implement GPU-side conditional execution in vLLM, translating reduced global reads into practical decoding speedups over full attention at long context lengths. Experiments across Qwen and Gemma models, including hybrid-attention backbones, show that selective recall recovers most of the performance lost under local attention while substantially reducing global reads. These findings support long-context inference in which pretrained models guide their own access to the information they retain.

AI.tldr: ODA是一种长上下文推理加速方法，通过轻量级的recall head让预训练模型自主决定何时从局部注意力升级为全局注意力，在保持性能的同时显著减少全局计算量。
AI.motivation: 全注意力解码在长上下文推理中每一步都读取全部历史KV缓存，成本高昂且浪费，因为许多生成步骤并不需要远距离信息。需要一种让模型自适应决定何时调用全局注意力的方法。
AI.method: On-Demand Attention (ODA)采用局部优先策略：每步先执行Local注意力（初始token+最近窗口），然后通过一个仅28M参数的轻量级recall head从已有解码状态（前一隐藏状态、当前token嵌入、当前Local隐藏状态）预测全局注意力的收益，超过阈值则重计算该步的Full注意力。训练时冻结骨干网络，仅用配对的Local-Full NLL增益作为监督信号训练recall head。推理时在vLLM中实现GPU端条件执行。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B的RULER16K上，ODA以41.6%的Full调用率达到81.17分（Full为81.94，Local仅19.23）。在128K上下文+1K输出+12.5%全局调用率下，FLOPs减少约76%，vLLM实测吞吐量达到Full的1.98倍（149.52 vs 75.54 tokens/s）。方法在Qwen3-8B、Qwen3.5-2B混合架构和Gemma-4-12B-it上均验证有效。随机路由对照实验表明"何时调用"比"调用频率"更重要。
AI.conclusion: 预训练模型的解码状态本身包含预测全局注意力收益的信号，无需修改预训练权重即可实现自适应的上下文访问。ODA在保持完整KV缓存的同时，通过模型自指导的按需召回，在长上下文推理中显著提升效率，为长上下文高效推理提供了新方向。

title: JEPA-Anything: Learning Predictive Models across Different Worlds
comment: Code: this https URL
summary: World modeling enables intelligence to anticipate consequences, guide interventions, and learn from interaction. Yet predictive models remain domain-specific: can a common learning principle support world modeling across radically different systems? We introduce JEPA-Anything, a domain-agnostic framework based on orthogonal predictive factorization (OPF). Extending joint-embedding predictive architectures, OPF decomposes latent targets into complementary factors, learns them through dedicated pathways, and recombines them within a shared predictive design. We evaluate JEPA-Anything across seven domains: vision, biology, clinical trajectories, control, molecular dynamics, physical fields, and weather. Experiments span representation learning, intervention prediction, out-of-distribution generalization, and long-horizon dynamics, including 10 matched dynamics tasks, forecasting of over 1,000 clinical events, and 100-step molecular rollouts across four systems. Against matched JEPA baselines, JEPA-Anything improves reported metrics on all 10 dynamics tasks and reduces single-intervention prediction error on Interventional Pong by 34.8%. It achieves the lowest one-step and 100-step molecular errors among compared methods in all four systems. Beyond prediction, a factor-nominated biological intervention receives experimental support in cell co-cultures, patient-derived organoids, tumor fragments, and mice; latent orbital modes recover the Keplerian scaling exponent with a fitted slope of -1.4991. These results support a common factorized predictive principle across heterogeneous worlds, connecting world modeling with intervention and experimentally grounded scientific discovery. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: JEPA-Anything 提出了一种基于"正交预测分解"(OPF) 的领域无关预测学习框架，将潜在目标分解为多个互补子空间并通过专用通路学习，再合成完整潜状态，在七个异构领域（视觉、生物、临床、控制、分子动力学、物理场、天气）中验证了一个统一的潜在世界模型接口。
AI.motivation: 当前预测模型高度领域专用：标准 JEPA 用单一目标嵌入和单一预测通路承载可预测结构，当局部/全局、多实体或多尺度混合时，易预测或高方差成分会主导优化，造成容量分配失衡。论文试图回答：一个潜世界模型接口能否通过多因子分解，组织跨域的不同结构化预测状态？
AI.method: 1) 设计统一的 context–target 潜世界状态接口：领域适配器 A_δ 将原始观测映射为内容 token H 与结构描述符 S，视图采样器 V_δ 选择上下文 C 与目标 T。2) 引入正交预测分解 (OPF)：学习 K 个投影矩阵 P_k∈R^{d×r}（Kr=d）将目标分解到正交子空间，对应 K 个专用预测器 q_k，预测因子经 Moore–Penrose 伪逆合成完整状态。3) 复合损失 L_train = L_base + L_OPF，其中 L_OPF = L_pred + λ_orth L_orth + λ_fac L_fac + λ_enc L_enc，分别施加因子预测、子空间正交、因子活动、在线编码器方差正则。4) 同一接口支持三种使用模式：表示读出 (丢弃因子头)、操作型世界模型 (保留合成状态用于多步规划/滚动)、因子级科学分析 (保留 P_k 作为诊断接口)。
AI.result: 在 10 项匹配动力学任务中相对标准 JEPA 全部改进报告指标；CITRIS Interventional Pong 单次干预 MSE 由 0.009541 降至 0.006218（-34.83%）；四类分子体系（水、石英、对乙酰氨基酚、苯）单步 MAE 与 100 步 RMSD 均最低；长程 Burgers 50 步滚动 ID 与高频 OOD 误差均降低；APEBench Burgers 保持末期 MSE 下降约 49.5%；PBMC 单细胞聚类与扰动预测、临床 1000+ 事件 PRAUC 均优于基线；机制审计显示正交分解使 κ_2(P)≈1、合成误差达机器精度；生物学方面由因子坐标提名 IL-18+CD73 联合干预在共培养、类器官、肿瘤片段与小鼠实验中获支持；轨道潜模式以斜率 -1.4991（R²=0.9999999）恢复开普勒标度律。
AI.conclusion: 正交预测分解为异构世界提供了一种统一的"容量分配+稳定合成"核心：正交性保证子空间不重叠与合成数值稳定，活动与方差正则防止坍缩；同一潜世界状态接口可同时支持表征读出、迭代规划与因子级科学分析，在七个领域实现预测改进并连接到湿实验验证与已知物理标度律，验证了跨域因子化预测原则的可行性。

title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
comment: 16 pages
summary: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence. Efforts to moderate hostile rhetoric in online speech draw on foundational theories in social and moral psychology, and political science. However, these theories were developed largely in parallel, often propose different and sometimes conflicting accounts of how hostility develops, and have rarely been tested against each other in real discourse. The result is a fragmented understanding of the rhetorical mechanisms of hostility, without a clear sense of how they appear, and relate to each other, in real-world discourse. Using 2.86 million posts from TikTok, Truth Social, and Twitter/X during the 2024 U.S. presidential election, we model the mechanisms of six foundational theories of intergroup hostility -- boundary construction, threat construction, scapegoating, negative evaluation, dehumanization, and action orientation -- within a common empirical framework to recover the broader organization of intergroup hostility rhetoric. Structurally, we find that boundary construction and threat construction anchor the system; temporally, we find that these mechanisms tend to follow a regular ordering: boundary construction, derogation, and action orientation tend to appear early; dehumanization and threat construction later; scapegoating latest. Mapping how these theoretical frameworks actually manifest in discourse bridges longstanding divisions across social science traditions and presents computational social science with a clearer empirical foundation for modeling intergroup hostility rhetoric beyond single-label detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个统一框架，在2.86百万条跨平台社媒帖文中同时测量六种群体间敌意机制（边界建构、威胁建构、替罪羊、负面评价、去人化、行动导向），通过结构依赖分析与叙事时间排序分析，揭示这些机制构成一个以边界建构和威胁建构为中心的系统，并呈现出"早期—中期—晚期"三层次的规律性时间序。
AI.motivation: 计算社会科学中仇恨言论、去人化、威胁等有害语言类别的检测通常彼此独立进行，缺少将这些分别发展的社会心理学与政治学理论机制放在同一实证框架内加以比较和统一的分析，导致对群体敌意修辞机制的整体组织缺乏清晰认识，难以支持早期干预与叙事级治理。
AI.method: 基于2024年美国总统大选期间TikTok、Truth Social和Twitter/X上2,861,992条帖子，使用人机协作标注流程（Qwen3-14B作为语料级标注器，宏F1=.798、κ=.588），通过五折交叉验证下的留出预测增益、条件logistic关联、BIC贝叶斯网络骨架学习三类互补方法刻画结构关系，并基于跨平台叙事中的首次出现时序比较各理论路径。
AI.result: 结构上，7条边即可恢复完全连接系统97.8%的预测增益，威胁中介路径以两条边恢复74.0%增益（105种两边结构中最佳），道德排斥路径仅恢复14.3%，整合路径以84.1%排名第7；条件关联显示边界-威胁对应约20倍优势比变化，威胁-行动约15倍。时间上呈现三层次：早期层为边界建构、负面评价、行动导向；中期层为去人化、威胁建构；晚期层为替罪羊，该三层次在97.5%自助样本中稳定，对标签扰动、左截断、跨平台均稳健。
AI.conclusion: 六种机制并非独立也并非单一固定路径，而是以边界建构和威胁建构为锚的稀疏、相互依赖系统，时间序独立于结构耦合；社会认同、威胁中介类理论较好刻画结构核心，道德排斥理论刻画其余关系；这支持将敌意修辞作为相互依赖的机制系统来建模，为叙事追踪、早期审核与组合机制建模提供更清晰的实证基础。

title: BurnRiSc: Toward Non-Invasive Burnout Screening in Open Source from Public Repository Signals
comment: 8 Pages, Submitted to the JAWs 2 Workshop
summary: Burnout is a chronic occupational syndrome, and open source is close to a worst case for it: maintainers absorb unbounded demand with no manager to reallocate work and no organization to notice decline. The cost is not only personal. Burnout precedes withdrawal, and in projects sustained by a handful of maintainers, one departure can break infrastructure that thousands of downstream systems depend on. Yet the field has no way to see it coming: self-report inventories, the only existing measure, miss exactly the contributors most in need of detection and cannot be applied retroactively, so the field cannot even ask how common burnout is or what helps. We present BurnRiSc, a framework that operationalizes the Oldenburg Burnout Inventory's two dimensions, exhaustion and disengagement, as 14 behavioral and linguistic signals computed from GitHub activity and scored against each contributor's own history. The signals aggregate into two weighted dimension scores, with weights learned from labeled cases, and average into a monthly Burnout Risk Score (BRS). In a preliminary evaluation across 68 contributors in ten repositories (ten disclosed burnout cases, twelve comparable-volume collapses, and 46 comparison contributors), sustained BRS elevation precedes 6 of 10 disclosures by 6-15 months, 8 of 10 when adding peak BRS as a second criterion, and 10 of 10 over any prior time frame. We thus present BurnRiSc as evidence that burnout is screenable from public data.

AI.tldr: BurnRiSc是一个基于GitHub公开活动数据的开源贡献者倦怠风险非侵入性筛查框架。它将Oldenburg倦怠量表(OLBI)的两个维度(疲惫与脱离)操作化为14个从GitHub行为和文本中提取的信号,通过相对个人历史的评分与从标注案例学习得到的权重,聚合成每月倦怠风险评分(BRS)。在68位贡献者的初步评估中,BRS在公开披露倦怠前提前数月出现持续升高,展示出倦怠可从公开数据筛查的可行性。
AI.motivation: 开源软件维护者承受无限制需求,缺乏管理者重新分配工作或察觉衰退,倦怠问题严重但现有自我报告测量方式无法扩展;现有研究无法回溯测量、规模受限、漏检最需识别的贡献者。该研究旨在填补这一空白,验证倦怠能否从公开仓库信号中被无侵入地筛查。
AI.method: 将OLBI两个维度操作化为14个行为与语言信号(疲惫维度7个:非工作时段活动、PR合并时间、词汇疲惫、情感-疲惫、词汇多样性、Hapax率、语言唤醒度;脱离维度7个:提交量、评审参与、PR拒绝率、任务放弃、代词使用、词汇脱离、情感-脱离);每位贡献者信号相对自身历史(百分位排名+4月滚动趋势斜率)进行相对评分;维度内权重由L-BFGS-B基于标注案例(10位披露+12位活动崩塌+46位对照)的学习得到,正则化向4种锚点(均等、启发式、疲惫偏重、脱离偏重)收缩;两维度等权平均为月度BRS,经sigmoid(中心0.65,陡度8)映射;风险发病定义为连续3个月超过阈值,峰值BRS作为补充标准。
AI.result: 在24个月窗口内,BRS持续升高在10位自我披露倦怠者中预先识别其中6位(提前6–15个月);加入峰值BRS后覆盖率升至8/10;10/10在更长时间窗口内均有BRS升高史。12位活动崩塌案例中6位在4–13个月内被识别,加入峰值后升至10/12。46位对照贡献者中35位(76%)从未越过阈值。权重学习显示非工作时段活动与提交量为最具影响力的信号。峰值BRS与独立活动评分仅弱相关(r=0.260),表明BRS不可还原为活动量。
AI.conclusion: BurnRiSc证明倦怠可从公开仓库数据中被筛查,且BRS在公开披露前数月即可预警。它是筛查工具而非诊断工具,旨在触发温和、非评判性的关怀而非干预。设计上偏向更多假阳性以换取更少假阴性。未来工作包括扩大标注样本、针对AI辅助贡献重新校准、直接对照OLBI施测以验证构念效度。

title: Think Thrice Before Reranking: Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking
summary: Reasoning-based reranking with Large Language Models (LLMs) has shown promising improvements in text ranking. However, current methods predominantly rely on a single reasoning trajectory, resulting in rankings that are susceptible to reasoning errors and inherently constrained in modeling the multifaceted signals underlying document relevance. To resolve this dilemma, we propose MERIT-Rank(Multi-perspective Evidence and Reasoning Integration for Text Reranking), a framework that models complementary reasoning trajectories to improve reranking robustness. MERIT-Rank formulates a Multi-Trajectory Reasoning Space (MTRS) that evaluates query-document relevance from multiple perspectives and introduces a joint reranker that consolidates these reasoning paths into a unified ranking decision. We further develop Progressive Rank Policy Optimization (PRPO), a progressive training framework that stabilizes reasoning trajectories while continually improving ranking quality through staged optimization objectives. Experiments on both reasoning-intensive and traditional retrieval benchmarks show that MERIT-Rank consistently achieves superior performance over competitive baselines. The 4B model notably outperforms most 7B and even 32B rerankers on BRIGHT.

AI.tldr: MERIT-Rank 提出了一种基于多视角推理轨迹的文本重排序框架，通过构建多轨迹推理空间（MTRS）和渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），缓解了现有方法对单一推理轨迹的依赖问题，显著提升了排序的鲁棒性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的推理式重排序方法依赖单一推理轨迹生成最终排序，存在两个关键缺陷：(1) 推理链中的错误会通过自回归生成传播并损害最终排序；(2) 查询-文档相关性本质上是多维度的（语义对齐、用户意图满足、证据支持等），单一推理轨迹难以全面捕捉这些多面信号。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心组件：(1) 多轨迹推理空间（MTRS），定义三种互补推理视角——语义对齐推理、意图满足推理、证据基础推理，并使用 DeepSeek-R1 作为教师模型合成多视角推理链及汇总推理链；(2) 多轨迹联合重排序器，在统一生成式框架内依次生成各视角的推理与排序，再聚合生成综合推理与最终排序；(3) 渐进式排序策略优化（PRPO），采用课程式训练——先 SFT 学习结构化多轨迹推理格式，再分两阶段 P-GRPO 强化学习：第一阶段使用格式奖励 + 相对排序奖励（优于初始检索），第二阶段叠加绝对排序指标（MRR、NDCG）。
AI.result: 在 BRIGHT 推理密集型基准上，MERIT-Rank-32B 平均 NDCG@10 达 40.3，MERIT-Rank-4B 达 36.6，优于多数 7B 甚至 32B 基线；在 TREC-DL 和 BEIR 传统检索基准上，MERIT-Rank-32B 平均 NDCG@10 分别达 73.6 和 62.5，均为 SOTA。消融实验表明：(1) 移除任一推理视角均导致性能下降，其中合成推理贡献最大（-1.84）；(2) 移除所有推理导致 -4.95 的大幅下降；(3) P-GRPO 优于单阶段 GRPO 及 ReasonRank 奖励方案；(4) 显式视角约束相比无约束多轨迹提升 5.1%。效率方面，使用 3 个滑动窗口即可达到与 ReasonRank 9 个窗口相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MERIT-Rank 通过多视角互补推理有效缓解了单路径推理的幻觉和错误传播问题，在推理密集型和传统 IR 任务上均达到 SOTA 性能，同时展现强泛化能力、参数效率和推理效率，验证了结构化多视角推理框架的有效性。

title: Making Local Government Contracts Legible: A Computational Pipeline for Classifying and Mapping Intergovernmental Service Agreements
comment: 22 pages, 8 tables, 7 figures
summary: Interlocal agreements are one of the primary instruments through which local governments formalize collaboration for public service delivery, yet the institutional and financial content encoded in these contracts has remained inaccessible to systematic analysis at scale. This paper introduces an end-to-end computational pipeline for classifying intergovernmental agreements by institutional form and extracting financial relationships between principals and agents in service contracts. Applied to Iowa's 28E archive (N = 21,629), the largest dataset of interlocal agreements in the United States, the pipeline combines LLM-based summarization and classification across LLaMA 3.1, GPT 5.2 Pro, and Gemini 3 Pro on a four-class classification task that distinguishes agreements as either service contracts, resource sharing agreements, joint operations agreements, or new joint entity agreements. We also identify the financial principal and agent in these agreements and contracts, as well as the resulting dollar amounts and represent them on a directed network.
